Bava Kamma 92a:7-16: Gemara tanu rabbanan: kol ellu sheamru – deme voshto; aval tzaaro – afillu hevi kol ele nevayot shebbaolam, en nimchal lo ad sheyyevakkesh mimmennu. shenneemar: "hashev eshet haish ki navi hu, veyitpallel baadcha".
Deeshet navi bae ahdore, eshet acher la bae ahdore?

Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: "hashev eshet haish" – mikkol makom. udeka amrat: "hagoy gam tzaddik taharog?! halo hu amar li achoti hi, vehi gam hi amra achi hu!" navi hu, uchevar limmed: achsenay shebba lair – al iske achila ushetiyya shoalin oto, o al iske ishto shoalin oto – "ishtecha hi?" "achotcha hi?"
Mikkan leven noach shenneherag, shehaya lo lilmod velo lamad.
"Ki atzor atzar Adonai" – amar rabbi elazar: shete atzirot hallalu lamma? achat beish – shichvat zera, shetayim beishsha – shichvat zera veleda.
Bematnita tena: shetayim beish – shichvat zera uketannim, shelosha baishsha – shichvat zera uketannim veleda.
Ravina amar: shalosh beish – shichvat zera uketannim ufi tabbaat, arbaa beishsha – shichvat zera veleda uketannim ufi tabbaat.
"Bead kol rechem" – amri deve rabbi yannay: afillu tarnegolet shel bet avimelech lo hetila betzatah.

Amar leh rava lerabba bar mari: mena ha milleta daamur rabbanan: kol hamevakkesh rachamim al chavero vehu tzarich leoto davar, hu naane techilla? amar leh: dichtiv: "vaAdonai shav et shevut iyyov behitpallo bead reehu".

Amar leh: at amrat mehatam, vaana amena mehacha: "vayyitpallel avraham el haelohim, vayyirpa elohim et avimelech veet ishto veamhotav [vegomer]", uchetiv: "vaAdonai pakad et sara kaasher amar vegomer" – kaasher amar avraham el avimelech.
Berakhot 53b:13-19: Mi sheachal vechulei. amar rav zevid veittema rav dimi bar abba: machaloket beshachach, aval bemezid, divre hakkol — yachzor limkomo vivarech.
Mahu detema hu haddin afillu bemezid, vehay dekatane "veshachach" — lehodiacha kochan devet shammay. kamashma lan.

Tanya, amru lahem bet hillel levet shammay: ledivrechem, mi sheachal berosh habbira veshachach veyarad velo berach, yachzor lerosh habbira vivarech?! amru lahen bet shammay levet hillel: ledivrechem mi sheshshachach arnaki berosh habbira lo yaale veyitlenna? lichvod atzmo hu ole, lichvod shamayim lo kol shekken?!
Hanhu tere talmide, chad avad beshogeg kevet shammay veashkach arneka dedahava, vechad avad bemezid kevet hillel veachleh arya.

Rabba bar bar chana hava kaazel beshayyayrta, achal veishteli vela barech. amar: hechi aaved? i amena lehu "inneshay levarech", amru li: barech, kol hecha dimvarchat — lerachamana mevarchat. mutav deamena lehu: inneshay yona dedahava. amar lehu: intaru li, deinneshay yona dedahava. azel uvarech veashkach yona dedahava.

Umay shena yona? dimtili keneset yisrael leyona. dichtiv: "kanfe yona nechpa vakkesef veevroteha birakrak charutz" — ma yona enah nitztzolet ella bichnafeha, af yisrael enan nitztzolin ella bemitzvot.
Jonah 1:1-5: Kum lech el-ninve hair haggedola ukera aleha ki-alta raatam lefanay
Vayyakom yona livroach tarshisha millifne Adonai vayyered yafo vayyimtza oniyya ׀ baa tarshish vayyitten secharah vayyered bah lavo immahem tarshisha millifne Adonai

Vayyiru hammallachim vayyizaku ish el-elohav vayyatilu et-hakkelim asher booniyya el-hayyam lehakel mealehem veyona yarad el-yarkete hassefina vayyishkav vayyeradam
Mishnah Arakhin 8:1-5:
Hammakdish et sadehu beshaa sheenah yovel, omrim lo petach atta rishon, shehabbealim notnim chomesh, vechol adam eno noten chomesh. maase veechad shehikdish et sadehu mippene raatah, amru lo, petach atta rishon. amar, hare hi shelli veissar. amar rabbi yose, lo amar ze ella bechabbetza, shehahekdesh nifde vechesef uveshave chasef. amar lo, higgiatcha, nimtza mafsid issar, vesadehu lefanav: 
Amar echad, hare hi shelli veeser selaim, veechad omer beesrim, veechad omer bishloshim, veechad omer bearbaim, veechad omer bachamishshim. chazar bo shel chamishshim, memashkenin minnechasav ad aser. chazar bo shel arbaim, memashkenin minnechasav ad aser. chazar bo shel sheloshim, memashkenin minnechasav ad aser. chazar bo shel esrim, memashkenim minnechasav ad aser. chazar bo shel eser, mochrim otah beshavyah venifraim mishshel eser et hammotar. habbealim omrim beesrim, vechol adam omrim beesrim, habbealim kodmim, mippene shehen mosifin chomesh: 
Amar echad, hare hi shelli veesrim veachat, habbealim notnim esrim veshesh. beesrim ushetayim, habbealim notnim esrim vesheva. beesrim veshalosh, habbealim notnim esrim ushemone. beesrim vearba, habbealim notnim tisha veesrim. bachamishsha veesrim, habbealim notnim sheloshim, sheen mosifin chomesh al illuyo shel ze. amar echad, hare hi shelli beesrim vashesh, im ratzu habbealim litten sheloshim veechad vedinar, habbealim kodmim. veim lav, omrim, higgiatcha: 
Macharim adam mitztzono umibbekaro, meavadav umishshifchotav hakkenaanim, umissede achuzzato. veim hecherim et kullan, enan muchramin, divre rabbi elazar. amar rabbi elazar ben azarya, ma im laggavoah, en adam rashshay lehacharim et kol nechasav, al achat kamma vechamma sheyyehe adam chayyav lihyot chas al nechasav: 
Hammacharim beno uvitto, avdo veshifchato haivrim, usede miknato, enan muchramim, sheen adam macharim davar sheeno shello. kohanim uleviyyim enan macharimin, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi shimon omer, hakkohanim enan macharimin, shehacharamim shellahem. haleviyyim macharimim, sheen hacharamim shellahen. rabbi omer, nirim divre rabbi yehuda bakkarkaot, shenneemar (Vayikra 25), ki achuzzat olam hu lahem, vedivre rabbi shimon bemittaltelim, sheen hacharamim shellahem:
Mishnah Arakhin 8:6-9:2:
Cherme chohanim en lahem pidyon, ella nittanim lakkohanim. rabbi yehuda ven betera omer, setam charamim levedek habbayit, shenneemar (sham 27), kol cherem kodesh kadashim hu laAdonai. vachachamim omrim, setam charamim lakkohanim, shenneemar (sham), kisde hacherem lakkohen tihye achuzzato. im ken, lamma neemar kol cherem kodesh kadashim hu laAdonai. shehu chal al kadshe kadashim veal kadashim kallim: 
Macharim adam et kadashav, ben kadshe kadashim uven kadashim kallim. im neder, noten et haddamim. im nedava, noten et tovato. shor ze ola, omdim kamma adam rotze litten beshor ze lehaaloto ola, sheeno rashshay. habbechor, ben tamim ben baal mum, macharimin oto. ketzad podin oto. happodin omdim kamma adam rotze litten bivchor ze, litteno leven bitto o leven achoto. rabbi yishmael omer, katuv echad omer takdish, vechatuv echad omer al takdish. i efshar lomar takdish, shekkevar neemar al takdish, vei efshar lomar al takdish, shekkevar neemar takdish. emor meatta, makdisho atta hekdesh illuy, veen atta makdisho hekdesh mizbeach: 
Hammocher et sadehu bishat hayyovel, eno muttar ligol pachut mishshete shanim, shenneemar (Vayikra 25), bemispar shene tevuot yimkar lach. hayta shenat shiddafon veyerakon o sheviit, enah ola min hamminyan. narah o hovirah, ola lo min hamminyan. rabbi elazar omer, mecharah lo lifne rosh hashshana vehi melea ferot, hare ze ochel mimmenna shalosh tevuot lishte shanim: 
Mecharah larishon bemane, umachar harishon lashsheni bematayim, eno mechashshev ella im harishon, shenneemar, laish asher machar lo. mecharah larishon bematayim, umachar harishon lashsheni bemane, eno mechashshev ella im haacharon, shenneemar (sham), laish, laish asher betochah. lo yimkor berachok veyigol bekarov, bera veyigol beyafe. lo yilve veyigal, velo yigal lachatzaim. uvahekdesh muttar bechullan. ze chomer bahedyot mibbahekdesh:
Mishnah Arakhin 9:3-6:
Hammocher bayit bevatte are choma, hare ze goel miyyad, vegoel kol shenem asar chodesh, hare ze kemin ribbit veenah ribbit. met hammocher, yigal beno. met hallokeach, yigal miyyad beno. eno mone lo shana ella mishshaa shemmachar lo, shenneemar (sham), ad melot lo shana temima. ucheshehu omer temima, lehavi chodesh haibbur. rabbi omer, yitten lo shana veibburah: 
Higgia yom shenem asar chodesh velo nigal, haya chalut lo, echad hallokeach veechad shennittan lo mattana, shenneemar latztzemitut. barishona haya nitman yom shenem asar chodesh, sheyyehe chalut lo. hitkin hillel hazzaken, sheyyehe cholesh et meotav ballishka, vihe shover et haddelet venichnas. ematay sheyyirtze halla, yavo veyittol et meotav: 
Kol shehu lifnim min hachoma, hare hu chevatte are choma, chutz min hassadot. rabbi meir omer, af hassadot. bayit habbanuy bachoma, rabbi yehuda omer, eno chevatte are choma. rabbi shimon omer, kotel hachitzon hi chomato: 
Ir sheggaggoteha chomatah, vesheenah mukkefet choma mimot yehoshua bin nun, enah kevatte are choma. veellu hen batte are choma, shalosh chatzerot shel shene shene vattim, mukkafot choma mimot yehoshua bin nun, kegon katztzera hayeshana shel tzipporim, vechakra shel gush chalav, veyodfat hayeshana, vegamla, ugedod, vechadid, veono, virushalayim, vechen kayyotze vahen:
Mishnah Arakhin 9:7-8:
Batte hachatzerim, notnim lahem koach hayyafe shebbevatte are choma vechoach hayyafe shebbassadot. nigalin miyyad, venigalin kol shenem asar chodesh kabbattim, veyotzim bayyovel uvegiron kesef kassadot. veellu hen batte chatzerim, shete chatzerot shel shene shene vattim, af al pi shemmukkafin choma mimot yehoshua bin nun, hare ellu chevatte chatzerim: 
Yisrael sheyyarash avi immo levi, eno goel kasseder hazze. vechen levi sheyyarash et avi immo yisrael, eno goel kasseder hazze, shenneemar (Vayikra 25), ki vatte are haleviyyim, ad sheyhe levi uveare haleviyyim, divre rabbi. vachachamim omrim, en haddevarim amurim ella veare haleviyyim. en osim sade migrash velo migrash sade, velo migrash ir velo ir migrash. amar rabbi eliezer, bamme devarim amurim. beare haleviyyim. aval beare yisrael, osin sade migrash velo migrash sade, migrash ir velo ir migrash, kede shello yacharivu et are yisrael. hakkohanim vehaleviyyim mochrim leolam vegoalim leolam, shenneemar (sham), geullat olam tihye lalviyyim:
Mishnah Kilayim 1:3-6:
Hallefet vehannafutz, vehakkeruv vehatterovtor, hatteradim vehalleunim, enam kilayim ze vaze. hosif rabbi akiva, hashshum vehashshumanit, habbatzal vehabbetzaltzul, vehatturmos vehappelaslos, enan kilayim ze vaze: 
Uvailan, haagasim vehakkerustumelin, vehapperishim vehauzradim, enam kilayim ze vaze. hattappuach vehachazrad, happarsekim vehashshekedin, vehashshizzafin veharimin, af al pi sheddomin ze laze, kilayim ze vaze: 
Hatztzenon vehannafutz, hachardal vehallafsan, udelaat yevanit im hammitzrit veharmutza, af al pi sheddomin ze laze, kilayim ze vaze: 
Hazzeev vehakkelev, kelev hakkufri vehashshual, haizzim vehatztzevaim, hayyeelim veharchelim, hassus vehappered, happered vehachamor, hachamor vehearod, af al pi sheddomin ze laze, kilayim ze vaze:
Mishnah Kilayim 1:7-2:1:
En meviin ilan beilan, yarak beyarak, velo ilan beyarak, velo yarak beilan. rabbi yehuda mattir yarak beilan: 
En notin yerakot betoch saddan shel shikma. en markivin pegam al gabbe kidda levana, mippene shehu yarak beilan. en notin yichur shel teena letoch hachatzuv, sheyyehe mekero. en tochavin zemora shel gefen letoch haavattiach, shettehe zoreket memeha letocho, mippene shehu ilan beyarak. en notnin zera delaat letoch hachallamit, shettehe meshammarto, mippene shehu yarak beyarak: 
Hattomen lefet utzenonot tachat haggefen, im hayu miktzat alav megullin, eno choshesh lo mishshum kilayim, velo mishshum sheviit, velo mishshum maasrot, venittalim beshabbat. hazzorea chitta useora keachat, hare ze chilayim. rabbi yehuda omer, eno kilayim, ad sheyyehu shene chittim useora, o chitta ushete seorim, o chitta useora vechussamet: 
Kol sea sheyyesh bo rova mimmin acher, yemaet. rabbi yose omer, yavor. ben mimmin echad ben mishshene minin. rabbi shimon omer, lo amru ella mimmin echad. vachachamim omrim, kol shehu chilayim bassea mitztaref lerova:
Mishnah Kilayim 2:11-3:3:
Tevua nota al gabbe tevua, veyarak al gabbe yarak, tevua al gabbe yarak, yarak al gabbe tevua, hakkol muttar, chutz middelaat yevanit. rabbi meir omer, af hakkishshut ufol hammitzri, veroe ani et divrehen middevaray: 
Aruga shehi shishsha tefachim al shishsha tefachim, zorim betochah chamishsha zeronim, arbaa bearba ruchot haaruga, veechad baemtza. haya lah gevul gavoah tefach, zorin betochah shelosha asar, shelosha al kol gevul ugevul, veechad baemtza. lo yitta rosh hallefet betoch haggevul, mippene shehu memalehu. rabbi yehuda omer, shishsha baemtza: 
Kol min zeraim en zorim baaruga, vechol min yerakot zorin baaruga. chardal vaafunim hashshufin, min zeraim. afunim haggamlanim, min yarak. gevul shehaya gavoah tefach venitmaet, kasher, shehaya chasher mittechillato. hattelem veammat hammayim shehem amukkim tefach, zorim letochan shelosha zeronin, echad mikkan, veechad mikkan, veechad baemtza: 
Haya rosh tor yarak nichnas letoch sede yarak acher, muttar, mippene shehu nire kesof sadehu. hayta sadehu zarua yarak, vehu mevakkesh litta betocho shura shel yarak acher, rabbi yishmael omer, ad sheyyehe hattelem mefullash merosh hassade vead rosho. rabbi akiva omer, orech shishsha tefachim verochav meloo. rabbi yehuda omer, rochav kimlo rochav happarsa:
Mishnah Kilayim 2:2-6:
Bamme devarim amurim. tevua vitvua vekitnit bekitnit, tevua vekitnit vekitnit bitvua. beemet amru, zerone ginna sheenan neechalin, mitztarfin echad meesrim vearba benofel levet sea. rabbi shimon omer, keshem sheamru lehachemir kach amru lehakel, happishtan battevua mitztarefet echad meesrim vearba benofel levet sea: 
Hayta sadehu zerua chittim venimlach lezarah seorim, yamtin lah ad shettatlia, veyofach, veachar kach yizra. im tzimmecha, lo yomar ezra veachar kach ofach, ella hofech veachar kach zorea. kamma yehe choresh, ketalme harvia. abba shaul omer, kede shello yeshayyer rova levet sea: 
Zerua venimlach lenatah, lo yomar etta veachar kach ofach, ella hofech veachar kach notea. netua venimlach lezarah, lo yomar ezra veachar kach asharesh, ella mesharesh veachar kach zorea. im ratza, gomem ad pachot mittefach, zorea, veachar kach mesharesh: 
Hayta sadehu zerua kanbos o luf, lo yehe zorea uva al gabbehem, sheenan osin ella lishlosha shanim. tevua sheala vah sefiche istis, vechen mekom haggeranot shealu vahen minin harebe, vechen tiltan sheheela mine tzemachim, en mechayyevin oto lenakkesh. im nikkesh o chissach, omrim lo, akor et hakkol chutz mimmin echad: 
Harotze laasot sadehu meshar meshar mikkol min, bet shammay omrim, shelosha telamim shel patiach. uvet hillel omrim, melo haol hashsharoni. ukerovin divre ellu lihyot kedivre ellu:
Mishnah Kilayim 2:7-10:
Haya rosh tor chittim nichnas betoch shel seorim, muttar, mippene shehu nire kesof sadehu. shello chittim veshel chavero min acher, muttar lismoch lo meoto hammin. shello chittim veshel chavero chittim, muttar lismoch lo telem shel pishtan, velo telem shel min acher. rabbi shimon omer, echad zera pishtan veechad kol hamminin. rabbi yose omer, af beemtza sadehu muttar livdok betelem shel pishtan: 
En somchin lisde tevua chardal vecharia, aval somchin lisde yerakot chardal vecharia. vesomech levur, ulenir, ulegafa, ulederech, ulegader gavoah asara tefachim, ulecharitz shehu amok asara verachav arbaa, uleilan shehu mesech al haaretz, ulesela gavoah asara verachav arbaa: 
Harotze laasot sadehu karachat karachat mikkol min, ose esrim vearba karachot levet sea, mikkarachat levet rova, vezorea betochah kol min sheyyirtze. hayta karachat achat o shetayim, zoram chardal. shalosh, lo yizra chardal, mippene shehi niret kisde chardal, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, tesha karachot muttarot, eser asurot. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer, afillu chol sadehu bet kor, lo yaase vetochah chutz mikkarachat achat: 
Kol shehu vetoch bet rova, ole vemiddat bet rova. achilat haggefen vehakkever vehassela, olin bemiddat bet rova. tevua vitvua, bet rova. yarak beyarak, shishsha tefachim. tevua veyarak, yarak bitvua, bet rova. rabbi eliezer omer, yarak bitvua, shishsha tefachim:
Mishnah Kilayim 3:4-4:1:
Hannotea shete shurot shel kishshuin, shete shurot shel deluim, shete shurot shel pol hammitzri, muttar. shura shel kishshuim, shura shel deluim, shura shel pol hammitzri, asur. shura shel kishshuim, shura shel deluim, shura shel pol hammitzri, veshura shel kishshuim, rabbi eliezer mattir, vachachamim osrin: 
Notea adam kishshut udelaat letoch gumma achat, uvilvad shettehe zo nota letzad ze, vezo nota letzad ze, venote sear shel zo lechan, vesear shel zo lechan. shekkol ma sheasru chachamim, lo gazru ella mippene marit haayin: 
Hayta sadehu zarua vetzalim, umevakkesh litta betochah shurot shel deluim, rabbi yishmael omer, oker shete shurot venotea shura achat, umanniach kamat betzalim bimkom shete shurot, veoker shete shurot venotea shura echat. rabbi akiva omer, oker shete shurot venotea shete shurot, umanniach kamat betzalim bimkom shete shurot, veoker shete shurot venotea shete shurot. vachachamim omrim, im en ben shura lachavertah shetem esre amma, lo yekayyem et hazzera shel bentayim: 
Delaat beyarak, keyarak. uvitvua, notnin lah bet rova. hayta sadehu zerua tevua, uvikkesh litta letochah shura shel deluin, notnin lah laavodatah shishsha tefachim. veim higdila, yaakor millefaneha. rabbi yose omer, notnin lah avodatah arba ammot. amru lo, hatachmir zo min haggafen. amar lahen, matzinu shezzo chamura min haggefen, shellegefen yechidit notnin lah avodatah shishsha tefachim, velidlaat yechidit notnin lah bet rova. rabbi meir omer mishshum rabbi yishmael, kol shelosha deluin levet sea, lo yavi zera letoch bet sea. rabbi yose ben hachotef efrati amar mishshum rabbi yishmael, kol shelosha deluin levet kor, lo yavi zera letoch bet kor: 
Karachat hakkerem, bet shammay omrim, esrim vearba ammot. uvet hillel omrim shesh esre amma. mechol hakkerem, bet shammay omrim, shesh esre amma. uvet hillel omrim shetem esre amma. veezo hi karachat hakkerem. kerem shecharav meemtzao. im en sham shesh esre amma, lo yavi zera lesham. hayu sham shesh esre amma, notnin lah avodatah, vezorea et hammotar:
Mishnah Nedarim 1:4-2:3:
Haomer, karban, ola, mincha, chattat, toda, shelamim sheeni ochel lach, asur. rabbi yehuda mattir. hakkarban, kekarban, karban sheochal lach, asur. lekarban lo ochal lach, rabbi meir oser. haomer lachavero, konam pi hamedabber immach, yadi osa immach, ragli mehallechet immach, asur:  
Veellu muttarin. chullin sheochal lach, kivsar chazir, kaavoda zara, keorot levuvin, kinvelot, kitrefot, kishkatzim, kirmasim, kechallat aharon vechitrumato, muttar. haomer leishto, hare at alay keimma, potchin lo fetach mimmakom acher, shello yakel rosho lechach. konam sheeni yashen, sheeni medabber, sheeni mehallech, haomer leishto, konam sheeni meshammeshech, hare ze velo yachel devaro. shevua sheeni yashen, sheeni medabber, sheeni mehallech, asur: 
Karban lo ochal lach, karban sheochal lach, lo karban lo ochal lach, muttar. shevua lo ochal lach, shevua sheochal lach, lo shevua lo ochal lach, asur. ze chomer bashshevuot mibbannedarim. vechomer bannedarim mibbashshevuot, ketzad, amar, konam sukka sheani ose, lulav sheani notel, tefillin sheani meniach, bannedarim asur, bashshevuot muttar, sheen nishbain laavor al hammitzvot: 
Yesh neder betoch neder, veen shevua betoch shevua. ketzad, amar hareni nazir im ochal, hareni nazir im ochal, veachal, chayyav al kol achat veechat. shevua shello ochal, shevua shello ochal, veachal, eno chayyav ella echat:
Mishnah Nedarim 2:4-3:3:
Setam nedarim lehachemir, uferusham lehakel. ketzad, amar hare alay kevasar maliach, keyen nesech, im shel shamayim nadar, asur. im shel avoda zara nadar, muttar. veim setam, asur. hare alay kecherem, im kecherem shel shamayim, asur. veim kecherem shel kohanim, muttar. veim setam, asur. hare alay kemaaser, im kemasar behema nadar, asur. veim shel goren, muttar. veim setam, asur. hare alay kitruma, im kitrumat hallishka nadar, asur. veim shel goren, muttar. veim setam, asur, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer, setam teruma bihuda asura, baggalil mutteret, sheen anshe galil makkirin et terumat hallishka. setam charamim, bihuda muttarin, uvaggalil asurin, sheen anshe galil makkirin et cherme hakkohanim: 
Nadar becherem veamar, lo nadarti ella vechermo shel yam. bekarban, veamar, lo nadarti ella vekarbanot shel melachim. hare atzmi karban, veamar, lo nadarti ella veetzem shehinnachti li lihyot noder bo. konam ishti nehenet li, veamar lo nadarti ella veishti harishona sheggerashti, al kullan en nishalim lahem. veim nishalu, onshin otan umachmirin alehen, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, potchin lahem petach mimmakom acher, umelammedim otan kede shello yinhagu kallut rosh bannedarim: 
Arbaa nedarim hittiru chachamim, nidre zeruzin, venidre havay, venidre shegagot, venidre onasim. nidre zeruzin, ketzad. haya mocher chefetz veamar, konam sheeni fochet lecha min hassela, vehalla omer, konam sheeni mosif lecha al hashshekel, shenehen rotzin bishlosha dinarin. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer, af harotze lehaddir et chavero sheyyochal etzlo, omer, kol neder sheani atid liddor hu vatel, uvilvad sheyyehe zachur bishat hanneder: 
Nidre havay, amar, konam im lo raiti vadderech hazze cheyotze mitzrayim, im lo raiti nachash kekorat bet habbad. nidre shegagot, im achalti veim shatiti, venizkar sheachal veshata. sheani ochel vesheani shote, veshachach veachal veshata. amar, konam ishti nehenet li, shegganva et kisi veshehikketa et beni, venoda shello hikkattu venoda shello genavattu. raa otan ochlim teenim veamar, hare alechem karban, venimtzeu aviv veechav, vehayu immahen acherim, bet shammay omrim, hen muttarin uma sheimmahen asurin. uvet hillel omrim, ellu vaellu muttarin: 
Nidre onasim, hiddiro chavero sheyyochal etzlo, vechala hu o shechala veno o sheikkevo nahar, hare ellu nidre onasin:
Mishnah Nedarim 3:4-7:
Nodrin lohoragin velochoramin velammochsin shehi teruma af al pi sheenah teruma, shehen shel bet hammelech af al pi sheenan shel bet hammelech. bet shammay omrim, bakkol nodrin, chutz mibbishvua. uvet hillel omrim, af bishvua. bet shammay omrim, lo yiftach lo veneder. uvet hillel omrim, af yiftach lo. bet shammay omrim, bema shehu maddiro. uvet hillel omrim, af bema sheeno maddiro. ketzad, amru lo, emor konam ishti nehenet li, veamar konam ishti uvanay nehenin li, bet shammay omrim, ishto mutteret uvanav asurin. uvet hillel omrim, ellu vaellu muttarin: 
Hare netiot haellu karban im enan niktzatzot, tallit zo karban im enah nisrefet, yesh lahen pidyon. hare netiot haellu karban ad sheyyikkatztzu, tallit zo karban ad shettissaref, en lahem pidyon: 
Hannoder miyyorde hayyam, muttar beyoshve hayyabbasha. miyyoshve hayyabbasha, asur beyorde hayyam, sheyyorde hayyam bichlal yoshve hayyabbasha. lo chaellu sheholchin meakko leyafo, ella vemi sheddarko lefaresh: 
Hannoder meroe hachamma, asur af bassumin, shello nitkavven ze ella lemi shehachamma roa oto:
Mishnah Nedarim 3:8-11:
Hannoder mishshechore harosh, asur bakkerchin uvevaale sevot, umuttar bannashim uvakketannim, sheen nikrain shechore harosh ella anashim: 
Hannoder min hayyillodim, muttar bannoladim. min hannoladim, asur bayyillodim. rabbi meir mattir af bayyillodim. vachachamim omrim, lo nitkavven ze ella vemi sheddarko leholid: 
Hannoder mishshovte shabbat, asur beyisrael veasur bakkutim. meochle shum, asur beyisrael veasur bakkutim. meole yerushalayim, asur beyisrael umuttar bakkutim: 
Konam sheeni nehene livne noach, muttar beyisrael veasur beummot haolam. sheeni nehene lezera avraham, asur beyisrael umuttar beummot haolam. sheeni nehene leyisrael, lokeach beyoter umocher befachot. sheyyisrael nehenin li, lokeach befachot umocher beyoter, im shomin lo. sheeni nehene lahen vehen li, yehanne lannachrim. konam sheeni nehene laarelim, muttar bearle yisrael veasur bemule haggoyim. konam sheeni nehene lammulim, asur bearle yisrael umuttar bemule haggoyim, sheen haarla keruya ella leshem haggoyim, shenneemar (yirmeya 9) ki chol haggoyim arelim vechol bet yisrael arle lev, veomer (Shmuel 1 17) vehaya happelishti hearel hazze, veomer (Shmuel b 1) pen tismachna benot pelishtim, pen taalozna benot haarelim. rabbi elazar ben azarya omer, meusa arla shennitgannu vah harshaim, shenneemar, ki chol haggoyim arelim. rabbi yishmael omer, gedola mila shennichretu aleha shelosh esre veritot. rabbi yose omer, gedola mila, sheddocha et hashshabbat hachamura. rabbi yehoshua ben karcha omer, gedola mila, shello nitla lo lemoshe hatzaddik aleha melo shaa. rabbi nechemya omer, gedola mila, sheddocha et hannegaim. rabbi omer, gedola mila, shekkol hammitzvot sheasa avraham avinu lo nikra shalem, ad shemmal, shenneemar (Bereshit 17), hithallech lefanay vehye tamim. davar acher, gedola mila, sheilmale hi, lo vara hakkadosh baruch hu et olamo, shenneemar (yirmeya log), ko amar Adonai im lo veriti yomam valayla, chukkot shamayim vaaretz lo samti:
Mishnah Nedarim 4:1-5:
En ben hammuddar hanaa mechavero lammuddar hemennu maachol ella derisat haregel vechelim sheen osin bahen ochel nefesh. hammuddar maachol mechavero, lo yashilennu nafa uchevara verechayim vetannur, aval mashil lo chaluk vetabbaat vetallit unezamim, vechol davar sheen osin bo ochel nefesh. mekom shemmaskirin kayyotze vahen, asur: 
Hammuddar hanaa mechavero, shokel et shiklo, uforea et chovo, umachazir lo et avedato. mekom shennotlin aleha sachar, tippol hanaa lahekdesh: 
Vetorem et terumato umaasrotav ledato. umakriv alav kinne zavin, kinne zavot, kinne yoldot, chattaot vaashamot, umelammedo midrash, halachot veaggadot, aval lo yelammedennu mikra. aval melammed hu et banav veet benotav mikra, vezan et ishto veet banav af al pi shehu chayyav bimzonotehem. velo yazun et behemto, ben temea ben tehora. rabbi eliezer omer, zan et hattemea, veeno zan et hattehora. amru lo, ma ben temea lithora. amar lahen, shehattehora nafshah lashshamayim vegufah shello, utemea nafshah vegufah lashshamayim. amru lo, af hattemea nafshah lashshamayim vegufah shello, sheim yirtze, hare hu mochrah legoyim o maachilah lichlavim: 
Hammuddar hanaa mechavero venichnas levakkero, omed, aval lo yoshev. umerappeehu refuat nefesh, aval lo refuat mamon. verochetz immo veambatiya gedola, aval lo viktanna. veyashen immo vemitta. rabbi yehuda omer, bimot hachamma, aval lo vimot haggeshamim, mippene shehu mehannehu. umesev immo al hammitta, veochel immo al hashshulchan, aval lo min hattamchuy, aval ochel hu immo min hattamchuy hachozer. lo yochal immo min haevus shellifne happoalim, velo yaase immo veumman, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, ose hu verichuk mimmennu: 
Hammuddar hanaa mechavero lifne sheviit, lo yored letoch sadehu, veeno ochel min hannotot. uvashsheviit eno yored letoch sadehu, aval ochel hu min hannotot. nadar hemennu maachol lifne sheviit, yored letoch sadehu, veeno ochel min happerot. uvashsheviit, yored veochel:
Mishnah Nedarim 4:6-5:1:
Hammuddar hanaa mechavero, lo yashilennu velo yishal mimmennu, lo yalvennu velo yilve mimmennu, velo yimkor lo velo yikkach mimmennu. amar lo, hasheileni faratecha. amar lo, enah penuya. amar konam sadi sheani choresh bah leolam, im haya darko lacharosh, hu asur vechol adam muttarin. im en darko lacharosh, hu vechol adam asurin: 
Hammuddar hanaa mechavero veen lo ma yochal, holech etzel hachenvani veomer, ish peloni muddar mimmenni hanaa veeni yodea ma eese, vehu noten lo uva venotel mizze. haya veto livnot, gedero ligdor, sadehu liktzor, holech etzel happoalim veomer, ish peloni muddar mimmenni hanaa veeni yodea ma eese. hem osin immo, uvain venotlin sachar mizze: 
Hayu mehallechin badderech, veen lo ma yochal, noten leacher leshum mattana vehalla muttar bah. im en immahem acher, manniach al hassela o al haggader veomer, hare hen mufkarim lechol mi sheyyachpotz, vehalla notel veochel. verabbi yose oser: 
Hashshuttafin shennadru hanaa ze mizze, asurin likkanes lechatzer. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer, ze nichnas letoch shello veze nichnas letoch shello. ushenehem asurim lehaamid sham rechayim vetannur ulegaddel tarnegolim. haya echad mehem muddar hanaa mechavero, lo yikkanes lechatzer. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer, yachol hu lomar lo, letoch shelli ani nichnas veeni nichnas letoch shellach. vechofin et hannoder limkor et chelko:
Mishnah Temurah 1:1-3:
Hakkol memirim, echad anashim veechad nashim. lo sheadam rashshay lehamir, ella, sheim hemir, mumar, vesofeg et haarbaim. hakkohanim memirim et shellahem, veyisrael memirim et shellahem. en hakkohanim memirim lo vechattat velo veasham velo vivchor. amar rabbi yochanan ben nuri, vechi mippene ma en memirim bivchor. amar lo rabbi akiva, chattat veasham mattana lakkohen, vehabbechor mattana lakkohen. ma chattat veasham en memirim bo, af habbechor lo yemirennu vo. amar lo rabbi yochanan ben nuri, ma li eno memir bechattat uveasham, sheen zachin bahen bechayyehem. tomar bivchor, shezzachin bo vechayyav. amar lo rabbi akiva, vahalo chevar neemar, vehaya hu utemurato yihye kodesh (Vayikra 27), hechan kedushsha chala alav, bevet habbealim, af temura bevet habbealim: 
Memirin min habbakar al hatztzon umin hatztzon al habbakar, min hakkevasim al haizzim umin haizzim al hakkevasim, min hazzecharim al hannekevot umin hannekevot al hazzecharim, min hattemimim al baale mumin umibbaale mumin al hattemimim, shenneemar (sham), lo yachalifennu velo yamir oto tov bera o ra betov. ezehu tov bera, baale mumin shekkadam hekdeshan et mumam. memirim echad bishnayim ushenayim beechad, echad bemea umea beechad. rabbi shimon omer, en memirim ella echad beechad, shenneemar (Vayikra 27), vehaya hu utemurato, ma hu meyuchad, af temurato meyuchadet: 
En memirin evarim beubbarim velo ubbarim beevarim, velo evarim veubbarim bishlemim velo shelemim bahen. rabbi yose omer, memirim evarin bishlemim velo shelemim beevarin. amar rabbi yose, vahalo vemukdashin, haomer raglah shel zo ola, kullah ola, af kesheyyomar raglah shel zo tachat zo, tehe chullah temura tachteha:
Mishnah Temurah 1:4-2:1:
En hamedumma medammea ella lefi cheshbon. en hamechummatz mechammetz ella lefi cheshbon. en hammayim hashsheuvim poslin et hammikve ella lefi cheshbon: 
En me chattat naasin me chattat ella im mattan efer. en bet happeras ose vet happeras, velo teruma achar teruma, velo temura osa temura, velo havvalad ose temura. rabbi yehuda omer, havvalad ose temura. amru lo, hekdesh ose temura, lo havvalad velo temura osin temura: 
Haofot vehammenachot enan osin temura, shello neemar ella (Vayikra 27) bivhema. hatztzibbur vehashshuttafim enan osim temura, shenneemar (sham), lo yamir oto, yachid ose temura, lo hatztzibbur velo hashshuttafim osim temura. karbenot bedek habbayit enan osin temura. amar rabbi shimon, vahalo hammaaser bakkelal haya, velamma yatza, lehakish elav, ma maaser karban yachid, yatzu karbenot tzibbur. ma maaser karban mizbeach, yatzu karbenot bedek habbayit: 
Yesh bekarbenot hayyachid ma sheen bekarbenot hatztzibbur, veyesh bekarbenot hatztzibbur ma sheen bekarbenot hayyachid. shekkarbenot hayyachid osim temura, vekarbenot hatztzibbur enam osim temura. karbenot hayyachid nohagin bizcharim uvinkevot, vekarbenot tzibbur enan nohagin ella vizcharim. karbenot hayyachid chayyavin beacharayutan uveacharayut niskehem, vekarbenot hatztzibbur en chayyavin lo veacharayutan velo veacharayut niskehen, aval chayyavin beacharayut niskehen mishshekkarav hazzavach. yesh bekarbenot hatztzibbur ma sheen bekarbenot hayyachid. shekkarbenot hatztzibbur dochin et hashshabbat veet hattuma, vekarbenot hayyachid enan dochim lo et hashshabbat velo et hattuma. amar rabbi meir, vahalo chavitte chohen gadol ufar yom hakkippurim, karban yachid vedochin et hashshabbat veet hattuma. ella shezzemannan kavua:
Mishnah Temurah 2:2-3:2:
Chattat hayyachid shekkipperu vealav, metot. veshel tzibbur, enan metot. rabbi yehuda omer, yamutu. amar rabbi shimon, ma matzinu bivlad chattat uvitmurat chattat uvechattat shemmetu vealeha, beyachid devarim amurim aval lo vetzibbur, af shekkipperu habbealim vesheavra shenatan, beyachid devarim amurim aval lo vetzibbur: 
Chomer bekadashim mibbitmura uvitmura mibbekadashim. shehakkodashim osim temura veen temura osa temura. hatztzibbur vehashshuttafin makdishim, aval lo memirim. umakdishim evarim veubbarim, aval lo memirim. chomer bitmura, shehakkedushsha chala al baalat mum kavua, veenah yotza lechullin lehiggazez uleheaved. rabbi yose bar rabbi yehuda omer, asa shogeg kemezid battemura, velo asa shogeg kemezid bammukdashim. rabbi elazar omer, hakkilayim, vehatterefa, veyotze dofen, tumtum, veanderoginos, lo kedeshim velo makdishim: 
Ellu kadashim shevvaldotehen utemurotehen kayyotze vahen. velad shelamim, utemuratan, uveladan, uvelad veladan ad sof haolam, hare ellu chishlamim, uteunim semicha unesachim utenufa vechaze vashok. rabbi eliezer omer, velad shelamim lo yikrav shelamim. vachachamim omrim, yikrav. amar rabbi shimon, lo nechleku al velad velad shelamim veal velad velad temura, shello yikrav. veal ma nechleku, al havvalad, sherabbi eliezer omer, lo yikrav, vachachamim omrim, yikrav. heid rabbi yehoshua verabbi pappeyas al velad shelamim, sheyyikrav shelamim. amar rabbi pappeyas, ani meid, shehayta lanu fara zivche shelamim, vaachalnuha vefesach, veachalnu veladah shelamim bechag: 
Velad toda utemuratah, veladan uvelad veladan ad sof haolam, hare ellu chetoda, uvilvad sheenan teunin lachem. temurat ola, uvelad temura, veladan uvelad veladan ad sof haolam, hare ellu cheola, uteunin hefshet venittuach vechalil laishshim:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 3:8-10:
Tavshil chay shello bashel kelal o shebbashel kol tzarko umitztammek vera lo muttar lishhoto al gabbe haesh ben bechira vechuppach ben betannur. vechen kol tavshil shebbashel velo bashel kol tzarko o bashel kol tzarko umitztammek veyafe lo im hishlich letocho evar chay samuch leven hashshemashot naasa hakkol ketavshil chay umuttar lishhoto al haesh af al pi shello garaf velo kissa. mippene shekkevar hissiach dato mimmennu veeno ba lachtot bagechalim: 
Kol tavshil sheasur lishhoto im avar veshiha oto asur leachlo ad motzae shabbat veyamtin bichde sheyyeasu. veim shechacho. im tavshil shello bashel kol tzarko hu asur ad motzae shabbat. veim tavshil shebbashel kol tzarko hu umitztammek veyafe lo muttar leachlo miyyad beshabbat: 
Kol shemmuttar lishhoto al gabbe haesh keshennotlim oto beshabbat asur lehachaziro limkomo. veen machzirin leolam ella al gabbe kira gerufa o mechussa o bechira vechuppach shehusseku bekash ugevava. vehu shello hinniach hakkedera al gabbe hakkarka aval mishshehinnicha al gabbe karka en machzirin otah. vaafillu al gabbe kira gerufa o mechussa. veen machzirin lattannur velo lechuppach shehusseku begefet o beetzim af al pi sheggaraf o kissa mippene shehevlan cham beyoter. vechol sheen machzirin alav en somchin lo beshabbat:
Mishneh Torah, Torah Study 4:1-2: En melammedin tora ella letalmid hagun nae bemaasav. o letam. aval im haya holech bederech lo tova machzirin oto lammutav umanhigin oto bederech yeshara uvodkin oto veachar kach machnisin oto levet hammidrash umelammedin oto. amru chachamim kol hashshone letalmid sheeno hagun keillu zarak even lemarkulis shenneemar <small>(Mishlei 26 8)</small> "kitzror even bemargema ken noten lichsil kavod". veen kavod ella tora shenneemar <small>(Mishlei 3 la)</small> "kavod chachamim yinchalu". vechen harav sheeno holech bederech tova af al pi shechacham gadol hu vechol haam tzerichin lo en mitlammedin mimmennu ad shuvo lammutav. shenneemar <small>(Malachi b 7)</small> "ki sifte chohen yishmeru daat vetora yevakshu mippihu ki malach Adonai tzevaot hu". amru chachamim im harav dome lemalach Adonai tzevaot tora yevakkeshu mippihu im lav al yevakkeshu tora mippihu:

Ketzad melammedim. harav yoshev barosh vehattalmidim mukkafim lefanav kaatara kede sheyyehu kullam roim harav veshomim devarav. velo yeshev harav al hakkisse vetalmidav al hakkarka ella o hakkol al haaretz o hakkol al hakkisot. uvarishona haya harav yoshev vehattalmidim omdim umikkodem churban bayit sheni nahagu hakkol lelammed lattalmidim vehem yoshvim:
Mishneh Torah, Torah Study 4:3-4: Im haya melammed mippiv lattalmidim melammed. veim haya melammed al pi metargem [hametargem] omed beno uven hattalmidim veharav omer lamtargem vehametargem mashmia lechol hattalmidim. ucheshehem shoalin lamtargem hu shoel larav veharav meshiv lamtargem vehametargem meshiv lashshoel. velo yagbiah harav kolo yoter mikkol hametargem. velo yagbiah hametargem kolo beet sheshshoel et harav yoter mikkol harav. en hametargem rashshay lo lifchot velo lehosif velo leshannot ella im ken haya hameturgeman aviv shel chacham o rabbo. omer harav lamturgeman kach amar li rabbi o kach amar li abba mari. uchesheomer hameturgeman haddevarim laam omer beshem hechacham umazkir shemo shel avi harav o shel rabbo veomer kach amar rabbana peloni af al pi shello hizkir harav shemo shel chacham. sheasur likrot lerabbo o leaviv bishmo:

Harav shellimmed velo hevinu hattalmidim lo yichos alehem veyirgaz ella chozer veshone haddavar afillu kamma peamim ad sheyyavinu omek hahalacha. vechen lo yomar hattalmid hevanti vehu lo hevin ella chozer veshoel afillu kamma peamim. veim kaas alav rabbo veragaz yomar lo rabbi tora hi velilmod ani tzarich vedati ketzara:
Mishneh Torah, Torah Study 4:6-8: En shoalin et harav kesheyyikkanes lammidrash ad shettityashshev dato alav. veen hattalmid shoel kesheyyikkanes ad sheyyityashshev veyanuach. veen shoalin shenayim keechad. veen shoalin et harav meinyan acher ella meoto hainyan shehen asukin bo kede shello yitbayyesh. veyesh larav lehateot et hattalmidim bishelotav uvammaasim sheose bifnehem kede lechaddedan. uchede sheyyeda im zochrim hem ma shellimmedam o enam zochrim. veen tzarich lomar sheyyesh lo reshut lishl otam beinyan acher sheen oskin bo kede lezarzam:

En shoalin meummad veen meshivin meummad velo miggavoah velo merachok velo meachore hazzekenim. veen shoalin harav ella beinyan shehen korin bo. veen shoalin ella miyyira. velo yishal bainyan yoter mishshalosh halachot:

Shenayim sheshshaalu. shaal echad kainyan veshaal echad shello kainyan nizkakin lainyan. maase vesheeno maase nizkakin lammaase. halacha umidrash nizkakin lahalacha. midrash veaggada nizkakin lammidrash. aggada vekal vachomer nizkakin lakkal vachomer. kal vachomer ugezera shava nizkakin lakkal vachomer. hayu hashshoalin shenayim echad chacham veechad talmid nizkakin lechacham. talmid veam haaretz nizkakin lattalmid. shenehem chachamim shenehem talmidim shenehem amme haaretz shaalu shenehem bishte halachot o bishte teshuvot o bishte sheelot shene maasim. harshut beyad hametargem meatta:
Mishneh Torah, Torah Study 5:1-3:
Keshem sheadam metzuvve bichvod aviv veyirato kach hu chayyav bichvod rabbo veyirato yeter meaviv. sheaviv mevio lechayye haolam hazze verabbo shellimmedo chachma mevio lechayye haolam habba. raa avedat aviv vaavedat rabbo shel rabbo kodemet leshel aviv. aviv verabbo nosim bemassa meniach et shel rabbo veachar kach shel aviv. aviv verabbo shevuyim bashshivya pode et rabbo veachar kach pode et aviv. veim haya aviv talmid chacham pode et aviv techilla. vechen im haya aviv talmid chacham af al pi sheeno shakul keneged rabbo meshiv avedato veachar kach meshiv avedat rabbo. veen lecha kavod gadol mikkevod harav velo mora mimmora harav. amru chachamim <small>(mishna avot 4 12)</small> "mora rabbach kemora shamayim". lefichach amru kol hacholek al rabbo kecholek al hashshechina shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 26 9)</small> "behatztzotam al Adonai". vechol haose meriva im rabbo keose meriva im hashshechina shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 20 13)</small> "asher ravu vene yisrael et Adonai vayyikkadesh bam". vechol hammitraem al rabbo kemitraem al Adonai shenneemar <small>(Shemot 16 8)</small> "lo alenu telunotechem ki al Adonai". vechol hameharher achar rabbo keillu mehareher achar shechina shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 21 5)</small> "vaydabber haam belohim uvemshe":
Ezehu cholek al rabbo. ze shekkovea lo midrash veyoshev vedoresh umelammed shello birshut rabbo verabbo kayyam veaf al pi sherabbo bimdina acheret. veasur laadam lehorot bifne rabbo leolam. vechol hammore halacha bifne rabbo chayyav mita:
Haya beno uven rabbo shenem asar mil veshaal lo adam devar halacha muttar lehashiv. ulehafrish min haissur afillu bifne rabbo muttar lehorot. ketzad. kegon sheraa adam ose davar haasur mippene shello yada beissuro o mippene risho yesh lo lehaferisho velomar lo davar ze asur vaafillu bifne rabbo veaf al pi shello natan lo rabbo reshut. shekkol makom sheyyesh chillul hashshem en cholkin kavod larav. bamme devarim amurim. bedavar shennikra mikre. aval likboa atzmo lehoraa veleshev ulehorot lechol shoel afillu hu besof haolam verabbo besof haolam asur lo lehorot ad sheyyamut rabbo ella im ken natal reshut merabbo. velo kol mi shemmet rabbo muttar lo leshev ulehorot battora. ella im ken haya talmid shehiggia lehoraa:
Mishneh Torah, Torah Study 5:4-6:
Vechol talmid shello higgia lehoraa umore hare ze rasha shote vegas haruach. vealav neemar <small>(Mishlei 7 26)</small> "ki rabbim chalalim hippila" vegomer. vechen chacham shehiggia lehoraa veeno more hare ze monea tora venoten michsholot lifne haivverim vealav neemar <small>(Mishlei 7 26)</small> "vaatzumim kol harugeha". ellu hattalmidim hakketannim shello hirbu tora karauy vehem mevakkeshim lehitgaddel bifne amme haaretz uven anshe iram vekoftzin veyoshvin barosh ledin ulehorot beyisrael hem hammarbim hammachaloket vehem hammacharivim et haolam vehamechabbin nerah shel tora vehamechabbelim kerem Adonai tzevaot. alehem amar shelomo bechachmato <small>(Shir hashshirim b 15)</small> "echezu lanu shualim shualim ketannim mechabbelim keramim":
Veasur lo letalmid likrot lerabbo bishmo vaafillu shello befanav. vehu sheyyihye hashshem peli shekkol hashshomea yeda shehu peloni. velo yazkir shemo befanav vaafillu likrot laacherim sheshshemam keshem rabbo kederech sheose beshem aviv. ella yeshanne et shemam afillu leachar motam. velo yitten shalom lerabbo o yachazir lo shalom kederech shennotnim lereim umachazirim ze laze. ella shoche lefanav veomer lo beyira vechavod shalom alecha rabbi. veim natan lo rabbo shalom yachazir lo shalom alecha rabbi umori:
Vechen lo yachalotz tefillav lifne rabbo. velo yasev ella yoshev keyoshev lifne hammelech. velo yitpallel lo lifne rabbo velo leachar rabbo velo betzad rabbo. veen tzarich lomar sheasur lo lehallech betziddo. ella yitrachek leachar rabbo velo yehe mechavven keneged achorav veachar kach yitpallel. velo yikkanes im rabbo bammerchatz. velo yeshev bimkom rabbo. velo yachria devarav befanav. velo yistor et devarav. velo yeshev lefanav ad sheyyomar lo shev. velo yaamod millefanav ad sheyyomar lo amod o ad sheyyittol reshut laamod. uchesheyyippater merabbo lo yachazor lo laachorav ella nirta laachorav ufanav keneged panav:
Niddah 13b:17-20: Tanu rabbanan: kohen shote — matbilin oto, umaachilin oto teruma laerev, umeshammerin oto shello yishan. yashan — tame, lo yashan — tahor.
Rabbi eliezer berabbi tzadok omer: osin lo kis shel or. amru lo: kol shekken shemmevi lide chimmum! amar lahen: ledivrechem, shote en lo takkana.
Amru lo: lidvarenu — yashan tame, lo yashan tahor; lidvarecha — shemma yire tippa kechardal, vetibbala bakkis!
Tana mishshum rabbi elazar amru: osin lo kis shel mattechet.

Shabbat 118b:2-119a:4: Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: nitztzol mishshibud galiyyot. ketiv hacha: "vehirkavtich al bomote aretz", uchetiv hatam: "veatta al bamotemo tidroch". amar rav yehuda amar rav: kol hameanneg et hashshabbat notnin lo mishalot libbo, shenneemar: "vehitannag al Adonai veyitten lecha mishalot libbecha". oneg ze eni yodea mahu. keshehu omer "vekarata lashshabbat oneg" — heve omer ze oneg shabbat. bamme meannego? rav yehuda bereh derav shemuel bar shilat mishshemeh derav amar: betavshil shel teradin vedagim gedolim verashe shumin. rav chiyyay bar ashe amar rav: afillu davar muat, velichvod shabbat asao — hare ze oneg. may hi? amar rav pappa: kasa deharsana.

Amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: kol hameshammer shabbat kehilchato, afillu oved avoda zara [kedor] enosh — mochalin lo, shenneemar: "ashre enosh yaase zot vegomer mechallelo". al tikre "mechallelo" ella: "machul lo".

Amar rav yehuda amar rav: ilmale shamru yisrael shabbat rishona lo shalta bahen umma velashon, shenneemar: "vayhi bayyom hashshevii yatzu min haam lilkot", uchetiv batreh: "vayyavo amalek". amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: ilmale meshammerin yisrael shete shabbatot kehilchatan — miyyad nigalim, shenneemar: "cho amar Adonai lassarisim asher yishmeru et shabbetotay", uchetiv batreh: "vahaviotim el har kodshi vegomer".

Amar rabbi yose: yehe chelki meochle shalosh seudot bashshabbat. amar rabbi yose: yehe chelki miggomre hallel bechol yom. ini?! vehaamar mar: hakkore hallel bechol yom hare ze mecharef umegaddef! ki kaamrinan — bifsuke dezimra.

Amar rabbi yose: yehe chelki mimmitpallelim im dimdume chamma. amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: mitzva lehitpallel im dimdume chamma. amar rabbi zera, may kera: "yiraucha im shamesh velifne yareach dor dorim".

Veamar rabbi yose: yehe chelki mimmete becholi meayim, daamar mar: rubban shel tzaddikim metim becholi meayim. veamar rabbi yose: yehe chelki mimmete bederech mitzva. veamar rabbi yose: yehe chelki mimmachnise shabbat bitverya, umimmotzie shabbat betzippori. veamar rabbi yose: yehe chelki mimmoshive bet hammidrash, velo mimmaamide bet hammidrash.
Veamar rabbi yose: yehe chelki miggabbay tzedaka vela mimmechalleke tzedaka. veamar rabbi yose: yehe chelki mimmi shechoshdin oto veen bo. amar rav pappa: ledidi chashdun vela hava bi.

Amar rabbi yose: chamesh beilot baalti, venatati chamishsha arazim beyisrael. uman innun — rabbi yishmael berabbi yose, verabbi elazar berabbi yose, verabbi chalafta berabbi yose, verabbi avtilas berabbi yose, verabbi menachem berabbi yose. vehaikka vardimas! hayeynu vardimas hayeynu menachem, veammay kare leh "vardimas"? — sheppanav domin levered. lememra derabbi yose mitzvat ona lo kiyyem?! ella ema: chamesh beilot baalti veshaniti.
Amar rabbi yose: miyyamay lo kariti leishti "ishti" uleshori "shori", ella leishti — "beti", uleshori — "sadi".

Amar rabbi yose: miyyamay lo nistakkalti bammilla shelli. ini? vehaamaru leh lerabbi: may tama karu lach rabbenu hakkadosh? amar lehu: miyyamay lo nistakkalti bammilla shelli. berabbi milleta achariti hava beh, shello hichnis yado tachat avneto. veamar rabbi yose: miyyamay lo rau korot beti imre chaluki.

Veamar rabbi yose: miyyamay lo avarti al divre chaveray. yodea ani beatzmi sheeni kohen, im omrim li chaveray: ale ladduchan — ani ole. veamar rabbi yose: miyyamay lo amarti davar vechazarti laachoray.

Amar rav nachman: tete li, dekayyemit shalosh seudot beshabbat. amar rav yehuda: tete li, dekayyemit iyyun tefilla. amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: tete li, dela sagena arba ammot begilluy harosh. amar rav sheshet: tete li, dekayyemit mitzvat tefillin. veamar rav nachman: tete li, dekayyemit mitzvat tzitzit.

Amar leh rav yosef lerav yosef bereh derabba: avuch, bemay zehir tefe? amar leh: betzitzit. yoma chad hava ka salek bedarga. ippesik leh chuta, vela nechet vaata, kamma dela ramya. veamar abbaye: tete li, dechi chazena tzureba merabbanan dishlim massechteh

Avedna yoma tava lerabbanan. amar rava tete li, dechi ata tzureba merabbanan lekammay ledina, la mazegna reshi abbe sadya kamma dela mehappechna bezachuteh. amar mar bar rav ashe: pesilna leh letzureba merabbanan ledina. may tama? — dechabbiv alay kegufay, veen adam roe chova leatzmo.

Rabbi chanina miatef vekae appanya demaale shabbeta, amar: "bou venetze likrat shabbat hammalka". rabbi yannay lavesh mane mealleye (shabbat) [umikkasse], veamar: "boi challa, boi challa". rabba bar rav huna ikkela leve rabba bar rav nachman. karivu leh telat save tachye. amar lehu: mi hava yaditun deatena? amaru leh: mi adifat lan minna?

Rabbi abba zaven bitlesar istire peshite bisra mittelesar tabbache, umeshallem lehu atztzinnora dedashsha, vaamar lehu: "ashshur hayyay, ashshur hayyay". rabbi avahu hava yatev attachtaka deshinna umoshef nura. rav anan lavesh guneda, detana deve rabbi yishmael: begadim shebbishshel bahen kedera lerabbo — al yimzog bahen kos lerabbo.

Rav safra mecharech resha. rava malach shibbuta. rav huna madlek sherage. rav pappa gadel petilata. rav chisda parem silka. rabba verav yosef metzallechi tzive. rabbi zera metzattet tzattote. rav nachman bar yitzchak mechattef veayel, mechattef venafek. amar: illu mikkalin li rabbi amme verabbi assi, mi la mechattefna kammayyhu? veikka deamri: rabbi amme verabbi assi mechattefi veayyli, mechattefi venafki, amri: illu ikkela lan rabbi yochanan, mi la mechattefinan kammeh?!
Yevamot 6a:10-6b:3: Vechi tema, shane lave deshabbat dachamiri — veha tanna bealma kae, vela ka farech! detanya, yachol amar lo aviv: hittamme, o sheamar lo: al tachzir, yachol yishma lo — talmud lomar: "ish immo veaviv tirau vegomer" — kullechem chayyayvim bichvodi.
Ella, mishshum deikka lemifrach: ma lehanach shekken hechsher mitzva. hechsher mitzva tippok li mehatam?

In hachi name. veet shabbetotay tishmoru umikdashi tirau" lema li? mibbee leh, lechidtanya: yachol yityayre adam mimmikdash, talmud lomar: "et shabbetotay tishmoru veet mikdashi tirau". neemra shemira bashshabbat, veneemra mora bammikdash. ma shemira haamura bashshabbat —
Lo mishshabbat atta mityayre, ella mimmi shehizhir al hashshabbat, af mora haamura bammikdash — lo mimmikdash atta mityayre, ella mimmi shehizhir al hammikdash.
Vee zo hi mora mikdash? lo yikkanes adam behar habbayit bemaklo, beminalo, befunedato, uveavak sheal gabbe raglav, velo yaasennu kappandarya. urekika mikkal vachomer.

Veen li ella bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyaym, bizman sheen bet hammikdash kayyaym — minnayin? talmud lomar: "et shabbetotay tishmoru umikdashi tirau". ma shemira haamura beshabbat — leolam, af mora haamura bammikdash — leolam.
Zevachim 88a:14-88b:4: Tanu rabbanan: kele kodesh shennikkevu – en mattichin otan, veen mattichin letochan avar. nifgemu – en metakkenin otan. sakkin shennifgema – en mashchizin et pegimatah. nishmeta – en machzirin otah. abba shaul omer: sakkin matrefet hayta bammikdash, venimnu aleha kohanim ugenazuha.
Tanu rabbanan: bigde chehunna, en osin otam maase machat ella maase oreg, shenneemar: "maase oreg". nitgaalu, en mechabbesin [otan] lo beneter velo beahal.
Ha bammayim – mechabbesin?! amar abbaye, hachi kaamar: huggeu bemayim – mechabbesin otan beneter veahal;
Huggeu leneter veahal – af bemayim en mechabbesim. veyesh omrim: en mechabbesin otan kol ikkar, sheen aniyyut bimkom ashirut.

Tanu rabbanan: meil – kullo shel techelet haya, shenneemar: "vayyaas et meil haefod kelil techelet". shulav ketzad? mevi techelet veargaman vetolaat shani shezurin, veose otan kemin rimmonim shello pittechu pihen, uchemin konaot shel kenasot shebberashe tinokot.

Umevi shivim ushenayim zaggin shebbahen shivim ushenayim inbalin, vetole bahen sheloshim veshishsha betzad ze usheloshim veshishsha mitztzad ze. rabbi dosa omer mishshum rabbi yehuda: sheloshim veshishsha hayu – shemone esre mitztzad ze ushemone esre mitztzad ze.
Amar rabbi inyoni bar sason: kemachloket kan kach machloket bemarot negaim, ditnan: marot negaim – rabbi dosa ben harekinas omer: sheloshim veshishsha, akavya ben mahalalel omer: shivim ushenayim.
Zohar, Beshalach 7: (Shemot 14:14) Adonai yillachem lachem veattem tacharishun. ribbi abba patach (Yeshayahu 58:13) im tashiv mishshabbat raglecha asot chafatzecha beyom kadshi. zakkain innun yisrael, dekudesha berich hu itrae behon, leitdabbeka behu, mikkol shear ammin dealma, umiggo rechimuta dilhon, kariv lon legabbeh, veyahav lon orayyta, veyahav lon shabbat, deihu kaddisha mikkol shear yomin, venayycha mikkolla, vechedva decholla, veshakil shabbat, lokovel orayyta kella, uman denatir shabbat, keillu natir orayyta kulla.

Vekarata lashshabbat oneg, innuga decholla, innuga denafsha vegufa innuga deillain vetattain. vekarata lashshabbat, may vekarata. deyazmin leh. kema deat amer, (Vayikra 23:2) mikrae kodesh, kelomar, zeminin, kema dimzammin ushepiza leveteh. veal da vekarata lashshabbat oneg, deyazmin leh, kema dimzamnin ushepiza, befatora metakkena, beveta metakkena kedka yeot, bemechla uvemishteya kedka yeot, yattir al shear yomin. vekarata lashshabbat mibbeod yom. (emor 22 amud alef) likdosh Adonai mechubbad: da yom kippurim. tere deinnun chad. vechibbadto measot derachecha, kema deokimna.
Mimmetzo cheftzecha vedabber davar, veha ittemar, begin dehahi milla salleka, veittear milla dechol leella. man dimzammin ushepiza, beh bae leishtaddela, vela baochora.

Ta chaziyi hahu milla denafik mippumeh devar nash, salleka veittear itaruta leella, i letav, i levish. uman deyativ beinnuga deshabbeta, asir leh leitteara milla (43 2) dechol, deha pagim pegimu beyoma kaddisha. man deyativ behillula demalka, la yitchaze lemishbak lemalka, veyitassek beachara.
Uvechol yoma bae leachazaa ovada, uleitara ataruta mimma deitzterich. uveshabbat, bemille dishmayya, uvikdushsha deyoma bae leitteara, vela bemilla achara.

Ta chaze, hacha kad itkeriv paro leaggacha kerava behu beyisrael, behahi zimna, la bae kudesha berich hu, deyittearun yisrael itaruta letatta kelal, deha itaruta leella hu, deha avahan akdimu veattearu itaruta da leella, uzechuta dilhon kaim kameh, (veattearu itaruta da) vela baa kudesha berich hu deyisrael yittearun letatta kelal. (deha beatrah leella hava) hada hu dichtiv Adonai yillachem lachem veattem tacharishun. tacharishun vadday, vela titarun milla, dela itzterich lechu, vehacha itkelil shema kaddisha beatvavn reshiman, veha itaru beh chavrayyay.

Ribbi yose veribbi yehuda havo azle bearcha. amar ribbi yose leribbi yehuda, vadday tannina, Adonai, bechol atar rachame, veaf al gav deaggach kerava, veavid dina, hahu dina birchimuta hu. vehacha chamena, dichtiv Adonai yillachem lachem, vela itchaze behahu dina rachame kelal, deha ketiv lo nishar bahem ad echad.

Amar leh, milla da shemana meribbi shimon deamar, deafillu hacha dina berachame hava, dechafa alehon yamma umitu, ulevatar appik lon yamma, vekudesha berich hu baa bikarehon, veitkevaru beara, vela baat ara lekabbela lon, ad deoshit lah kudesha berich hu yemineh, vekabbilat lon, hada hu dichtiv, (Shemot 15:12) natita yemincha tivlaemo aretz. uvegin da, (hava) hay dina berachame hava.

Veal da, la baa kudesha berich hu deyittearun yisrael milla bealma, dei yitarun yisrael milla, la yitarun shema derachame, vela yitavid dina berachame, hada hu dichtiv Adonai yillachem lachem veattem tacharishun, dela titarun midi. deha shema derachame bae leitteara alayyhu, lemebad dina berachame. veal da bae, dela taavdun pegimu, vetitarun milla achara.

Amar leh, veha ketiv, (zecharya 14:3) veyatza Adonai venilcham baggoyim hahem. i hachi da dina berachame hava. amar leh, hachi hava vadday, dina hu berachame, demota dilhon la ishtechach kemotana dishar bene alma, ella chas alayyhu kudesha berich hu, dela yehon kemotana dishar bene alma, dekatilu lon, ella benachat belo tzaara, ha dina berachame ihu.

Uvechol atar, shema da, dina berachame ihu, bar atar chad, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 42:13) Adonai kagibbor yetze vegomer. vechi kagibbor velo gibbor. ella yeshanne levushoy, veyilbash levushin acharanin. keish milchamot, yeshanne zineh.

Veim kol da, dina hu yattir, aval rachame beh, kema dichtiv, kagibbor, velo gibbor. keish milchamot, velo ish milchamot. devadday af al gav deavid dina, chas al ovadoy, veal da, Adonai yillachem lachem vadday veattem tacharishun. zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael, dekudesha berich hu barir lon lechulakeh veachasanteh, dichtiv, (Devarim 32:9) ki chelek Adonai ammo yaakov chevel nachalato.
Zohar, Vayeshev 1: Vayyeshev yaakov beeretz megure aviv beeretz kenaan. ribbi chiyyay patach veamar, (tehillim la) rabbot raot tzaddik umikkullam yatztzilenu Adonai. ta chaze, kamma mekatregin it leh levar nash miyyoma dekudesha berich hu yahav beh nishmata (davar acher 33 levar nash) (leitkayyeyma) behay alma. dechevan denafik var nash laavira dealma, miyyad izdamman leishtattefa bahadeh yetzer hara kema deittemar. dichtiv, (Bereshit 4:7) lappetach chattat rovetz vegomer. ucheden ishtattaf bahadeh yetzer hara.

Veta chaze, dehachi hu, deha beire miyyoma deityallidu, kullehu natre garmayyhu, vearkin min go nura, umin kol atrin bishin. uvar nash, miyyad ate laarama garmeh go nura, begin deyetzer hara share begavvih, umiyyad aste leh learcha visha.

Veokimna dichtiv, (Kohelet 4:13) tov yeled misken vechacham mimmelech zaken uchesil asher lo yada lehizzaher od. tov yeled, da hu yetzer tov dehu yeled miyyomin zeirin immeh devar nash, deha mittelesar shenin vaelach (immeh) kema deittemar.

Mimmelecha zaken uchesil. mimmelech, da hu yetzer hara deihu ikre melech veshallit bealma al bene nasha. zaken uchesil, deihu zaken vadday, kema deukemuha, dechad ityelid var nash venafik laavira dealma ihu izdamman immeh devar nash. veal da ihu melech zaken uchesil.

Asher lo yada lehizzaher od, lehazehir la ketiv, ella lehizzaher, begin deihu chesil. vealeh amar shelomo alav hashalom (Kohelet 2:14) vehakkesil bachoshech holech. deha messusita dechoshech ka atya velet leh nehora lealmin.

Ribbi shimon amar, ta chaze, ketiv tov yeled misken vechacham. man yeled misken, ha ukemuha veittemar deihu yetzer tov. aval tov yeled, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 37:25) naar hayiti gam zakanti. veda hu naar deihu yeled misken delet leh miggarmeh kelum. veammay ikre naar, begin deit leh chadtu desihara demitchaddesha tadir, vetadir ihu yeled misken kema deamran. vechacham, begin dechachma sharya beh.

Mimmelecha zaken, da hu yetzer hara kema deittemar. deha min yoma dehava la nafak mimmesaavuteh lealmin, veihu chesil. dechol archoy inun leorach bisha, veazil vesate livni nasha vela yada leizdahara. veihu ate im var nash betiskufin begin leastaa lon meorach tava leorach bisha.

Ta chaze, al da akdim im bar nash beyoma deityelid begin diyhemin leh. deha kad ate yetzer tov la yachil var nash limhemna leh vedame aleh kematula. kegavvna da taninan, man hu rasha arum, da hu man deakdim leatana milloy lekamme dayyna ad la yete chavreh mare dedina. kema deat amer, (Mishlei 18:17) tzaddik harishon berivo vegomer.

Kegavvna da (hu nusach acher hay) rasha arum, kema deat amer, (Bereshit 3:1) vehannachash haya arum. vehu akdim veshare immeh devar nash ad la yete chavreh leashraa aleh. uvegin deihu akdim veha atin taanateh immeh, kad ate chavreh deihu yetzer hattov, avish leh levar nash bahadeh vela yachil lezakfa resheh, keillu atin al kitfeh kol matolin dealma. begin hahu rasha arum deakdim immeh. veal da amar shelomo (Kohelet 9:16) vechachmat hammisken bezuya udevarav enam nishmaim, begin deha akdim ochora.

Veal da kol dayyne dekabbil mibbar nash milla ad la yete chavreh, keillu mekabbel aleh taavav ochora limhemnuta. ella (Mishlei 18:17) uva reehu vachakaro, veda hu orach devar nash zakkaa, deha var nash zakkaa da hu, dela hemin lehahu rasha arum deyetzer hara, ad deyete chavreh deihu yetzer tov. uvegin da bene nasha inun kashlin lealma deate.

Aval hahu zakkaa deihu dachil lemareh, kamma bishin savil behay alma begin dela yehemin vela yishtattaf behahu yetzer hara. vekudesha berich hu sheziv leh mikkullehu, hada hu dichtiv, (tehillim la) rabbot raot tzaddik umikkullam yatztzilenu Adonai. rabbot raot latztzaddik la ketiv, ella tzaddik. begin dekudesha berich hu itrae beh. uvegin kach kudesha berich hu itrae behahu var nash vesheziv leh mikkolla behay alma uvealma deate, zakkaa chulakeh.

Ta chaze, kamma bishin avru aleh deyaakov, begin dela yitdabbak behahu yetzer hara veyitrechak mechulakeh. uvegin kach savil kamma onshin kamma bishin vela shakit. patach veamar, (iyyov 3:26) lo shalavti velo shakatti velo nachti vayyavo rogez. ta chaze, kamma bishin savlin tzaddikaya behay alma. bishin al bishin, keevin al keevin. begin lemizke lon lealma deate.

Yaakov kamma savil bishin al bishin tadir, kema deat amer lo shalavti, beveta delavan, vela yachilna leishtezava minneh. velo shakatti, meesav. mehahu tzaara detzier li hahu memanna dileh, ulevatar dechilu deesav. velo nachti, min dina umin shechem.

Vayyavo rogez, da rugeza veirbuveya deyosef deihu kashya mikkullehu, miggo rechimuta deyaakov legabbe deyosef deihu raza divrit, al bemitzrayim. begin dilvatar ketiv, (Shemot 6:Adonai) vaezkor et beriti, leishtakkacha shechinta (nusach acher shemesh) tamman bahadeh.

Vayyeshev yaakov beeretz megure aviv beeretz kenaan, ribbi yose patach, (Yeshayahu 57:1) hatztzaddik avad veen ish sam al lev veanshe chesed neesafim been mevin ki mippene haraa neesaf hatztzaddik. hatztzaddik avad, bezimna dekudesha berich hu ashgach bealma vela have alma kedka yeut, veizdamman dina lesharyay al alma. keden kudesha berich hu natil zakkaa deishtakkach benayyhu, begin deyishre dina al kullehu ochoranin, vela yishtakkach man deyagin alayyhu.

Deha kol zimna dezakkaa share bealma, dina la yachil leshaltaa al alma. menalan mimmoshe, dichtiv, (Tehillim 106:23) vayyomer lehashemidam lule moshe vechiro amad bapperetz lefanav vegomer. uvegin kach kudesha berich hu natil lezakkaa mibbenayyhu vesallik leh mealma, ucheden itpera vegave dileh. sofeh dikra, ki mippene haraa neesaf hatztzaddik. ad dela yete raa leshaltaa al alma neesaf hatztzaddik. (davar acher ki mippene haraa neesaf ad lo yishlot haraa bealma) davar acher ki mippene haraa, da yetzer hara.
Ta chaze, yaakov shelimu daavahan hava veihu kaim lekayyma begaluta. aval miggo deihu tzaddik itakkav dina dela shalta bealma. deha kol yome deyaakov la shara dina al alma, vechafna itbatlat.

Veuf hachi beyomoy deyosef deihu diukena deavoy (kevan deihu met miyyad). la shera galuta (dina al alma). begin deihu agin alayyhu kol yomoy, kevan deihu met, miyyad shara alayyhu galuta. kema deat amer (Shemot 1:14) vayyamat yosef vegomer, vesamich leh hava nitchakkema lo. uchetiv vaymararu et chayyehem baavoda kasha bechomer uvilvenim vegomer.
Kegavvna da bechol atar desharya zakkaa (al) bealma begineh kudesha berich hu yagin al alma, vechol zimna deihu kayyaym, dina la sharya al alma veha ittemar.

Ta chaze, vayyeshev yaakov beeretz megure aviv, may megure aviv, kema deat amer, (Yirmeyahu 6:25) magor misaviv, dechol yomoy hava dachil vehava bidchilu: vayyeshev yaakov beeretz megure aviv. ribbi elazar amar, deitkashshar veyativ behahu atar deitachid bachoshech. eretz megure aviv dayyka, beeretz kenaan, itkashshar atra beatreh. megure aviv, da dina kashya. beeretz megure aviv, kema deittemar hahu dina rafya deihi eretz, deitachid min dina kashya uveh ityashshev yaakov veitachid beh, (vehahi eretz ihi aspaklarya dela nahara):
Zohar, Vayishlach 1: Vayyishlach yaakov malachim vegomer. ribbi yehuda patach (Tehillim 91:11) ki malachav yetzavve lach lishmarcha bechol derachecha, hay kera ukemuha chavrayay, deha beshata devar nash ate lealma, miyyad izdamman bahadeh yetzer hara deihu mekatreg leh levar nash tadir kema deat amer, (Bereshit 4:7) lappetach chattat rovetz. may chattat rovetz, da yetzer hara.

Vedavid hachi name karyeh chattat dichtiv, (Tehillim 51:5) vechattati negdi tamid, begin deihu avid leh levar nash kol yoma lemechote kamme mareh, veyetzer hara da la itade mibbar nash miyyoma deityelid bar nash lealmin. veyetzer hattov ate levar nash miyyoma deate leitdakkaa.

Veematay ate bar nash leitdakkaa kad ihu bar telesar shenin, keden izdavvavg bar nash betarvavyyhu chad mimina vechad missemala, yetzer tov limina veyetzer ra lismala. veillen inun teren malachin mammash memannan, veinun mishtakkechin tadir bahadeh devar nash.

Ate var nash leitdakkaa, hahu yetzer hara itkafya kammeh veshallit yemina al semala. vetarvavyyhu mizdavvevgin lenatra leh levar nash bechol archoy dehu avid. hada hu dichtiv ki malachav yetzavve lach lishmarcha bechol derachecha.

Ribbi elazar mokim leh lehay kera beyaakov, dekudesha berich hu azmin bahadeh malachin mashshiryayn memannan. begin deha ihu ate shelim beshivtin illain kullehu shelemin kedka yeut, kema deittemar (dichtiv) veyaakov halach ledarko vayyifgeu vo malache elohim veittemar. vehacha kevan deishteziv minneh delavan veha itperash minneh keden izdavvevgat immeh shechinta veatu mashshiryayn kaddishin lesachara leh, ucheden vayyomer yaakov kaasher raam vegomer. umeinun malachin shaddar leh leesav hada hu dichtiv vayyishlach yaakov malachim, malachim mammash havu vadday.

Patach ribbi yitzchak veamar ketiv, (Tehillim 35:5) chone malach Adonai saviv lireav vaychalletzem, ha ukemuha. aval beatar chad ketiv ki malachav yetzavve lach, malachav saggiin, vehacha chad dichtiv chone malach Adonai saviv lireav vaychalletzem. ella ki malachav yetzavve lach, illen shear malachin. malach Adonai saviv da shechinta, kema deat amer, (Shemot 3:2) vayyera malach Adonai elav belabbat esh mittoch hassene. uvegin kach chone malach Adonai saviv lireav, laakafa leh bechol sitrin begin leshezava leh. vechad shechinta sharya begavveh devar nash, kamma mashshiryayn kaddishin kullehu izdammenu letamman.

Ta chaze, kad david malka ishteziv meachish melech gat keden amar hay, begin dishchinta sachara leh veishteziv minnayyhu meachish umeammeh kol inun deatkifu (nusach acher daakaypav) beh, ma ketiv, (Shmuel 1 21:14) vayyitholel beyadam, ammay vayyitholel, vayyishtaggea mibbae leh, kema deat amer, (sham) ki hevetem et ze lehishtaggea alay.

Ella ahadar al hahu milla deamar david bekadmita dichtiv, (Tehillim 73:3) ki kinneti bahollim vegomer. amar leh kudesha berich hu chayyecha adayin ant itzterich lehay, kevan deal leve achish veatkifu beh, ma ketiv vayyitholel beyadam, keinun hollim dekanne bekadmita, ucheden atya shechinta vesharya sacharaneh dedavid.

Vei tema shechinta la sharya ella (baachasenateh) beachsanteh, deihi ara kaddisha. vadday la sharya begin (deyankin) linaka minnah, aval laagana sharya. vehacha kad ata yaakov mibbe lavan kullehu mashshiryayn kaddishin sacharan leh vela ishtaar bilchodoy.

Amar ribbi chizkiya i hachi (sefer acher dechullehu mashshiryayn kaddishin oto bahehah ushechinta bahadeh), ammay ketiv vayyivvater yaakov levaddo vegomer. amar ribbi yehuda begin deail garmeh lesakkana, vehava chame lehahi sakkana beenoy, inun itparshu minneh, ucheden amar katonti mikkol hachasadim umikkol haemet, illen inun mashshiryayn kaddishin deitparshu minneh.

Ribbi yitzchak amar begin leshavka leh im hahu memanna deesav devirshuta illaa hava ate. veillen azle lememar shirata demata zimnayyhu leshabbacha leh lekudesha berich hu behahi shata, ulevatar ahadaru, hada hu dichtiv katonti mikkol hachasadim umikkol haemet asher asita et avdecha vegomer, veatta hayiti lishne machanot. machane shechinta, vechol beteh, (sefer acher machane chad hava dichtiv machane elohim ze), lishni machanot, dehava shelim michol sitrin mitteren chulakin chivvavr vesumak.

Ribbi elazar amar, ha ittemar, hahu lelya shuletanuta desitra deesav hava. behahi shata deha ketiv (Bereshit 1:14) yehi meorot chaser, uvegin kach vayyivvater yaakov levaddo, deishtaar yaakov deihu shimsha bilchodoy, deitkasya sihara min shimsha. veaf al gav dintiru (sefer acher veim kol da netiru) dekudesha berich hu la itade minneh mikkol vachol, veal da lo yachol lo, dichtiv vayyar ki lo yachol lo.

Istakkal limina vechama leavraham. istakkal lismala vechama leyitzchak. istakkal begufa vechama deitkelil missitra da veitkelil missitra da, keden vayyiga bechaf yerecho. bechad ammuda desamich legufa deihu levar min gufa.

Uvegin kach chone malach Adonai saviv lireav vaychalletzem, akkif leh bechol sitroy begin leshezava leh, vechad shara shechinta begavveh (sefer acher legabbeh) kamma chelin umashshiryayn atu bahadeh, umeinun malachin shaddar legabbeh deesav:

Vayyishlach yaakov malachim, amar ribbi abba vechi ammay itar ihu legabbeh deesav, vetav hava leh leishtuke minneh. ella amar yaakov yedana deesav chayyish leh likara deabba ulealam la argiz kammeh, veha yedana hoil veabba kayyaym la mistafina minneh, aval hasheta (hoil deabba kaim beena laatapeyys (leitpayysa)) immeh, miyyad vayyishlach yaakov malachim lefanav.

Vayyishlach yaakov malachim. ribbi shimon patach veamar, (Mishlei 12:9) tov nikla veeved lo mimmitkabbed vachasar lechem, hay kera al yetzer hara ittemar, begin deihu mekatrega tadir legabbe bene nasha, veyetzer hara ihu arim libbeh ureuteh devar nash begaavata veazil avatreh mesalsel saareh uveresheh ad deihu itgae aleh umashich leh laggehinnom.

Aval tov nikla, hahu dela azil avatreh deyetzer hara vela itgae kelal umaich rucheh velibbeh ureuteh legabbe kudesha berich hu, ucheden hahu yetzer hara mithappech leeved lo, dela yachil leshaltaa aloy, vehahu bar nash shallit aloy kema deat amer, (Bereshit 4:7) veatta timshal bo.

Mimmitkabbed, kema deamaran deihu okir garmeh mesalsel besaareh itgae berucheh, veihu chasar lechem, chasar mehemnuta kema deat amer, (Vayikra 21:17) lechem elohav vegomer (Vayikra 21:6) lechem elohehem hem makrivim vegomer.

Davar acher tov nikla (vaavad lo), da yaakov demaich rucheh legabbeh deesav. begin dilvatar leheve eved lo veyishlot aloy veyitkayyaym beh (Bereshit 27:29) yaavducha ammim veyishtachavu lecha leumim vegomer, vaadayin la hava zimneh kelal. ella begin desalik leh yaakov levatar yomaya, veal da hava miyyad nikla. ulevatar hahu deihu mitkabbed yehe eved lo, hahu deihu chasar lechem yehe avda lehahu deyahavu leh rov dagan vetirosh.

Ta chaze, al da begin deyada yaakov deitzterich leh, hasheta ithappach leh nikla. veyoter chachma vaakimu avad beda, mikkol ma deavad legabbe deesav. deilu hava yada esav chachma da yiktil leh legarmeh vela yete leda, aval kolla avad bechachmeta, vealeh amra channa (Shmuel 1 2:10) Adonai yechattu merivav vegomer veyitten oz lemalko vegomer:
Zohar, Vayishlach 2: Vaytzav otam lemor ko tomrun ladoni leesav ko amar avdecha yaakov im lavan garti vaechar ad atta. miyyad patach yaakov leithappacha leh leavda, begin dela yistakkal esav beinun birchan devarcheh avoy, deha yaakov salik lon levatar kedka amaran.

Amar ribbi yehuda may chama yaakov deshaddar leh leesav veamar im lavan garti, vechi ma avid bishlichuteh deesav (deamar) milla da. ella lavan haarammi kaleh azil bealma dela hava var nash deyishteziv minneh, dehu hava charash bechorashin verav bekosmin, vaavoy divor hava, uveor avoy devilam, dichtiv (yehoshua 13:22) bilam ben beor hakkosem, velavan chacham bechorashin vekosmin yattir mikkullehu, veim kol da la yachil beyaakov. uvaa leovada leyaakov bechamma zayynin hada hu dichtiv, (Devarim 26:5) arammi oved avi.

Amar ribbi abba kule alma have yade delavan hava rav chakkimin vochorashin vekosmin, uman devae leovada bechorashoy la ishteziv minneh, vechol ma deyada bilam minneh hava. uchetiv beh bevilam (Bamidbar 22:6) ki yadati et asher tevarech mevorach vaasher taor yuar. vechule alma havu mistafe millavan umechorashoy, umilla kadmaa deshaddar yaakov leesav amar im lavan garti. vei tema dizer hava yerach o shatta. lav hachi, ella vaechar ad atta, esrin shenin itacharit immeh.

Vei tema dela salik beyadi kelum. vayhi li shor vachamor, inun teren gizre dinin, dechad mitchabberan tarvavyyhu kechada, la mitchabberan ela leavasha alma. uvegin kach ketiv, (Devarim 22:10) lo tacharosh beshor uvachamor yachdav.

Tzon veeved veshifcha, ilen inun kitre tattae dekatal kudesha berich hu bemitzrayim (Shemot 12:29) bechor behema (Shemot 12:29) bechor hashshevi (Shemot 11:5) bechor hashshifcha, hada hu dichtiv tzon veeved veshifcha. miyyad mistafe hava esav venafak lokodamuteh, udechilu hava leh miyyaakov kema dehava leh leyaakov meesav.

Levar nash dehava azil bearcha, ad dehava azil shama al chad listim dehava kaman bearcha, paga beh var nash ochora. amar leh mimman ant, amar leh mippeloni ligyon ana, amar leh sete lach miggabbay dechol man dekariv bahaday chad chivya ana mayyte vekatil leh. azal hahu var nash lehahu ligyon, amar leh chad var nash ate vechol man di kariv bahadeh nashcheh chad chivya dehu mayyte umayet.

Shama hahu ligyon vedachil, amar yaot deezil lekovleh veitpayes bahadeh. ad dechama leh hahu var nash, amar, vavy dehashta yikteleneh hahu ligyon. share sagid vechara lekovleh. amar hahu ligyon, ilmale hava leh bideh chivya lekatla, la segid kulay hay lekovli. share ligyonaa leitgaa, amar, hoil vechol kach kara lekivli la ektelineh.

Kacha amar yaakov im lavan garti vaechar ad atta, esrin shenin itacharit immeh veana mayyte chivya lekatla beni nasha. shema esav, amar, vavy man yakum kammeh. dehashta yiktelineh yaakov befumeh, share nafik lokodamuteh leitpayysa immeh.

Kevan dechama leh ma ketiv vayyira yaakov meod vayyetzer lo, kevan dekariv bahadeh share kara vesagid lekovleh. hada hu dichtiv vayyishtachu artza sheva peamim ad gishto ad achiv. amar esav ilmale kol kach hava immeh, la segid lekivli, share leitgaa.

Ta chaze, ma ketiv bevilam (Bamidbar 22:20) vayyavo elohim el bilam layla. belavan ketiv (Bereshit 31:24) vayyavo elohim el lavan haarammi bachalom hallayla vayyomer lo hishshamer lecha pen tedabber im yaakov mittov vegomer. pen tedabber, pen taase leyaakov raa mibbae leh. ella lavan la radaf avatreh deyaakov bechela deguverin laagacha beh kerava. deha chela deyaakov uvenoy rav minneh, ella lemikteleh befumeh uleshetzaa kolla. hada hu dichtiv arammi oved avi. uvegin kach pen tedabber, vela ketiv pen taase. uchetiv yesh leel yadi laasot. minnayin hava yada diycholta hava bideh. ella kema deittemar elohe avichem emesh amar elay vegomer.

Veda hu sahaduta, depakkid kudesha berich hu leashada. dichtiv (Devarim 26:5) veanita veamarta lifne Adonai elohecha arammi oved avi vegomer. veanita, kema deat amer, (Shemot 20:13) lo taane vereacha. (Devarim 19:18) ana veachiv.

Ketiv beh bevilam (Bamidbar 24:1) velo halach chefaam befaam likrat nechashim, dehachi hu archeh deihu hava menachesh. belavan ketiv, (Bereshit 30) nichashti, deashgach bacharashoy uviksamoy beiska deyaakov, vechad baa leovada leyaakov binchasha uvacharasha dileh baa leovadeh, vela shavkeh kudesha berich hu.

Vehayeynu deamar bilam bar bereh (Bamidbar 23:23) ki lo nachash beyaakov velo kesem beyisrael, man yachil lehon, deha savay baa leovada laavuhon binchashim uviksamim dileh vela selika bidoy. dela shavkeh lelatya. hada hu dichtiv ki lo nachash beyaakov velo kesem beyisrael.

Uvechullehu asara zine chorashin vekosmin dekuzetfe dechitrin tattain avad lavan lekovleh deyaakov vela yachil. hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 31:41) vattachlef et maskurti aseret monim. dechullehu avad lavan lekovleh vela seliku bidoy leavasha leh, dichtiv, (Bereshit 31:7) vehecholif et maskurti aseret monim velo netano elohim lehara immadi. may monim, ketargum zinin, uchetiv (Vayikra 17:7) lasseirim asher hem zonim acharehem. monim, minim kemashmao. vaasara zinin inun decharashin vekosmin bechitrin tattain vechullehu avad lekovleh.
Asara zinin inun, dichtiv, (Devarim 18:10-11) kosem kesamim meonin umenachesh umechashshef vechover chaver veshoel ov veyidoni vedorish el hammetim, ha asara inun.

Amar ribbi yose nachash vekesem, tere zine inun, uvedarga chad salkin. vechad ata bilam bekesem avad lekivlehon deyisrael. vehayeynu dichtiv, (Bamidbar 22:7) ukesamim beyadam. ulekovleh deyaakov ata lavan benachash, hay vehay la seliku bidayyhu hada hu dichtiv, (sham 23) ki lo nachash beyaakov velo kesem beyisrael. ki lo nachash beyaakov bekadmita beyomoy delavan. velo kesem beyisrael levatar beyomoy devilam.

Amar bilam levalak, ta chaze, man yachil lehon. dechol kesamin vacharashin divchitrin dilan, mikkizfa demalchuta dilela (vetatta) mitatteran (deha), vehu itkashshar behu, dichtiv Adonai elohav immo uteruat melech bo.

Amar ribbi yehuda chas veshalom dehava yada bilam bikdusha dilela kelal. deha kudesha berich hu la itrae beam velishan ochora deyishtammesh bikareh, ella benoy kaddishin. veamar (Vayikra 11:44) vehitkaddishtem vihyitem kedoshim, man deinun kaddishin yishtamshun bikdushsha, yisrael inun kaddishin dichtiv, (Devarim 14:2) ki am kadosh atta. atta kadosh vela am ochora.

Man deinun mesaavin, mesaavu izdamman lon leistaava aleh. ketiv, (Vayikra 13:46) tame hu badad yeshev michutz lammachane moshavo. umesaava limsaava kare dichtiv, (sham) vetame tame yikra, man deihu tame, letame yikra, kola azil batar zineh.

Amar ribbi yitzchak, yaot hu leyaakov dehava kaddisha lomar deistaav belavan uvacharashoy, o shevacha hu dileh. amar leh ribbi yose, af al gav dekaamar rabbi yehuda, ana mesayyea lach. deha ketiv, (Bereshit 27:19) anochi esav bechorecha. vechi yaot hu letzaddika keyaakov lemichlaf shemeh bishma dimsaava, ella anochi, paska tama. veamar anochi man deana, aval esav bechorecha veha ukemuha.

Uf hacha, vayhi li shor vachamor, lomar la teshavve libbach ureutach lehahi birchata devarich li abba deitkeyyaym bi. hu barich li hevi gevir leachecha veyishtachavu lecha bene immecha, begin kach avdecha yaakov. ladoni leesav. hu barich li berov dagan vetirosh. ha la itkeyyaym bi, dela otzarna lon. ella, vayhi li shor vachamor tzon veeved, rae ana bechakla. hu barich li, mittal hashshamayim umishmanne haaretz. ha la itkeyyaym bi, begin deha im lavan garti, kegiyyora. dela hava li beta chada kol shekken mishmanne haaretz. vechol da begin dela yistakkal beh beyaakov al inun birchan vikatreg immeh.

Ribbi abba amar ketiv beh beyaakov (Bereshit 25:27) ish tam yoshev ohalim, gevar shelim. begin deihu yetiv bitren mishkanin illain. veashlim lehay gisa ulehay gisa, veihu la amar deistaav bacharashoy. aval al ma dekaamar ribbi yehuda, begin delibboy shelim al tivu ukeshot deavid leh kudesha berich hu. dechol alma yade ovadoy delavan man inun, uman yachil leishtezava (sefer acher minneh, kol esrin shenin dahevaytay immeh) mikkitruga dileh devae leovada li. (sefer acher vaana yativna veavadna immeh esrin shenin) vekudesha berich hu shezvani minneh. vecholla hava begin dela yistakkal beh esav deitkayyeymu beh inun birchan, vela yintar leh devavu. veal da ketiv, (Hoshea 14:10) ki yesharim darche Adonai vegomer, uchetiv, (Devarim 18:13) tamim tihye im Adonai elohecha:
Zohar, Vayishlach 3: Vayyashuvu hammalachim el yaakov lemor banu el achicha el esav vegam holech likratcha vearba meot ish immo. kevan deamar banu el achicha, la yedana deihu esav, vechi achin ochoranin havu leyaakov. ella banu el achicha, vei tema dehadar bitshuva veazil beorach metakkena, lav hachi, ella esav harasha kidmeikkara. vegam holech likratcha, vei tema deihu bilchodoy azil. lav, ela arba meot ish immo.

Vechol kach lamma, (ella inun) amru leh, begin dekudesha berich hu itrae tadir bitzlothon detzaddikaya umitatter bitzlothon. kidamrinan, dehahu malacha dimmanna al tzelothon deyisrael, sandalfon shemeh, natil kol inun tzelotin veavid minnayyhu atara lechaye haolamim veukemuha. vechol shekken tzelothon detzaddikayya dekudesha berich hu itrae behu veitavdan atara leitattera beinun tzelotin lekudesha berich hu. vei tema mashshiryayn kaddishin havu atyayn immeh, ammay dachil. ella tzaddikayay la samchin al zechutayyhu, ella al tzelothon uvautehon legabbe marehon.

Veta chaze, deamar ribbi shimon, tzelota desaggiin salik kamme kudesha berich hu umitatter behahu tzelota. begin desalka bigvavnin saggiin veitkelilat mikkamma sitrin. uvegin deitkelilat mikkamma gevavnin itavidat atara umancha al resha detzaddik chay haolamim. utzelota deyachid lav ihi kelila, velav ihi ella begavvavn chad. veal da tzelota deyachid lav ihu mittakna leitkabbela (ella bitzlota) kitzlota desaggiin. veta chaze, yaakov kalil hava, veal da tzeloteh taiv lah kudesha berich hu. ma ketiv vayyira yaakov meod vayyetzer lo.

Ribbi yehuda patach veamar (Mishlei 28:14) ashre adam mefached tamid umakshe libbo yippol beraa. zakkain inun yisrael dekudesha berich hu itrae behu, veyahav lon orayyta dikshot begin lemizke vah lechayye alma, dechol man deishtaddal beorayyta kudesha berich hu mashich aleh chayyin illain, veail leh lechayye alma deate, dichtiv, (Devarim 30:20) ki hi chayyecha veorech yamecha. uchetiv, (sham 32) uvaddavar hazze taarichu yamim. chayyin behay alma vechayin bealma deate.

Ribbi elazar amar kol man deishtaddal beorayyta lishmah, lav mitateh al yeda deyetzer hara, begin (gillayon dehu nachash vehu malacha demota. ella mitathon binshika dichtiv (Shir HaShirim 1:2) yashkeni minneshikot pihu, kelomar al pi Adonai, vehi hanneshika dehi dabeykevatea denafsha baaykeraa, vehahi deishtaddal beorayyta) deittakkif beilana dechayye vela arpe minneh, uvegin kach tzaddikaya demishtaddele beorayyta la mistaave gufa dilhon (gillayon ella hu dechi, kegon eliyyahu beve kivre daashakechavehav rabbanan, usheilu leh velav kohen hu mar, amar lon tzadikaya lo misave bemitathon, kema detanenan beyom shemmet rabbi betela kehunna, kelomar daataasakev beh) dela shara alayyhu ruach mesaava.
