Yaakov ilana dechayye hava, ammay dachil, deha la yachol leshaltaa aloy. veod deha ketiv vehinne anochi immach vegomer, ammay hava dachil. vetu deha ketiv vayyifgeu vo malache elohim. i mashshiryayn kaddishin havu immeh ammay hava dachil.

Ella kolla yaot hava, veyaakov la hava bae lemismach al nissa dekudesha berich hu, begin dechashiv delav ihu keday dekudesha berich hu yaavid leh nissa. may tama, begin dela falach leavoy uleimmeh kedka yeut, vela ishtaddal beorayyta venatal tere achayot. veaf al gav decholla ittemar, veim kol da bae leh levar nash lemidchal tadir uletzallaa kamme kudesha berich hu bitzlota. dichtiv ashre adam mefached tamid (ulemidchal tadir kamme kudesha berich hu) veha ukemuha.

Ta chaze, tzelota deavahan kayymu alma, vechol bene alma alayyhu kayyme vesamchin. lealam ulealme almin, la itneshe zechuta deavahan, begin dizchuta deavahan ihu kiyyuma deela vetatta, vekiyyuma deyaakov ihu kiyyuma shelim yattir mikkullehu. uvegin kach beshata deaku livnoy deyaakov, kudesha berich hu achme kammeh diukena deyaakov vechayis al alma kema deat amer, (Vayikra 26:42) vezacharti et beriti yaakov. yaakov beVav, ammay beVav, begin deihu diukena deyaakov mammash.

Ta chaze, kol man dechame leh leyaakov keman deistakkel beaspaklarya denahara, veha ittemar deshufereh deyaakov keshufereh deadam kadmaa. amar ribbi yesa, ana shemana dechol man deistakkal bechelmeh vechama leh leyaakov mekustar bekusefoy, chayyin ittosfan leh.

Ribbi shimon amar, ha ittemar dedavid malka ad la hava, la havu leh chayyim kelal. bar deadam kadmaa yahav leh shivin shenin middileh, vechach hava kiyyumeh dedavid malka shivin shenin havu. vekiyyuma deadam kadmaa elef shenin chasar shivin. ishtakkachu behanne elef shenin kadmae, adam harishon vedavid malka.

Patach veamar (Tehillim 21:5) chayyim shaal mimcha natatta lo orech yamim olam vaed. chayyim shaal mimcha, da david malka. deha kad bara kudesha berich hu ginta deeden attil beh nishmata dedavid malka, veistakkal beh vechame delet leh chayyim middileh kelum. vekayyma kammeh kol yoma. kevan devara adam harishon amar ha vadday kiyyumeh, umeadam kadmaa havu shivin shenin deitkeyyaym david malka bealma.
Tu avahan shavku leh mechayyehon kol chad vechad, avraham shavak leh, vechen yaakov veyosef. yitzchak la shavak leh kelum, begin dedavid malka missitreh ka ata.

Vadday avraham shavak leh chamesh shenin, dehava leh leitkayyeyma mea utemanin shenin, veitkeyyaym mea veshivin vechamesh shenin, chaserin chamesh. yaakov hava leh leitkayyma bealma keyome deavraham, vela itkeyyaym ella mea vearbain vesheva shenin, chaserim temanya veesrin. ishtakkachu deavraham veyaakov shevaku leh mechayyehon telatin utelat shenin. yosef deitkeyyaym mea veeser shenin, hava leh leitkayyayma mea vearbain vesheva shenin keyome deyaakov, vechaser minnehon telatin vesheva shenin. ha shivin shenin dishvaku leh ledavid malka leitkayyma behon, uvehu itkayaym david bechol inun shenin dishvaku leh avahan.

Vei tema yitzchak ammay la shavak leh kelum kehanne, begin deihu choshech vedavid missitra dechoshech ka ata, uman deihu bachoshech let leh nehora kelal velet leh chayyim. uvegin kach la havu ledavid chayyim kelal. aval illen dehavu lehon nehora, nehiru leh ledavid malka, uminnayyhu itzterich leanhara ulemehve leh chayyim, deha missitra dechoshech let leh chayyim kelal, veal da la ata yitzchak bechushebna.

Vei tema yosef ammay yattir mikkullehu. ella vadday yosef bilchodoy, kechullehu begin deikre tzaddik, veda hu deanhir lesihara yattir mikkullehu. uvegin kach hay shavak leh ledavid malka yatir mikkullehu chayyin, dichtiv, (Bereshit 1:17) vayyitten otam elohim birkia hashshamayim lehair al haaretz.

Ta chaze yaakov tzeloteh agin leh meesav, begin devaa lesalka zechuteh livnoy avatreh vela leafaka leh hasheta legabbeh deesav. veal da tzale tzeloteh lekudesha berich hu, vela istemich al zechuteh, leshezava leh beginih:

Vayyomer im yavo esav el hammachan haachat vehikkahu vehaya hammachan hannishar lifleta. ta chaze, ma ketiv vayyachatz et haam asher itto veet hatztzon veet habbakar vehaggemallim lishne machanot. ammay lishne machanot. begin deamar im yavo esav el hammachan haachat vehikkahu vehaya hammachane hannishar lifleta.

Ta chaze, shechinta la adiat meohel lea umeohel rachel. amar yaakov yadana deha netiru lon leillen min kudesha berich hu. ma avad vayyasem et hashshefachot veet yaldehen rishona, amar im yaktil esav, leillen yaktel. aval illen la mistafina minnayyhu, begin dishchinta immehon. veal da vehaya hammachane hannishar lifleta. kevan deavid hay atkin tzeloteh alayyhu, ma ketiv vayyomer yaakov elohe avi avraham vilohe avi yitzchak Adonai haomer elay shuv leartzecha ulemoladtecha veetiva immach.

Ribbi yose patach veamar (Tehillim 102:1) tefilla leani chi yaatof velifni Adonai yishpoch sicho. hay kera ukemuha bechamma atar. ella david malka amar da kad istakkal vechama bemille demiskena, veistakkal beh kad hava azil vearak mikkamme chamoy amar da. tefilla leani, da hu tzelota devae miskena kamme kudesha berich hu, veda tzelota deakdimat lechol tzelothon dealma.

Ketiv hacha tefilla leani uchetiv hatam (Tehillim 90:1) tefilla lemoshe ish haelohim, ma ben hay lehay. ella da tefilla shel yad veda tefilla shel rosh, velet leafrasha ben hay tefilla leani uven tefilla lemoshe ish haelohim, vetarvavyyhu shekilin kechad.

Veal da tzelota deani akdimat kamme kudesha berich hu mikkol tzelotin dealma, begin dichtiv, (Tehillim 22:25) ki lo vaza velo shikkatz enut ani vegomer. ta chaze, tefilla leani, da tefilla shel yad. deani itdabbak bemiskenuteh, keman delet leh miggarmeh kelum.
Davar acher tefilla da moshe. leani da david. ki yaatof, kad itkasseya sihara veitkasse shimsha minah. velifne Adonai yishpoch sicho, begin leitchabbera bahade shimsha.

Ta chaze, tzelota dechol bene nasha tzelota. utzelota demiskena ihi tzelota dekayyma kammeh dekudesha berich hu vetavar tarin ufitchin vealat leitkabbala kammeh hada hu dichtiv, (Shemot 22:26) vehaya chi yitzak elay veshamati ki channun ani, uchetiv shamoa eshma tzaakato. velifne Adonai yishpoch sicho, keman demitraem al dinoy dekudesha berich hu.

Amar ribbi elazar tzelothon detzaddikayay chedvavta lichneset yisrael leitattara kameh kudesha berich hu, vegin kach chaviva hu yattir kammeh kudesha berich hu. uvegin kach kudesha berich hu taiv litzlothon detzaddikayyay beshata deitzterich lon, begin deyade leratztzuye lemarehon.

Ma ketiv beh beyaakov elohe avi avraham velohe avi yitzchak Adonai haomer elay shuv vegomer, iatar veikshar kishshura bekishshura chad kedka chaze. elohe avi avraham limina, vilohe avi yitzchak lismala. haomer elay, hacha tale milla leitattera leatreh benayyhu. shuv leartzecha ulemoladtecha veetiva immach:

Katonti mikkol hachasadim, ammay hava itzterich hay im hay. ella amar yaakov at avtacht li leotava immi, veana yedana dechol ovadach kullehu al tenay. ha ana let bi zechuta deha katonti mikkol hachasadim umikkol haemet asher asita et avdecha, vechol ma daavadat li ad yoma lav begin zechutay hava ella beginach hu daavadat li, vehahu tivu ukeshot beginach hava. deha kad avarna bekadmita dehavena azil mikkamme deesav, yechiday avarna leh lehahu nahara, veant avdit immi tivu ukeshot. veha ana hasheta maavar leh bitre mashshiryayn, inun teren mashshiryayn defalig.

Ad hacha siddura deshivcha demareh, mikkan ulehala baa ma deitzterich leh. leachazaa lechol beni alma, deitzterich leh levar nash lesaddera shevacha demareh bekadmita, ulevatar yibbae bauteh. dehachi avad yaakov, bekadmita sidder shevacha demareh, ulevatar desidder shevacha amar bauteh deitzterich leh.

Hada hu dichtiv hatztzileni na miyyad achi miyyad esav ki yare anochi oto pen yavo vehikkanni em al banim. mikkan, man detzalle tzeloteh devae lefarsha milloy kedka yeut. hatztzileni na, vei tema deha shezavt li millavan. miyyad achi. vei tema kerivin ocharanin setam, achin ikrun. miyyad esav. may taama, begin lefarsha milla kedka yeut. vei tema ana ammay itzterich, ki yare anochi oto pen yavo vehikkani. begin leishtemoda milla leela ulefarsha lah kedka yeut, vela yastim milla:
Veatta amarta hetev etiv immach vegomer. veatta amarta hetev etiv, may veatta. kema deat amer (nechemya 9:6) veatta mechayye et kullam, uf hacha veatta amarta.

Ta chaze, david malka amar (Tehillim 19:15) yihyu leratzon imre fi, illen millin deitparshan. vehegyon libbi, illen millin distiman dela yachil bar nash lefarsha lon befumeh, da hu hegyon deihu belibba dela yachil leitparsha.

Veal da itzterich milla leitparsha befuma, umilla detalya belibba, vecholla raza ihu. chad lokovel darga tattaa, vechad lokovel darga illaa. milla deitparsha lokovel darga tattaa deitzterich leitparsha. hahu detalya belibba ihu lokovel darga penimaa yattir, vecholla kechada ihu. veal da amar yihyu leratzon imre fi vehegyon libbi lefanecha vegomer.

Kegavvna da amar yaakov, bekadmita parish milla kedka yeut, ulevatar satim milla deihi talya behegyona delibba dela itzterich lefarsha. dichtiv, (Bereshit 32:13) vesamti et zaracha kechol hayyam asher lo yissafer merov. hacha ihu milla detalya belibba dela itzterich lefarsha. vechen itzterich kidkaamaran, begin leyachada yichuda shelim kedka yeut. zakkain inun tzaddikaya deyade lesaddera shevacha demarehon kedka yeut ulemive bautehon, uvegin kach ketiv (Yeshayahu 49:3) vayyomer li avdi atta yisrael asher becha etpaar. (sefer acher ketiv gam et hashsheni gam et hashshelishi vegomer, hashshalosh peamim gam, ramaz (gillayon, 43 rashe tevot goel masheraz goel mardochay goel mashiach) leshalosh geulot al yede shelosha tzaddikim moshe mardochay mashiach sheatid legoolenu bekeruv):
Zohar, Vayishlach 9: Vayyaratz esav likrato vaychabbekehu vayyippol al tzavvarav. tzavvaro ketiv chaser. vayyishshakehu vayyivku. rabbi yitzchak amar (Yeshayahu 57:20) veharshaim kayyam nigrash ki hasheket lo yuchal vayyigreshu memav refesh vatit, hay kera ittemar. umille deorayyta, kamma razin illain it behu meshanyayn da min da, vecholla chad.

Veharshaim kayyam nigrash ki hasheket lo yuchol, da esav dechol ovadoy birshiu uvechiyyuva, deha kad ata legabbeh deyaakov, ovadoy la havu bishlam, vayyippol al tzavvarav, chad. tzavvaro da yerushala 40 deihu tzavvaro dechol alma. vayyippol al tzavvaro, velo al tzavvarav. begin ditren zimnin itchariv be makdesha. chad mibbavel, vechad mizzareh deesav, deappil garmeh aleh zimna chada vechariv leh. veal da vayyippol al tzavvaro chad.

Vayyishshakehu, nakud leel, dela nashkeh biruteh. utenan may dichtiv, (Mishlei 27:6) venetarot neshikot sone, da bilam kad barich lon leyisrael. deha la barich lon biruta delibba. uf hacha netarot neshikot sone, da esav.

Amar ribbi yose, ketiv (Tehillim 3:8) kuma Adonai hoshieni elohay ki hikkita et kol oyvay lechi shinne reshaim shibbarta. utenan al tikre shibbarta ella shirbavta. deha asgiu shinoy vechashiv lenashcha leh vechulei. veal da vayyivku, da bache veda bache, veukemuha chavrayay.

Ta chaze, kamma hava libbeh ureuteh deesav legabbe deyaakov, deha afillu behahu shata chashiv leorech zimnin (sefer acher laavarekaa deyomin) lemebad leh bishin ulekatrega leh, veal da vayyivku. da hava bache, dela hava chashiv leishtezava min yedoy. veda hava bache, begin deavoy hava kayyaym vela yachil leh.

Amar ribbi abba vadday itchallash rugezeh deesav beshata dechama leh leyaakov. may tama, begin deha istakkam bahadeh hahu memanna deesav. veal da la yachil esav leshaltaa berugezeh, dehachi kol millin dehay alma talyayn leela. vechad istakkemu leela bekadmita istakkemu letatta. shaltanuta lav ihu letatta ad deityahiv shaltanuta leela, vecholla da beda talya:

rashi: Bechor yaakov. afillu bishat hakkalkala kerao bechor:
Bechor yaakov. bechor lannachala, bechor laavoda, bechor leminyan, velo nittena vechora leyosef ella leinyan hashshevatim – shennaasa lishne shevatim:
ohc: Bene lea bechor yaakov vegomer. taam shehutzrach lehodia heyoto bechor yaakov, lomar shello tachshov bo davar bilti hagun dichtiv besamuch "vayyishkav et bilha", ki lo shachav mammash. veharaya, shechazar umenao im shear echav, dichtiv "vayyihyu vene yaakov shenem asar", velaze rasham veamar bechor yaakov, ki hu bechor yaakov, veleheyoto tippa rishona shel yaakov, bechina zo tashresh bo harechakat hattiuv velo tachshedennu.

rashi: Veelle shemot allufe esav. shennikreu al shem medinotehem leachar shemmet hadar ufaska mehem malchut, veharishonim hannizkarim lemala hem shemot toldotam; vechen meforash bedivre hayyamim vayyamat hadad vayyihyu allufe edom alluf timna vegomer:
Miyyad achi miyyad esav. miyyad achi sheen noheg immi cheach ella cheesav harasha:
ohc: Hatztzileni na. amro "na" leshon bakkasha gam leshon atta, perush, leval yifrotz bo esav, veyomar Adonai ki hu yashiv kol asher lo lemishne, laze hitpallel lifne Adonai sheyyatztzilehu veyaamid beyado et asher higgio atta, velo taasena yadav shel esav tushiyya, hagam sheyyashiv Adonai shevuto achare chen.

Miyyad achi vegomer. Rashi zichrono livracha peresh "achi" sheeno noheg immi keach ella keesav harasha, velidvarav zichrono livracha lo haya lo lomar ella "miyyad achi esav" umuvan haddavar miyyittur amro "esav" ki en lo ach zulato.

Achen nitkavven lehitpallel, leheyot shehayu leesav shete bechinot hattokef: haachat letzad zechut yitzchak, vehashsheniyya letzad godel takpo umaalato, vetzarich chozek gadol lehinnatzel mimmennu. laze hitpallel shello taamod lo zechut avot. vehu amro hatztzileni na miyyad achi, hagam sheach esav leyaakov veaf al pi chen ani mitpallel, ucheneged bechinat godel takpo amar miyyad esav, veyadua hu benissa veram.

Od yechavven lomar al ze hadderech: hatztzileni na miyyad achi – im yitchakkem alav lehara berammaut achva, shehu derech sheen yaakov yachol lehinnatzel mimmennu, miyyad esav – im yefarsem risho lehara, gam laze hutzrach litfilla lehatztzilo miyyado.

Od yechavven lehazekir rishuto shel esav: ha – miyyad achi – vehu mevakkesh laharog et achiv, haim yesh rasha kaze, veyesh baddin lehashepilo lifne yaakov. veod – miyyad esav – shemmefursam beresha levad meavon ze, velo yimmot tzaddik lifne rasha.

rashi: Veoholivama yalda vegomer. korach ze mamzer haya, uven elifaz haya, shebba al eshet aviv, el oholivama eshet esav, shehare hu manuy im allufe elifaz besof hainyan (Bereshit Rabba):

Yovav ben zerach mibbotzra. batzra meare moav hi, shenneemar veal keriyyot veal batzra vegomer (Yirmeyahu 48); ulefi sheheemida melech leedom, atida lilkot immahem, shenneemar ki zevach laAdonai bevatzra (Yeshayahu 34):
Bemirma. bechachma:
Asher timme. hakkatuv omer shello hayta remiyya, shehare timme et dina achotam (Bereshit Rabba):
ohc: Vayyaanu vene yaakov vegomer. tzarich ladaat ma hi hachachma sheasu, shettirgem uneklos "bechachmeta", veen ze ella genevat daat. od, ma hi kavvanato beamro vaydabberu asher vegomer:

Achen yechavven beamro bemirma ki nitchakkemu leval yargishu bearmatam, ki ze hu haikkar, ki ma yoilu bearmatam im yachushu lah chamor ushechem veyaasu shemira hatztzericha, o lo yaasu davar lachashash hammechush. asher al ken nitchakkemu bitshuvatam, vekodem kol davar gillu ki hikpidu al haddavar, shezzulat ze tihye nikkeret haarma, kevan shehammaase haya yadua ki lo yease chen. im haelem yalimu mehareot hakepada ketzat, mirma yaggid. laze petach divrehem dibberu kashot "asher timme" vegomer, vehu amro vaydabberu dibbur kashe shehochichum al haddavar, uvaze hesiru hachashad sheenam medabberim echad bappe veechad ballev, shehare heru hakepadatam.

Veachare chen amru lahem amira rakka, vehu amro vayyomru lo nuchal, perush, hem chafetzim uretzonam letittah lo, ella sheenam yecholin letittah letzad asher lo arla. velo amru "asher hu arel", ki letaana zo yaspik behimmolo hu et besar arlato. laze amru asher lo arla, perush, asher lo hetter arla, ki ma bechach im yimmol hu, uvanim asher yivvaldu lo middina yihyu arelim, kevan sheen lahem din mila.

Veod natnu taam bedivrehem, shehaikkar hu kede sheyyitchattenu immahem veyihyu nosim nashim ellu meellu veyihyu leam echad, veze lo yihye ella im yimmolu kullam. laze amru ach bezot neot lachem vegomer lehimmol kol zachar. dikdeku lomar "ach" lemaet taanat sheyyekabbel alav mila chamor hu vezaro, ki lo yaspik ze mittaam shekkatavnu, ella davka lehimmol lachem kol zachar. vetamam beikkar haddavar halo hu kamus immam laharog kullam veen miyyadam matztzil. od nitchakkemu levattel mehem chashad devar arma bechol dibbur vedibbur sheamru lahem, kaasher avaer besamuch beezrat hashshem yitbarach.

rashi: Hittattu. leoto chasar lev (Mishlei 7:7) eleha:
Berov likchah. shehi lemuda leharegil bechach anashim:
Bechelek sefateha. bedibbur chalaklak taddichennu min hadderech:
targum: Veate yateh besugeya demilaha uvishiuta desifvataha tefatteh:

rashi: Lo yikkare shimcha od yaakov. leshon adam habba bemaarav veakba, ella leshon sar venagid:
ohc: Lo yikkare shimcha vegomer ki im yisrael. tzarich ladaat ma nishtanna yaakov meavraham, ki hakkore leavraham avram over baase (berachot 13.), aval hakkore leyisrael yaakov eno over. vahagam sherabbotenu zichronam livracha (sham) amru ki yaakov ahdereh kera, velamma lo nilmad mimma deahdereh leyaakov hagam sheamar bo "lo yikkare" veahdereh kemo chen beavraham?

Veulay ki letzad sheshshinna Adonai devaro hattov haamur beyaakov mehaamur beavraham, bema sheamar "shimcha yaakov", ki lo haya tzarich lomar ken, ki ma chiddesh baze beamro "shimcha yaakov"? ella vadday shennitkavven lomar shem kavua hu lecha. ella shetztzarich ladaat tamo shel 112 lamma beavraham hikpid al avram, veal yaakov lo hikpid. veyerae ki yesh taam nachon, vehu lema shekkadam lanu ki shemot bene haadam hem shemot nafshotam, vaAdonai sam shammot baaretz vedarshu zichrono livracha (berachot 7.) vechulei. vehinne yaakov yihye shem nefesh shehayta lo, velaze hagam shennittosef bo ruach elohim hannikra yisrael, lo mippene ze avad harishon, vahare yeshnam lerishon gam sheni veyachol hu likkare yaakov veen rauy sheyyeaker shemo harishon lachalutin. ma sheen ken avraham, ki gam achar shinnuy shemo leilluy lo neekar shem harishon, ki yesh bichlal avraham avram, velaze yetzav hael likrot lo bitmidut avraham, veen akira larishon ki bichlal avraham avram. veulay ki ze ramaz hakkatuv bedivre hayyamim (divrei hayamim 1 1:26) "avram hu avraham". uchefi ze amro lo yikkare shimcha od vegomer, perush levad ella gam yisrael. gam diyyek beamro "lo yikkare shimcha od" velo amar "lo yikkare od shimcha" kemo sheamar beavraham (Bereshit 17:5), vehaven:

rashi: Al lev hannaara. devarim hammityashshevim al hallev; rei, avich bechelkat sade ketanna kamma mamon bizbez, ani assiech vetikne hair vechol sedoteha:
Ach neota lahem. ledavar ze, veal yede chen yeshvu ittanu:
Ben oni. ben tzaari:

Vinyamin. nire veenay, lefi shehu levaddo nolad beeretz kenaan shehu bannegev kesheadam ba mearam naharayim, kemo shenneemar bannegev beeretz kenaan (Bamidbar 33), haloch venasoa hannegba (Bereshit 12):
Vinyamin. ben yamin, leshon tzafon veyamin atta veratam (Tehillim 89), lefichach hu male:
Vayhi li shor vachamor. abba amar li mittal hashshamayim umishmanne haaretz, zo enah lo min hashshamayim velo min haaretz:
Shor vachamor. derech eretz lomar al shevarim harebe shor – adam omer lachavero ballayla kara hattarnegol veeno omer karu hattarnegolim:
Vaeshlecha lehaggid ladoni. lehodia sheani va elecha:
Limtzo chen beenecha. sheani shalem immecha umevakkesh ahavatcha:

Achappera fanav. avattel ragzo; vechen vechuppar beritchem et mavet (Yeshayahu 28), lo tucheli kapperah (sham 47). venire veenay shekkol kappara sheetzel avon vechet veetzel panim kullan leshon kinnuach vehaavara hen, velashon arammi hu, veharebe battalmud vechapper yedeh, bae lechappure yede behahu gavra, vegam bilshon hammikra nikraim hammizrakim shel kodesh kefore zahav (Ezra 1), al shem shehakkohen mekanneach yadav bahen bisfat hammizrak:
ohc: Vaamartem vegomer. perush: taam shehinne hu acharenu velo kodem velo immanu, "ki amar achappera" vegomer kodem, veachar kach ere fanav.

rashi: Od. paam sheni bammakom hazze, echad belechto veechad beshuvo:
Vayvarech oto. birkat avelim (Bereshit Rabba):

Habba veyado. birshuto, vechen vayyikkach et kol artzo miyyado (Bamidbar 21). umia min habba veyado – avanim tovot umargaliyyot, sheadam tzar bitzror venosam beyado (davar acher min habba veyado, min hachullin, shennatal maaser, kema deat amar asser aasserennu lach, vahadar lakach mincha):
Hammallachim. bene adam hammanhigim et hassefina:
Ish el elohav. min shivim ummot shel akkum hayu sham:
targum: Udechilu safnaya uveo gevar min dechalteh vachazo are let behon tzeroch uremo yat manaya divilfa leyama leakala minhon veyona nechet learit shida deilfa ushechiv udemuch:

rashi: El bet el. hakkabba bevet el, gilluy shechinato bevet el. yesh teva chasera bet hameshammeshet beroshah, kemo hinne hu bet machir ben ammiel (Shmuel 2 9) – kemo bevet machir; bet avich (Bereshit 38:11) – kemo bevet avich:

Niglu elav haelohim. bimkomot harebe yesh shem elohut veadnut bilshon rabbim, kemo adone yosef (sham 39), im bealav immo (Shemot 20), velo neemar baalo, vechen elohut shehu leshon shofet umarut nizkar bilshon rabbim, aval echad mikkol shear hashshemot lo timtza bilshon rabbim:
ohc: Vayyikra lammakom el vegomer. hagam shekkevar kerao chen bevarcho mippene esav, chazar vehosif lomar "el bet el". perush: yiched shemo yitbarach al hammakom sheshshemo bet el, venatan taam laze "ki sham niglu" vegomer, uletzad shemmakom ze sham kana hahavtachot shennitkayyemu bo, yiched hosif lehaalot lammakom hahu.

Vayyikra yaakov vegomer asher vegomer bet el. kashe, vahalo kevar kerao chen, vegam betosefet "el bet el", uchemo shepperashti lemala (Bereshit 35:7), uma chiddesh bikria zo? veulay shehosif likrot lammakom samuch levet el sheggam hu yikkare "bet el" kesheddibber Adonai elav bo, vehu sheddikdek lomar et shem hammakom asher dibber vegomer, perush ki letzad haddibbur shehaya sham kara lo gam ken vechulei, sheillu lammakom shennigla sham elav bevarcho lo haya tzarich lomar "asher dibber":

rashi: Veayya vaana. vav yetera, vehu kemo ayya vaana, veharebe yesh bammikra, tet vekodesh vetzava mirmas (Daniel 8), nirdam verechev vasus (Tehillim 76):
Hu ana. haamur lemala shehu achiv shel tzivon vechan hu kore oto beno? melammed shebba tzivon al immo veholid et ana:

Et hayyemim. peradim, hirbia chamor al sus nekeva veyalda pered, vehu haya mamzer vehevi fesulin laolam; velamma nikra shemam yemim? sheematan muttelet al habberiyyot, deamar rabbi chanina miyyamay lo shealani adam al makkat pirda levana vechaya (chullin 7) (vahalo ka chazinan dechaya? al tikre vechaya ella vechayta, ki hammakka lo terafe leolam, verashi yashan) velo huzkak lichtov lanu mishpechot hachori ella mippene timna, ulehodia gedullat avraham, kemo shepperashti lemala:
Lamma ze tishal. en lanu shem kavua, mishtannim shemotenu, hakkol lefi mitzvat avodat hashshelichut sheanu mishtallechim (Bereshit Rabba):
ohc: Haggida na shemecha. leheyot sheyyaakov yodea hu sheen shem kavua lammalach, veshaal lammalach shemo, uferesh ki shoalo al shemo az beotah shaa, vehu amro haggida na shemecha perush: atta ma shemecha.

Lamma ze tishal vegomer. perush, bishlama ma sheshshaal hammalach shemo shel yaakov hu letaam ma sheamar lo "lo yaakov vegomer ki im yisrael", ma sheen ken sheela zo shel yaakov lamma, im lomar lo davar yomar elav uvelo sibbat sheelat inyan ze. o yirtze lamma perush, leeze inyan atta shoel davar ze sheodiacha shemi sheani nikra bo atta, kevan sheen ze shem kavua uveet acher yitztarech lishol lishmi.

rashi: Gemallim menikot sheloshim, uvenehem. immahem: umia: uvenehem – bannaehem, zachar keneged nekeva, ulefi shetztzanua betashmish lo firsemo hakkatuv (Bereshit Rabba):
Vayarim. chamorim zecharim:
Avar lifnehem. amar im yavo oto rasha lehillachem yillachem bi techilla:

Livroach tarshisha. yam sheshshemo tarshish, vehu bechutza laaretz. amar: evrach li hayyam, sheen hashshechina shora bechutz laaretz. amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu: chayyecha, yesh li sheluchim keyotze becha lishloach acharecha ulehaviacha mishsham. mashal leeved kohen shebbarach min rabbo venichnas levet hakkevarot. amar lo rabbo: yesh li avadim kayotze becha lishloach acharecha ulehaviacha mishsham. uma raa yona shello ratza lelech el ninve? amar: haakkum kerove teshuva hem, im omar lahem veyaasu teshuva nimtzeti mechayyev et yisrael sheen shomim ledivre hanneviim:
Vayyitten secharah. hikdim latet secharah, veen derech yorde hayyam latet sechar hassefina ad sheat hayyetzia, vehu hikdim. velo od ella shennatan sechar kullah:
targum: Vekam yona lemerak leyama min kodam deitnabbe bishma dayya unechat leyafo veashkach ilfa daazala leyama vihav agra unechat bah lemezal imhon beyama min kodam deitnabbe bishma dayay:

rashi: Veet lea viladeha acharonim. acharon acharon chaviv:
Haela. min ilan serak:
Im shechem. etzel shechem:

Vattamot devora. ma inyan devora bevet yaakov? ella lefi sheamra rivka leyaakov veshalachti ulekachticha mishsham, shalcha devora etzlo lefaddan aram latzet mishsham, umeta vadderech; middivre rabbi moshe haddarshan lemadtiha:
Mittachat levet el. hair yoshevet bahar venikbera beragle hahar:

Tachat haallon. beshippule meshra, shehaya mishor milmala beshippua hahar vehakkevura millematta, umishor shel bet el hayu korin lo allon. veaggada, nitbasser sham beevel sheni, shehuggad lo al immo shemmeta (Bereshit Rabba), veallon bilshon yevani acher, ulefi sheheelimu et yom motah shello yekallelu habberiyyot keres sheyyatza mimmennu esav, af hakkatuv lo firsemah:
Vechen lo yease. leannot et habbetulot, shehaummot gadru atzman min haarayot al yede hammabbul (Bereshit Rabba):
ohc: Vayyitatztzevu vegomer ki nevala vegomer. perush, ki yesh bemaase ze shene divre kiur: haechad hu afillu im haya lokeach otah lo leishsha kederech eretz, af al pi chen hu cherpa lahem latet bittam leish tame, vehu amro achar kach ki nevala asa veyisrael lishkav et bat yaakov, ucheneged perat ze amar vayyitatztzevu haanashim. vehashsheni hu letzad asot haddavar bederech ze, sheafillu ben haammim haddomim begeder happechitut hu davar megunne, vehu amro vechen lo yease, perush afillu ben haummot, keamram zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 80:6) sheggadru atzman haummot min haarayot. ucheneged ze amar vayyichar lahem, ech asa davar sheafillu benehem bilti hagun hu:

rashi: Veal tere veyom achicha. lo haya lecha lehabbit velaamod minneged:
Beyom nachro. beyom hisgiro beyad oyev, hu habbavliyyim. vechen hu omer beshaul "nikkar oto elohim beyadi" (Shmuel 1 23:7), hisgir oto beyadi:
targum: Vedachazeta veyoma deachuch beyom tevireh vedachadita livne yehuda beyom tevirhon udeasgeta lemalala ravrevan beidan aka:

rashi: Ukera aleha. et keriati:
targum: Kum ezel leninve karta rabbeta veitnabbe alah are selikat bishathon kodamay:

rashi: Velohe avi yitzchak. ulehallan hu omer ufachad yitzchak? veod umahu shechazar vehizkir shem hameyuchad? haya lo lichtov haomer elay shuv leartzecha vegomer. ella kach amar yaakov lifne hakkabba, shete havetachot hivtachtani, achat betzeti mibbet avi mibbeer sheva, sheamarta li ani Adonai elohe avraham avicha velohe yitzchak, vesham amarta li ushemarticha bechol asher telech, uvevet lavan amarta li (Bereshit 31) shuv el eretz avotecha ulemoladtecha veehye immach, vesham nigleta elay bashshem hameyuchad levaddo, shenneemar vayyomer Adonai el yaakov shuv el eretz avotecha vegomer, bishte havetachot ellu ani va lefanecha:

Al panav. kemo lefanav, vechen chamas vashod yishshama bah al panay tamid (Yirmeyahu 6), vechen hammachisim oti al panay (Yeshayahu 65); umia al panav, af hu sharuy bechaas, shehaya tzarich lechol ze (Bereshit Rabba):
Chittat. pachad:
ohc: Vayyissau vayhi vegomer. ulay shechiddush yashmienu, ki hagam shennasu mishsham, veze yaggid al anaf habbericha, af al pi chen "vayhi chittat" vegomer. o al ze hadderech: hagam sherau shemmilletu miyyadam vehalchu lahem, af al pi chen nafla alehem emata velo radfu, vehiskimu al melitatam.

rashi: Yoshve haaretz. shehayu yoshveha kodem shebba esav lesham. verabbotenu darshu (shabbat 85) shehayu bekiin beyishshuvah shel eretz; melo kane ze lezetim, melo kane ze ligfanim, shehayu toamin heafar veyodin e zo netia reuya lo:
ohc: Elle vene seir vegomer. taam hodaat inyan ze, lehodia shiur ma shennatan Adonai bizchut haavot leesav hagam heyoto rasha. verabbotenu zichronam livracha gam ken darshu bemassechet shabbat perek rabbi akiva (shabbat pe) veze leshonam: rabbi acha bar yaakov amar, chori – shennaasu bene chorin minnichsehem, ad kan. hare sheyyesapper hakkatuv bintinatam leesav. veamru od (sanhedrin 99) ki lehodia timna heyotah berum hammaalot achot lotan venaaset pilegesh leelifaz, veellu vaellu divre elohim chayyim:

rashi: Shelemim. beshalom uvelev shalem:
Vehaaretz hinne rachavat yadayim. keadam sheyyado rechava uvatranit; kelomar, al tafsidu kelum – perakmatya harebe baa lechan veen lah konim:
ohc: Shelemim hem ittanu. perush, veen belibbam sina al hammaase lachush learma:

Veamro et benotam nikkach lanu vegomer, nitchakkemu lomar ken kede sheyyaaminu anshe iram ki en belibbam tina, ki hem machshivin otam gedolim vetovim mehem, ki benotehen hem mitratztzim sheyyikchu lahem vegomer, uvenot mishpachat shechem yitztarchu latet hem lahem, vedavar ze yaggid ki hem machshivin otam gedolim vetovim mehem, vezo sibba lema shello hikpidu al haddavar.

rashi: Yehi lecha asher lecha. kan hoda lo al habberachot (Bereshit Rabba):
ohc: Vayyomer esav yesh li vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma hutzrach lomar achi achar sheimmo haya medabber, veod haya lo lehakedimah bitchillat haddibbur lo beemtza haddevarim.

Achen kavvanat esav hu al ze hadderech: im letzad hanaati atta mechavven – yesh li rav veeni tzarich laze, veim lahanaat atzmecha atta mechavven kede sheyyitkarev libbi elecha, kemo sheggilla beamro "limtzo chen" – achi yehi lecha vegomer, perush, lo yukkar ahavati otcha shehi letzad haachva ella im tachzir minchatcha, shezzulat ze yerae ki ma sheani mitnaheg immecha beachva eno ella letzad hammincha, veze hu shiur hakkatuv, achi, perush, tihye nikkar sheani machzik otcha beachi im yihye lecha vegomer:
Al na im na matzati vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma heerich lomar na shete peamim?

Achen kavvanat hakkatuv hu al ze hadderech, ki ba lehashiv sheddevarav emet hem, sheyyoter yukkar middat achva im lo yikkach mimmennu davar. aval ematay haya haddavar ken? kodem shehevi, ach lo atta achar shehevi lo hammincha en rauy lehachezirah lo. vehu amro al na, perush: atta achar sheheveti lecha hammincha, im na matzati chen vaahavtani keach leachiv, tosif laasot immi chesed shettikkach minchati miyyadi. velaze dikdek lomar velakachta betosefet vav. veamro ki al ken, perush: shettihye ofen hammincha lo lehitnaheg immi beachva ella kemishpat hamekabbelim pene haggedolim shello yerau fenehem rekam, velaze tzarich lehitratztzot lakachat minchati, shezzulat ze yaggid hafechiyyut haratzon vehachibba:

Veim lachashashat shello yamit mehono shel yaakov, laze amar ki "channani elohim vechi yesh li chol". perush amro kol, ulay sheyyechavven lomar ki hammincha shehevi lo enah poretzet pirtza binchasav, veachar shennatan lo ma shennatan lo bammincha, nisharim nechasav kaasher hayu mikkodem kullam bishlemut belo machsor, vehaven.

Od yirmoz beamro kol shehi bechinat hakkedushsha shennikret kol, uvechina zo keshettihye musseget baadam en hachissaron ose roshem vehechaser nishlam meatzmo, uchevirkat yisrael kachol shehechaser nishlam meatzmo vehi birkat kol. vehu sod (Melachim 1 17:16) "kad hakkemach lo chalata". veayyen ma shepperashti befasuk (Bereshit 33:18) "vayyavo yaakov shalem". uveracha zo zachu bah kol haavot: avraham bakkol, yitzchak mikkol, yaakov kol (bava batra 47.). veze sodah. umeatta noten taam tov beamro "kach na et birchati vegomer ki channani elohim vechi yesh li chol" vehannechsar nishlam meatzmo.

rashi: Vayyigga bechaf yerecho. kulit hayyarech hattakua bekkalbusit karuy kaf, ashe shehabbasar shealeha kemin kaf shel kedera:
Vatteka. nitkakea mimmekom machbartah, vedome lo pen teka nafshi mimmech (Yirmeyahu 6), leshon hasara. uvemishna lekakea betzatan – lesharesh sharshehen:

Vayyikra lo el elohe yisrael. lo shehammizbeach karuy elohe yisrael ella al shem shehaya hakkabba immo vehitztzilo kara shem hammizbeach al shem hannes, lihyot shivcho shel makom nizkar bikriat hashshem, kelomar mi shehu el, hu hakkabba, hu lelohim li, sheshshemi yisrael. vechen matzinu bemoshe vayyikra shemo Adonai nissi (Shemot 17), lo shehammizbeach karuy Adonai, ella al shem hannes kara shem hammizbeach lehazekir shivcho shel hakkadosh baruch hu, Adonai hu nissi. verabbotenu darshu shehakkabba kerao leyaakov el (Megila 18); vedivre tora kefattish yefotzetz sala (70 shabbat 88) – mitchallekim lechamma teamim, vaani leyashshev peshuto shel mikra bati:

Mi lecha kol hammachane. mi kol hammachane asher pagashti, shehu shellecha? kelomar lamma hu lecha? peshuto shel mikra al moliche hammincha, umidrasho kittot shel malachim paga, shehayu dochafin oto veet anashav veomrim lahem shel mi attem? vehem omrim lahem shel esav, vehem omrim hakku, hakku, veellu omrim hannichu, beno shel yitzchak hu, velo hayu mashgichim alav; ben beno shel avraham hu, velo hayu mashgichin; achiv shel yaakov hu, omrim lahem im ken, mishshellanu attem:
Vealu. sare yisrael moshiim behar tziyyon:
Lishpot et har esav. lippara mehar esav asher asu leyisrael. lishpot 645 belaaz:
Har esav. targum yonatan: karka rabba deesav:
Vehayta laAdonai hammelucha. limmedcha sheen malchuto shelema ad sheyyippara meamalek:
targum: Veyiskun meshezvin betura detzion lemedan yat kerakka deesav vetitgele malchuta dayya al kol yatve ara:

rashi: Vayyishlach yaakov malachim. malachim mammash (Bereshit Rabba):
Artza seir. leeretz seir kol teva shetztzericha lamed bittechillatah hetil lah hakkatuv hei besofah:
ohc: Vayyishlach. tzarich ledakdek amro lefanav lelo tzorech. gam lamma hutzrach lomar tevat achiv ki yadua hu sheesav hu achiv. gam lamma hutzrach lehazekir artza seir sede vegomer, ki hashshelichut lo yishtanne im yihye sham o bemakom acher. veod dikdek lomar artza velo amar leeretz, vahagam sheamru zichrono livracha (yevamot 13:) kol makom shetztzarich lamed vechulei, af al pi chen halo davar hu sheggorem shinnuy.

Achen kavvanat hakkatuv hi latet taam leamro vayyishlach malachim, lamma yishtammesh bimsharte elyon lelo tzorech, ki yachol asot haddavar al yede mesharte adam gam bene ish? laze amar lefanav, perush, letzad heyotam lefanav dan ki huresha lehishtammesh bahem laasher yitztarech lahem bedavar sheen yachol asot al yede bene adam. veamar ki hutzrach lahem letzad shehashshelichut hu el esav, vehu adam gadol kayyadua lefi divrehem zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 75), ushelichut acherim efshar shello yachshiv otam lahashivam. o efshar sheyyakdim lehakkotam mibbeli hashev veyavo al yaakov kaasher yide hannesher, ma sheen ken hammalachim. gam beemtzaut shelichutam yifchad verachav levavo biroto tzeva hashshamayim, ucheamram zichronam livracha (sham): "mehem levushe esh verochve susim" vechulei ad kan, shebbaze yira leval asot ra.
Veamro el achiv, perush: taam hishtaddeluto bishlichut ze bederech shalom verabbanut, letzad heyoto achiv, vehaya chash shello yikkanes immo bemilchama shemma yaamdu lo zechut avotav.

O yirtze al ze hadderech: el esav shehu sone, el achiv sheeno sone. perush, sheyyaasu hashshelichut leerech asher yimtzauhu: im yimtzauhu shehu sone tihye hashshelichut beofen echad, veim yiru ki hu achiv tihye hashshelichut beofen acher. vedavar ze lo yuchelu havin zulat hammalachim, ki haanashim yachol lehateotam.

O yirtze shennitkavven lehakedim lishloach hu sheluchav kodem sheyyeda esav mehazzulat ki va yaakov, al derech amram zichronam livracha (sota ma:) "kaddemehu larasha" vechulei. asher al ken bachar lishloach hammalachim shello yitztarchu lahalicha, uvammakom shehem shamma yaasu shelichutam, ki chol haolam kearba ammotam. vehu amro vayyishlach malachim, hattaam lefanav el esav vegomer, perush: hem odam omdim lefanav vehem osim shelichutam el esav achiv, hagam shehu bemakom rachok. vehu amro artza seir, velaze lo amar "leeretz", ki lo yitztarchu lalechet ella yachzeru penehem vidabberu im esav, uvemaamadam yaamodu veyachzeru lo hatteshuva, vehaven. veamro sede edom perush: kodem sheyyetze mimmekomo esav yaggiuhu bashshelichut, ki mekom moshavo yikkare sede edom:

Uvederech remez yechavven hakkatuv lirmoz shelosha zemannim sheyyishtannu vahem bene esav: haechad yihyu yaakov veesav bemiddat haachva, vehu amro esav achiv, veze haya ad et hachurban. vahagam shehaya zeman shehaya edom tachat yad yisrael, ze haya zeman muat. vehashsheni mizzeman shennecherav habbayit ad et ketz, sheesav bemaala gedola veen maalat yisrael nikkeret lefanav, vehu sheramaz beamro artza seir befattach tachat haalef lehareot madrega elyona. vehashshelishi bayyamim hamekuvvim lanu shettihye edom yerushsha, vehu amro sede edom kesade techaresh.

rashi: Halo chachma tikra. halo hattora machrezet alechem devarim haamurim lematta bainyan:
targum: Metul hechna chachmeta tikra uveyuna tirme kala:

rashi: Veelle hammelachim vegomer. shemona hayu uchenegdan heemid yaakov uvittel malchut esav bimehem, ellu hen, shaul veish boshet, david ushelomo, rechavam, aviyya, asa, yehoshafat; uvime yoram beno katuv beyamav pasha edom mittachat yad yehuda vayyamlichu alehem melech (Melachim 2 8), uvime shaul katuv umelech en beedom nitztzav melech (Melachim 1 22):
ohc: Veelle hammelachim vegomer. yechavven baze limnot kol asher nitchatten leedom o heemid lah melech vechaddome, ki hakkol omed laavaddon binfol edom, ucheamram zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 83), batzra lefi sheheemida melech leedom atida lilkot immahem, dichtiv (Yeshayahu 34:6) "zevach laAdonai bevatzra", ad kan. gam shear hearim hagam shebbene bene kodem sheyyavo goel tzevi yisrael yikkansu birshut melech acher, yavou bene yisrael betaana keduma veyotziuha vetissaref, veen tzel hazzulat matztzilatah.

Gam lakachat siman laggeulla haatida ki yaarichu hayyamim, veharaya, ki Adonai mana malche edom shekkadmu lemalche yisrael, uchemotam kadmu malche yisrael lemalchutam achar sheppaska achar melachim harshumim battora, umeatta kemo chen yimlechu yisrael kamminyan asher malchu beedom (baggalut, haggaha), vahagam ki sheshet alafim olam omed (sanhedrin 99.), yaarich Adonai yeme tova, kemaamaram zichronam livracha.
Chassalat parashat vayyishlach

rashi: Neot lachem. nitratztze lachem, leshon vayyeotu (Melachim 2 12):
Lehimmol. lihyot nimmol. eno leshon lifol ella leshon lehippael:
Veal tishlachna vechelo. al tishlachna yadcha binchasav, ken tirgem yonatan. umikra katzar hu vetzarich lehosif alav yadcha:
targum: Udealta vetare ami beyom tevirhon vedachazeta af at bevishteh beyom tevireh udeoshitta yedach benichsohi beyom tevireh:

rashi: Izzim matayim uteyashim esrim. matayim izzim tzerichot esrim teyashim, vechen kullam, hazzecharim kede tzorech hannekevot; uvivra doresh mikkan laona haamura battora, hattayyalim bechol yom, happoalim shetayim beshabbat, hachammarim achat beshabbat, haggammalim achat lishloshim yom, hassappanim achat leshishsha chodashim; veeni yodea lechavven hammidrash hazze bechiuun, ach nire veenay shellamadnu mikkan sheen haona shava bechol adam ella lefi torach hammuttal alav, shemmatzinu kan shemmasar lechol tayish eser izzim vechen lechol ayil; lefi shehem penuyim mimmelacha darkam leharebot tashmish uleabber eser nekevot, uvehema mishshennitabbera enah mekabbelet zachar, ufarim sheoskin bimlacha, lo masar lezachar ella arba nekevot, velachamor sheholech bederech rechoka shete nekevot lezachar, velaggemallim sheholchim derech yoter rechoka nekeva achat lezachar:
ohc: Izzim matayim vegomer. shamati mimmori zekeni zecher tzaddik vekadosh livracha, shennitkavven yaakov becheshbon sheshshalach mibbaale chayyim kecheshbon seir sheole bo 580, velaze shalach becheshbon izzim urechelim 440 ugemallim sheloshim im benehem hem shishshim, hare 500, parot ufarim chamishshim, atonot vaayarim sheloshim hare 580, lishbor takpo.

rashi: Bat me zahav. mahu zahav? ashir haya, veen zahav chashuv beenav lichlum:

Niggash yosef verachel. bechullan haimmahot niggashot lifne habbanim, aval berachel yosef niggash lefaneha, amar immi yefat toar, shemma yitle vah enav oto rasha, eemod kenegdah vaaakkevennu millehistakkel bah; mikkan zacha yosef levirkat ale ayin:
Chelam. mamonam vechen asa li et hachayil hazze (Devarim 8), veyisrael ose chayil (Bamidbar 24), veazvu laacherim chelam (Tehillim 49):
Shavu. leshon sheviyya, lefichach taamo millera:

Vetimna hayta filegesh. lehodia gedullato shel avraham, kamma hayu teevim liddabbek bezaro. timna zo bat allufim hayta, shenneemar vaachot lotan timna, velotan meallufe yoshve seir haya min hachorim sheyyashvu vah lefanim, amra eni zocha lehinnase lecha, halevay veehye pilegesh. uvedivre hayyamim mone otah bevanav shel elifaz, melammed shebba al ishto shel seir veyatza timna mibbenehem, uchesheggadla naaset pilagsho, vezehu vaachot lotan timna, velo menaah im bene seir shehayta achoto min haem velo min haav:
Kesita. maa. araa keshehalachti lichrakke hayyam hayu korin lemaa kesita (vetargumo churefan – tovim, charifim bechol makom, kegon over lassocher):
Nafti mishkavi. hanifoti hareach, kemenif besudar bevet habbosem, lehavi hareach milmala lematta. vedunash peresh leshon kittur, veamar sheen lo dimyon:
targum: Raset al arsi mora vechurekma vekunema:

rashi: Ki ala hashshachar. vetzarich ani lomar shira bayyom (chullin 91):
Berachtani. hode li al habberachot shebberchani avi, sheesav mearer alehen:
ohc: Lo ashallechacha vegomer. ze hu sheamar "ki sarita vegomer vattuchol", ki mashal bo velo haya hammalach yachol lahaloch zulat retzono. veamro ki im berachtani perush shello yuzzak mittekiat yerecho. o letzad shehikkir bo heyoto malach hishtaddel sheyyevarchehu.

rashi: Chashka. chaftza:
ohc: Vaydabber chamor vegomer. amro lemor, ulay shennitkavven lomar shehu muchan laasot mishpat katuv din meannes habbetula latet kenas tzaar boshet ufegam, gam hu muchan lekachtah leishsha im yirtzu aviha veacheha, vehu amro tenu vegomer:

O yomar shennitkavven liftor atzmo mehakkenas, keditnan (ketuvot ma.) haomer "anasti, pittiti bitto shel peloni" – eno meshallem hakkenas al pi atzmo, ad kan, laze amar lemor shechem beni vegomer, perush ki shechem mode meatzmo veomer sheshshachav im dina, uvaze patur mechiyyuv hakkatzuv shehu kenas ben bimfatte ben beones. veen lefaresh ki chamor hu meid al shechem, ki bedin bene noach yitchayyev habben beedut aviv (282 hilchot Melachim 9:14).

Panim el panim vegomer. taam hattemiha – lo sheraa malach, vahalo nigla elav kodem haelohim, ella shellacham im hammalach, vehu amro "panim el panim" leshon milchama, al derech amro (Melachim 2 14:8) "nitrae fanim".

rashi: Kum ale. lefi sheecharta badderech neenashta uva lecha zot mibbittecha (tanchuma):
ohc: Kum ale vegomer veshev sham vegomer. taam amro "veshev sham" perush: hagam shehu meeretz hakkenaani yoshev haaretz, shev sham velo tifchad mehem.
O yomar veshev sham velo teshev kan, ki shachiach hezzek sham bimkom happirtza.
O yirmoz al ze hadderech: veshev sham – perush, sham haya lecha lashevet velo bemakom ze, ki en rauy latet margoa leraglecha ad shamma, vaase mizbeach vegomer.

rashi: Beyom amadcha minneged. shello vata laazor lo:
Gam atta keachad mehem. aale ani alecha keillu atta min habbaim alehem:
targum: Beyom mekimach mikvel beyoma devazu ammaya nichsohi venichrain alu vekirvohi veal yerushelem remo advin af at kechad minhon:

rashi: Mohar. ketubba:
Chishsheva lehishshaver. nidmet keillu hi nishberet:
targum: Vayay arim ruach rav al yama vahava nachshol rav bayama veilfa baaya leittabbera:

rashi: Vehinne ishsha. kemashmaah. davar acher: echad min eppikorsim:
Shit zona. kemo "shetotehem" (Shmuel 2 10:4), kelomar: ervat zona:
Unetzurat lev. kemo "ir netzura" (yeshaya 1:8) hammukkefet karkom, vechen libbah shel zo mukkefet zimma ivvelet:
targum: Veha itteta leureeh beaskema diznayta demafreda libba deuleme:

rashi: Vayyira vayyetzer. vayyira shemma yehareg, vayyetzer lo im yaharog hu et acherim (Bereshit Rabba vetanchuma):
ohc: Vayyira yaakov vayyomer vegomer. perush: nichnas begeder laharog o lehareg, laze keneged lehareg yare meod, ucheneged laharog vayyetzer lo, velaze lo amar hakkatuv meod achar "vayyetzer".

Od yirtze ki letzad shehodiuhu ki esav maarim lehareot achva vehu sone, yare yaakov shello lehachin atzmo lammilchama, shemma esav yahargehu veen beyado shel yaakov kele kerav, ulehachin atzmo bichle kerav vayyetzer lo ki efshar shello yaase esav raa uchesheyyirehu muchan bichle kerav yomar esav, halo yaakov hu doresh raa uvaze yechaddesh sinato. velaze nitchakkem vayyachatz vegomer perush chatza haam: chatzi harishon marim pene ahava vechibba keach leachiv, vachatzi machanehu muchan umezuyyan:

rashi: Hammachane haachat vehikkahu. machane meshammesh leshon zachar uleshon nekeva, im tachane alay machane (tehillim 27), hare nekeva, hammachane hazze (Bereshit 33), zachar, vechen yesh shear devarim meshammeshim leshon zachar uleshon nekeva, hashshemesh yatza al haaretz (Bereshit 19:23), miktze hashshamayim motzao (tehillim 19), hare leshon zachar; vehashshemesh zarcha al hammayim (Melachim 2 3), hare leshon nekeva. vechen ruach, vehinne ruach gedola baa, hare leshon nekeva, vayyigga bearba pinnot habbayit (Iyov 1), hare leshon zachar, veruach gedola vechazak mefarek harim (Melachim 1 19), hare leshon zachar uleshon nekeva. vechen esh, veesh yatza meet Adonai (Bamidbar 16), leshon nekeva, esh lohet (Tehillim 104), leshon zachar:

Vehaya hammachane hannishar lifleta. al karcho, ki ellachem immo. hitkin atzmo lishlosha devarim, ledoron, litfilla ulemilchama. ledoron, vattaavor hammincha al panav; litfilla, elohe avi avraham; lemilchama, vehaya hammachane hannishar lifleta:
ohc: Vayyomer im yavo vegomer. perush: im yavo esav bemilchama vehikka machane harishon, yihye machane sheni shehechin lemilchama lifleta. kesheyyatchil hu veyire ki hu sone, yihye vadday machane happalit shehechin bichle zayin vifallet atzmo, veulay sheggam machane harishon yimmalet leval yechallehu. vehakkol asa yaakov behitbonnut leval yitztarech lenes vaAdonai yigmor baado.

rashi: Vechattu gibborecha teman. yechattu veyifchadu lanus el eretz yishmael. vetargum yonatan: veyitbarun gibbarach yatve ara deroma:
Lemaan yikkaret. kol ish gibbor:
Mehar esav mikkatel. merov hereg sheyyavo alechem:
targum: Veyittabberun gibbarach yatve daroma bedil deyishtetze gevar deveh tzorva mikkerakka deesav miktol:

rashi: Kaasher shetitem al har kadshi. kema dachaditun al mechat tura dekudeshi:
Velau. ketargumo: veyistalamun, leshon mehuma veshimmamon veteruf daat, 896 belaaz:
targum: Are kema dachadetun al mechat tura dekudeshi yishtun kol ammaya kes pureanutehon tedira veyishtun veyistalamun vihon kidla havo:

rashi: Vayyizrach lo hashshemesh. leshon bene adam hu keshehigganu lemakom peloni heir lanu hashshachar, zehu feshuto; umia vayyizrach lo letzarko – lerappeot et tzalato, kema detema shemesh tzedaka umarpe bichnafeha (Malachi 3); veotan shaot shemmihara lishkoa bishvilo kesheyyatza mibbeer sheva mihara lizroach bishvilo:
Vehu tzolea. haya tzolea keshezzarcha hashshemesh:
ohc: Kaasher avar et penuel. ulay ki lo yikra shem hammakom peniel ella yaakov levad, aval kol chutz mimmennu vaafillu devar tora tikraehu penuel, vechen nikra beshoftim (8:8).

rashi: Veamarta leavdecha leyaakov. al rishon rishon veal acharon acharon; sheshshaalta lemi atta? leavdecha leyaakov ani – vetargumo deavdach deyaakov – vesheshshaalta ulemi elle lefanecha, mincha hi shelucha vegomer:
Vehinne gam hiv. yaakov:
ohc: Veamarta leavdecha vegomer. perush: keneged amro "lemi atta" – teshuva shel "avdecha yaakov", keneged "veana telech" – leholich mincha, vehu amro "mincha shelucha", ucheneged "ulemi" – "ladoni leesav".

rashi: Nisa. kemo shima, silcha, shehu kemo shema, selach, af kan nisa kemo nesa, vehannun yesod batteva, vetargum shel unkelos tul unehach, esav amar leyaakov nesa mikkan venelech:
Veelcha lenegdecha. beshave lecha; tova zo eese lecha, sheaarich yeme mahalachti, lalechet leat kaasher atta tzarich, vezehu lenegdecha – beshave lecha:
Veyarshu hannegev. yisrael shehayu yoshvin bidromah shel eretz yisrael yirshu et har esav shehu bemetzar darom, uvene hashshefela yirshu et eretz pelishtim veet har efrayim veet har shomron:
Uvinyamin et haggilad. uvene menashshe shehayta eretz gilad shellahem yifshetu lahem mehalea ligvuloteha shel eretz yisrael bemizrachah:
targum: Veyachsenun yatve daroma yat kerakka deesav veyatve shefelta yat ara diflishtae veyachsenun yat kirve efrayim veyat kirve shomron udevet binyamin yat yatve ara degilad:

rashi: Vayyelech el eretz. lagur baasher yimtza:
Yaavor na adoni. al na taarich yeme halichatcha, avor kefi darkecha veaf im titrachek:
Etnahala. etnahel, hei yetera, kemo erda, eshmea:
Leitti. leat shelli, leshon nachat, haholchim leat, leat li lannaar (Shmuel 2 18). leitti hallamed min hayesod, veenah meshammeshet – etnahel nachat shelli:
Leregel hammelacha. lefi tzorech halichat ragle hammelacha hammuttelet alay leholich:
Uleregel hayeladim. lefi raglehem shehem yecholim lelech:

Ad asher avo el adoni seira. hirchiv lo hadderech, shello haya dato lalechet ella ad sukkot; amar im dato laasot li raa, yamtin ad boi etzlo, vehu lo halach; veematay yelech? bime hammashiach (Bereshit Rabba), shenneemar vealu moshiim behar tziyyon lishpot et har esav (Ovadya 1); umia yesh lefarasha zo rabbim:

Hammakke et midyan bisde moav. shebbau midyan al moav lammilchama, vehalach melech edom laazor et moav; umikkan anu lemedim, shehayu midyan umoav merivim ze im ze, uvime vilam asu shalom lehitkashsher al yisrael:
Nivu. targum yonatan: itgalyayn, uleshon aramit nivu nitbakkeshu, vechen "im tivayun beayu" (Yeshayahu 21:12):
targum: Echden itbelesh esav itgalyan matmorohi:

rashi: Vayyigva yitzchak. en mukdam umeuchar battora; mechirato shel yosef kadma lemitato shel yitzchak 12 shana, shehare keshennolad yaakov haya yitzchak ben shishshim shana, shenneemar veyitzchak ben shishshim shana vegomer, veyitzchak met bishnat 120 leyaakov – im totzi shishshim mimmea ushemonim shana nisharu 120 – veyosef nimkar ben 17 shana, veotah shana shenat mea ushemone leyaakov, ketzad? ben shishshim veshalosh nitbarech, arba esre shana nitman bevet ever, hare shivim vesheva, vearba esre avad beishsha, uvesof arba esre nolad yosef, shenneemar vayhi kaasher yalda rachel et yosef vegomer, hare tishim veachat, veyz ad shello nimkar yosef, hare mea ushemone (od meforash min hammikra mishshennimkar yosef ad shebba yaakov mitzrayima 22 shana shenne, veyosef ben sheloshim shana vegomer, vez shanim sava ushenatayim raav, hare 22, uchetiv yeme shene meguray sheloshim umeat shana, nimtza yaakov bimchirato 108):

Kivrat haaretz. menachem peresh leshon kabbir, ribbuy, mahalach rav. veaggada, bizman shehaaretz chalula umenukkevet kichvara (Bereshit Rabba), shehannir matzuy, hassetav avar vehashsharav adayin lo va (sham 7), veen ze peshuto shel mikra, shehare benaaman matzinu vayyelech meitto kivrat aretz (Melachim 2 Adonai). veomer ani shehu shem middat karka, kemo mahalach parsa o yoter, kemo sheatta omer tzemed kerem (Yeshayahu Adonai), chelkat hassade (Bereshit 33), kach bemahalach adam noten shem midda kivrat eretz:
Tzeror hakkesef. hattovim shebbahem harag:
Leyom hakkese. lizman hammoed hakkavua, vechen "bakkese leyom chaggenu" (tehillim 81:4):
targum: Tzerara dechaspa nesav bideh uleyoma deeda ate levayteh:

rashi: Ki Adonai dibber. vehechan dibber? "veyerd miyyaakov veheevid sarid vegomer" (Bamidbar 24:19):
targum: Vihon devet yaakov tekifin keeshata udevet yosef chasinin keshalhovita udevet esav chalashin kekasha veyishletun behon veyiktelonunun vela yehe shezva levet esav are Adonai gezir ken:

rashi: Et asher lo. habbehema vehammittaltelim; asa atzmo kegashshar notel mikkan umanniach kan (Bereshit Rabba):
Zivche shelamim alay. kelomar: seudda gedola hachinoti, ki hayyom hikravti nedaray ushelamay:
targum: Divche dekarbane alay yomana shalmet nidray:

rashi: Ad haggevul shillechucha. otam shehivtichucha leezra bau immecha veliuucha ad gevul artzecha ad hassefar, sheshsham bau alecha lammilchama, uvezot hissiucha vehitzlichu:
Yachlu lecha. lefattotcha latzet veshavu meacharecha:
Lachmecha yasimu mazor tachtecha. af maachalcha sam lecha achicha yaakov lemazor, shennatan lecha lechem unezid adashim veal yado bazita habbechora:
Mazor. choli:
targum: Min techumach agleyuch kol enasha keyamach atayuch yechilu lach anshe shelamach achle fetorach shaviu takla techotach midlet bach sucheltanu:

rashi: Mamre. shem hammishor:
Kiryat haarba. shem hair:

Mamre kiryat haarba. el mishor shel kiryat arba. veitto haya lo lichtov mamre hakkiryat arba? ken derech hammikra bechol davar sheshshemo kaful, kegon ze, uchegon bet lechem, avi ezer, bet el, im hutzrach lehattil bo hei, notnah berosh hatteva hashsheniyya – bet hallachmi (Shmuel 1 16), beafrat avi haezri (Shoftim 6), bana chiel bet haeli (Melachim 1 16):
Shimu ki negidim adabber. divre negidut vachashivut:
targum: Shemau metul dishriruta memalla ana umemalel pumi teritzuta:

ohc: Ad boam. perush sheshshalach lahem vehaya mamtin boam.

Vayyihyu yeme yitzchak vegomer. taam shello hizkir "chayyim" beyitzchak keminhag hakkatuv beavraham veyaakov, vegam beyosef hizkir chayyim dichtiv (Bereshit 50:22) "vaychi yosef", veulay ki leheyot shemmiyyom shennolad ad haakeda lo hayta lo bat zug, veamru zichronam livracha (Kohelet Rabba 9) hashsharuy belo ishsha sharuy belo chayyim, umeet haakeda amru zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 80 65) shehitchilu lichhot enav, laze lo hizkir bo chayyim.
O efshar, leheyot shello hevi immo chayyim ad haakeda lo hizkir bo chayyim.

Hu edom. amar ken shalosh peamim befarasha zo, leheyot shennishba Adonai leabbed edom, laze hizkir esav ki hu edom, vehizkir hair dichtiv (Bereshit 36:8) "behar seir hu edom", im eno inyan leesav tenehu inyan lair atzmah. vehizkir bene esav ki hem edom dichtiv (Bereshit 36:19) "veelle allufehem hu edom", lomar ki kullam yidleku baesh shel bet yaakov letzad shekkullam nikraim edom asher natan Adonai leyisrael, vegam esav atzmo, vehu ramuz bedivre razal (tanchuma, tzav; yerushalmi nedarim 3,5) sheamru atid esav lehitattef betzitzit veyavo veyeshev ben hatztzaddikim vehakkadosh baruch hu moshcho mishsham vechulei dichtiv (Ovadya 1:4) "veim ben kochavim vegomer mishsham" vegomer ad kan. veayyen ma shekkatavti befasuk (Bereshit 36:31) "veelle hammelachim":

rashi: Chazon ovadya. may shena ovadya leedom velo nibba nevua acheret? amru chachamim: ovadya ger adomi haya. amar hakkadosh baruch hu: mehem uvahem avi alehem. yavo ovadya sheddar ben shene reshaim, achav veizevel, velo lamad mimmaasehem, veyifra meesav harasha sheddar ben shene tzaddikim, yitzchak verivka, velo lamad mimmaasehem:
targum: Nevuat ovadya kidnan amar Adonai elohim leedom besora shemana min kodam Adonai veizgad beammaya sheliach kumu venitattad alah likrava:

rashi: Hinne katon netatticha. kelappe shekkerao aviv beno haggadol veimmo benah haggadol, amar hakkadosh baruch hu: lefanay katon hu. rabbotenu darshu: katon - shello haya lahem lo ketav velo lashon:
Bazuy. shello hayu maamidin melech ben melech:
targum: Ha chalash yehavtach beammaya besir at lachada:

rashi: Behimmol. bihyot nimmol:
Vayyomer lamma ze. taase li tova zo sheeni tzarich lah:
Emtza chen beene adoni. velo teshallem li atta shum gemul:
ohc: Lamma ze emtza vegomer. perush, lamma hu maflig ahavato immo bifrat ze, yoter hu bocher sheyyatmid immo metziut chen leatid measot lo ze, vehu amro "emtza chen beene adoni" leshon atid.

rashi: Magdiel. hi romi:

Gid hannashe. lamma nikra shemo gid hannashe? lefi shennasha mimmekomo veala, vehu leshon kefitza, vechen nashta gevuratam (Yirmeyahu nusach acher), vechen ki nashshani elohim et kol amali (Bereshit 41):
ohc: Al ken lo yochlu vegomer. perush: letzad shennizdaza haggid mimmekor hakkedushsha veshalat bo hakkelippa, bechina zo bechol makom shehi nitmea, vaasarah habbore ki hu hayyodea. vetimtza sod baze ki gid ze en bo taam, vehu siman livchinat hakkelippa, ki en bah taam kevan shenneekra kedushsha mimmennu. veyesh baze peshatim lomar, ella shehaikkar kemo shekkatavti.

Veim lo tishmeu vegomer. nitchakkemu gam baze shello yomru sheim lo yaasu chen hinne hem orchim ittam milchama ulenokme nakam yihyu lahem, laze amru ki im lo yishmeu vegomer yikchu bittam veyelchu lahem, veen kan nokme nakam. gam nitchakkemu baze lehareot ketzat hakepada baddavar shello yeshvu sham immahem, vezulat ze im lo yazkiru shum hergesh baddavar yachshov hachoshev ki arma baddavar ki hainyan haya megunne kefi haemet, keamro "vechen lo yease" afillu ben haummot, laze gillu ketzat hakepada, umuvanim lahem haddevarim beinyan nachon ki achar sheyyimmolu peshita sheyyihye kesher ammitz benehem shalom vereut, velaze timtza sheamar shechem vachamor livne iram "haanashim haelle shelemim hem" vegomer (Bereshit 34:21), perush shehirgish mehem sheen arma baddavar.

Od yirtze beamro velakachnu et bittenu, nitkavvenu lehachem levavo shel chamor ushechem lemaher laasot davar, kesheyyiru shehem molichin habbat mimmennu yemaher laasot davar, veyinkemu nikmat hatztzaddeket mizzera mereim.

rashi: Banu el achicha el esav. shehayita omer achi hu, aval hu noheg immecha keesav harasha, odennu besinato (Bereshit Rabba 80):
ohc: Vayyashuvu hammalachim. perush: heshivuhu teshuva veamru lo banu el achicha, perush, hu mare panim heyot achicha, uchefi haemet hu esav harashum besina, vegam holech likratcha vegomer, perush, holech likratcha bederech achva vearba meot ish immo lemachshava raa.

Od yirtze banu el achicha behoraat panim tzehuvot, veherenu lo gam ken panim shel zaam letzad heyoto kefi haemet esav belo achva, vehu al derech amram zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba perek 75) sheherahu machanot rochve esh vechulei lehafechido im lo yitnaheg bemiddat haachva. vetaam shello hechlitu hashshelichut beofen echad, letzad shehaya mare befanav achva ulevavo lo chen yedamme, laze asu shene afne shelichut im letov im vechulei:

rashi: Velo yachla eretz megurehem. lehasepik mire labbehemot shellahem (202). umia: mippene yaakov achiv. mippene shetar chov shel gezerat "ki ger yihye zaracha" hammuttal al zaro shel yitzchak, amar elech li mikkan, en li chelek lo bammattana, shennittena lo haaretz hazzot, velo befiron hashshetar, umippene habbusha shemmachar bechorato:

ohc: Elle bene etzer vegomer. yirmoz hakkatuv al derech amram zichronam livracha (yalkut shemauni Mishlei 2): amra tora mippene ma banay aniyyim? amar lah hakkadosh baruch hu "lehanechil ohavay yesh veotzrotehem amalle" (Mishlei 8:21), perush ki beemtzaut yissurehen baolam hazze yirbe otzaram baolam habba. vehu amro elle bene etzer, perush otam shechafetzim leetzor otzar battov bannitzchi tzerichin baolam hazze lisbol yissurin. bilhan vegomer, umodia hakkatuv ki hayyissurin hem osim otzarot meleim kol tuv lemala beemtzautam. ucheyissure rabbi elazar ben rabbi shimon bar yochay (bava metzia 84:) shehaya kore otam "bou achay" vegomer, umeatta mi haish hechafetz chayyim haelyonim veleetzor otzrot hattov yimas baolam hazze uvetaanugav vikabbel alav bilhan vezaavan vaakan, targum tzara "aka", letov lo kol hayyamim ulemalleot otzrotav.

rashi: Vayyivvater yaakov. shachach pakkim ketannim vechazar alehem (chullin 91):

Vayyeavek ish. menachem pe vayyitapper ish, leshon avak, shehayu maalim afar beraglehem ay ninuam. veli nire shehu leshon vayyitkashsher, velashon arammi hu, batar daaviku veh, vaavek leh mevak – leshon aniva, shekken derech shenayim shemmitatztzemim lehappil ish et reehu, shechovko veovko bizrootav. ufershu razili shehu saro shel esav (Bereshit Rabba):

Veet achad asar yeladav. vedina hechan hayta? netanah beteva venaal befaneha, shello yitten bah esav enav, ulechach neenash yaakov shemmenaah meachiv, shemma tachazirennu lammutav, venafla beyad shechem (Bereshit Rabba):
Yabbok. shem hannahar:
Mechamas achicha yaakov. bishvil chamas sheasita leyaakov:
targum: Mechatof achuch yaakov tachpinach bihata vetishtetze laalam:

rashi: Lemi atta. shel mi atta, mi sholchacha, vetargum deman at?

Ulemi elle lefanecha. veelle shellefanecha shel mi hem; lemi hammincha hazzot shelucha? lamed meshammeshet berosh hatteva bimkom shel, kemo: vechol asher atta roe li hu (Bereshit 31:43) – shelli hu; laAdonai haaretz umeloah (Tehillim 24) – shel Adonai:
ohc: Vaytzav et vegomer lemor. amro lemor lelo tzorech, perush, hagam shello yishal benosach ze, ella sheyyomar hashsheela belashon sheyyihye muvan mimmennu sheshshoel ken.

O yomar sheyyitchayyevu lehashiv hagam shello tihye hashsheela mippe el pe alehem, ella sheyyishal hu lezulat vehazzulat yishal otam, vehu amro "usheelcha" hu, o sheyyomar lishol otcha. o al ze hadderech, "usheelcha" vetihye hashsheela lezulat lemor lecha.

rashi: Marbaddim. bigde chofesh venoy, vedugmato besof hassefer, shenneemar "marvaddim asta lah" (Mishlei 31:22):
Ravadti arsi. kishshatti:

Chatuvot etun mitzrayim. mehullalot bigde kele fishtan chashuvin habbaim mimmitzrayim, sheshsham happishtan matzuy, kedichtiv besefer (Yeshayahu 19:9) "uvoshu ovde fishtim". etun targum "metrehem" (Shemot 35:18) "atunehon":
targum: Betashvayata shavyet arsi uvikrama kerimta mitzraa:

rashi: Vegalut hachel hazze. tirgem yonatan: amma haden. hachel leshon chayil, kemo "vayyavo yerushalayim bechel kaved" (Yeshayahu 36:2) deravshake, ella shezze chaser yod. veyesh od lefaresh hachel hazze - galut haggay hazze:
Livne yisrael asher kenaanim ad tzarfat. galut asher hu mibbene yisrael sheggalu measeret hashshevatim leeretz kenaanim ad tzarfat:

Vegalut yerushala͏m asher bisfarad. shehem mibbene yehuda asher galu lisfarad, hem yirshu et are hannegev shebbidromah shel eretz yisrael. veomrim happotrim: tzarfat hu hammalchut shekkorin 421 belaaz. sefarad tirgem yonatan: asepameya:
targum: Vegalut ama haden divne yisrael divara chenaanae ad tzarfat vegalut yerushelem divaspamya yachsenun yat kirve ara dedaroma:

rashi: Hachezona. hefker:
Et achotenu. yat achatana:
ohc: Vayyomru hachezona vegomer. tzarich ladaat ma teshuva zo osa lemechush yaakov al hashemadato hu uveto, vahalo afillu lechattechilla im shaalu haggoyim achat mehakkat veyichaduha, notnim otah lahem (yerushalmi terumot 8:4:11) velo yehargu kullan aleha afillu baarayot, umikkol shekken bederech ze shekkevar haya ma shehaya.

Veulay sheyyechavvenu lomar ki lo yachush al haddavar, ki lo yarishu ella im hayu horgim belo sibba, aval hariga zo lesibba reuya hayta, shellakach achotenu beal karchah vaasaah zona, vehu amram "hachezona yaase et achotenu". veen hakkavvana shechayyav al hazzenut, shehare penuya hayta, uven noach eno metzuvve ella al eshet chavero vezachar uvehema chayya veof vaachoto meimmo.

O yirtze lehashiv ki adrabba yistakkenu ben haummot kesheyyiru shebbazuy echad shalat bevat yaakov ufaal veasa kecheftzo uretzono, lo tihye lesonehem tekuma ben haammim, veadrabba baze tihye chittatam al haammim veyiradu mippenehem.

rashi: Bishkon yisrael baaretz hahi. ad shello va lechevron etzel yitzchak eruhu chol elle:

Vayyishkav. mittoch shebbilbel mishkavo, maale alav hakkatuv keillu shechavah; velamma vilbel vechillel yetzuav? shekkeshemmeta rachel natal yaakov mittato, shehayta netuna tadir beohel rachel velo bishar ohalim, unetanah beohel bilha; ba reuven vetava elbon immo, amar im achot immi hayta tzara leimmi, shifchat achot immi tehe tzara leimmi? lechach bilbel (shabbat 55):

Vayyihyu vene yaakov shenem asar. matchil leinyan rishon, mishshennolad binyamin nishlema hammitta umeatta reuyim lehimmanot, umenaan; verabbotenu darshu, lelammedenu va, shekkullan shavin vechullan tzaddikim, shello chata reuven:
Alot alay. hatztzon vehabbakar, shehen alot, muttalot alay lenahalan leat:
Alot. megaddelot ollehen, leshon olel veyonek (Eicha 2), ul yamim (Yeshayahu 65), ushete farot alot (Shmuel 1 6) uvelaaz 510:
Udefakum yom echad. leyaggeam badderech bimrutza vametu kol hatztzon:
Udefakum. kemo kol dodi dofek (Shir HaShirim), nokesh baddelet:

Shochni vechagve sela. somech al mishenet avotav avraham veyitzchak, vehem lo yoilu lo. chagve kemo "vehayta admat yehuda lemitzrayim lechagga" (Yeshayahu 19:17), 302 belaaz. veal titma al vav shel chagve shehi kevav shel ketzave (tehillim 65:6) uchevav shel kimtachave (Bereshit 21:16), sheen yesod batteva ella tet vechet:
targum: Resha libbach atayach deat dame lenishra deshare veshine chefa beroma motveh amar belibbeh man yachatinani leara:

rashi: Ucheeches. ze eres nachash:
El musar evil. kenachash hammemaher larutz bishlichut hakkadosh baruch hu leyasser haevil, hamechuyyav lammakom baruch hu, ken ze ratz achareha ad shennichshal bah, vayfallach chitztzah et kevedo:
targum: Vehu azel batraa sheliyait hech tura deazel levat tivcha vehech kalba leisura:

rashi: Veal taamod al happerek. makom shehabborchim yotzim derech sham limmalet, uvilshon laaz korim oto 218:
targum: Udekamta al pirka leshetzaa yat mearkohi vedimsarta meshezvohi beidan aka:

rashi: Eder eder levaddo. kol min vamin leatzmo:
Ivru lefanay. derech yom o pachot vaani avo acharechem:
Verevach tasimu. eder lifne chavero melo ayin, kede lehasebia eno shel oto rasha uletavvehu al ribbuy haddoron:
Hannechar. sheyyesh beyedchem mishshalal shel shechem:
Vehittaharu. meaza:
Vehachalifu simlotechem. shemma yesh beyedchem kesut shel aza:
ohc: Hasiru et elohe hannechar. perush, leheyot sheratza yaakov lissa mehammakom hahu, chash shemma yikchu beyadam meelohe haammim veyihyu birshutam, veleheyot shello hayu immahem mehaummot sheyyevattelu otam kodem sheyyavou levetam, en lahem bittul al yede yisrael.

Veim tomar lamma lo bittelu otam neshe anshe shechem kodem shebbau leyadam, keamram zichronam livracha (avoda zara mag.) goy mevattel avoda zara beal karcho vaafillu avoda zara shel chavero? veyesh lomar ki hannashim dinam kiktannim veen hakketannim mevattelim avoda zara, uchemo deamrinan bemassechet avoda zara daf 43 veamru sham veze leshonam: ushema minnah hayyodea betiv vechulei vesheeno yodea betiv avoda zara umeshammesheha eno mevattel, ad kan, vehannashim dinam kekatan. o efshar shello hayu medakdekim shello yaggiu leyadam ad sheyyevattelu otam. o shehayu avoda zara nistarim bakkelim vechaddome, velo hayu nikkarim etzlam letakken bittulam kodem sheyyaggiu leyadam, veal ze tzivva yaakov livdok lehasir hakkiur. o ulay shennitarva avoda zara o tashmish avoda zara shello nitbattelu veneesru hakkol.

Veamar lahem sheyyittaharu mimmagga avar, ki avoda zara metammea adam vechelim. veamro vehachalifu vegomer, al derech ma shekkatav harambam beferek 6 mehilchot avot hattuma veze leshono: kol av hattuma shemmetamme bemagga uvemassa, ben av vechulei, adam hannogea bo o hannoso metamme begadim bishat maggao vechulei, ad kan. laze amar lahem sheafillu lo nagu hassemalot baavoda zara, hare hem temeim utzerichin lehachelifam. velaze dikdek lomar simlotechem, perush, otam shehayu alehem beet shebbazzu habbizza shehayu bahem avoda zara.

Veim tomar: lamma yachush lehachelafat begadim, vahalo en adam vechelim mekabbelin tuma ella meav hattuma, uvegadim ellu lu yehe shennagu baavoda zara atzmah, enam naasim av hattuma veenam metammeim adam? yerae, kevan shemmatzinu keriat shem laavoda zara metim, dichtiv (Tehillim 106:28) "vayyochlu zivche metim", umatzinu sheamra tora (chullin 3.) cherev hare hu kechalal, vechatav harambam beferek Adonai mehilchot tumat met veze leshono: vehu haddin lishar kelim vechulei uvegadim, ad kan, im ken naasu habbegadim ketumat avoda zara atzmah, velaze yetzav hatztzaddik lehachelif habbegadim.

rashi: Cherpa hiv. shemetz pesul hiv etzlenu; habba lecharef chavero hiv omer lo arel atta o ben arel. cherpa bechol makom gidduf:
Shene vene yaakov. banav hayu, veaappi chen nahagu atzman shimon velevi kishar anashim sheenam banav, shello natlu etza hemennu (Bereshit Rabba):
Ache dina. lefi shemmasru atzman aleha nikreu acheha:
Betach. shehayu choavim umia betuchim hayu al kocho shel zaken (Bereshit Rabba):
ohc: Vayyahargu kol zachar veet chamor vegomer. kashe, lamma yahargu mi shello chata? veod, lamma lo hikdimu bevaal avera techilla?

Achen hinne bene yaakov lo haya bedatam laharog ella baal avera, ella shekkol bene hair ratzu laamod bapperetz kenegdam leval yahargu malkam, asher al ken haragum middin rodef, vehu amro vayyahargu kol zachar, uvaze hissigu laharog et chamor veet shechem, vezulat ze lo hayu yecholin linkom nakam mehamechuyyav lahem mita.
Od taam shehargu kol bene hair, letzad shehem hayu beezer shechem ligzol dina, uvene noach mechuyyavim mita al haggazel, aval al haarayot en chiyyuv ki dina lo hayta eshet ish.

Vetimtza sheamar hakkatuv "asher timmeu achotam" (Bereshit 34:26), hare kinna hammaase lechullam. ha lamadta sheyyad kullam shava baggezela. vetaam shello amar "asher gazlu achotam" shehu ikkar heavon shealav nitchayyevu mita, lomar shehi gezela sheenah bahashava. venafka minnah im lo taam "asher timmeu" lo hayu osim mishpat gamur laharog kol zachar, vahagam shebben noach sheggazal eno niftar mimmita behishshavon, im kol ze lo hayu bene yaakov horgim. umide dahava kamma mehaummot ovre dat hammitzvot veen achrayutam al bene yaakov ki en koach bahem, uchemo sheamar yaakov (Bereshit 34:30) "achartem oti vegomer vaani mete mispar", ella letzad hannevala sheasu shettimmeu, laze lavshu kina.

Od taam amro asher timmeu – natnu taam ze lilkichat mamonam, veamar taam asher bazzu et hair venatlu nichsehem asher timmeu et dina achotam. perush, deme boshet, ki lefi shiur hamevayyesh vehammitbayyesh, ki hem hadderagot muflagot, ulevay sheyyaspik kol chelam lidme boshet bat yaakov hameyuchad baolam berum hammaalot mechamor hannivze ad meod. vegam lefi ma shekkatavti lemala shehoda bammaase, ze lo yoil ella liftor mehakkenas, aval boshet ushear devarim chayyav (ketuvot ma:), ufashut.

Verambam beferek 9 mehilchot melachim (hilchot Melachim 9:14) natan taam laharigat anshe shechem, letzad shello hoshivu dayyanim al gezel shechem vechulei ad kan. vekashe, mi amar leharav shechayyavin ladun haallam alehem, melech vechayyotze bo, vahalo gam bedine yisrael peturim mikkayyotze baze – lo danim velo meidin oto (sanhedrin 16.). uvehechreach lomar shehem hayu beozrav uvaatzatam asa ma sheasa. veramban zichrono livracha dacha divre rambam beferush mitzvat dayyanim shennitztauu bene noach, ki en hakkavvana lehoshiv dayyanim ella ladun mishpatim ben ish lereehu, yeuyyan sham devarav. venatan taam harigat shechem letzad shehayu chayyavin mita al shehayu ovde avoda zara vechulei. udevarav zichrono livracha tzerichin arev. ushene hammeorot lo natnu taam lilkichat mamonam vehonam.

rashi: Etzel pinna. pinna shel zona vaavodat gillulim:
targum: Aver beshuka likvel pintah uvearcha devaytah mehalech:

rashi: Lefi karet. tikra hannetuna al hashshaar, veyoshvim aleha:
Taronna. tizakna. uma hi omeret? alechem ishim ekra:
targum: Veal tare befuma dekirya uvemaalana detare mishtabbecha veamra:

rashi: Bau lecha. alecha:
Ech nidmeta. lamma nirdamta dumam ad shegganvu kol retzonam:
Halo botzrim yashiru olelot. veelle lo yashiru lecha kelum, ki yachpesucha vigallu veyidreshu matzpunecha:
targum: Im ganavim ato alach im bezoze lelya echden haveta damich ad dignavu misithon veim chatofin kekitufin atu alach hala masharin ollan:

rashi: Hetev etiv. hetev bizchutecha, etiv bizchut avotecha (Bereshit Rabba):

Vesamti et zaracha kechol hayyam. vehechan alo chen, vahalo lo alo ella vehaya zaracha kaafar haaretz (sham 28)? ella shealo ki lo eezavcha ad asher im asiti et asher dibbarti lach (sham), uleavraham amar vehareba arbe et zaracha kechochve hashshamayim vechachol asher al sefat hayyam:
Ada bat elon. hi basmat bat elon, venikret basmat al shem shehayta mekatteret besamim laaza:
Oholivama. hi yehudit, vehu chinna shemah yehudit lomar shehi koferet baaza kede lehateot et aviv:

Bat ana bat tzivon. im bat ana lo bat tzivon? ana beno shel tzivon, shenneemar veelle vene tzivon veayya vaana? melammed shebba tzivon al kallato eshet ana, veyatza oholivama mibben shenehem, vehodiacha hakkatuv shekkullan bene mamzerut hayu:

Birchati. minchati, mincha zo habbaa al reiyyat panim velifrakim ena vaa ella lishelat shalom, vechol beracha shehi liriyyat panim – kegon vayvarech yaakov et paro (Bereshit 47:7), asu itti veracha desancheriv (Melachim 2 18), vechen lishal lo leshalom ulevarcho detoi melech chamat (Shmuel 2 8) – kullam leshon birkat shalom hen, shekkorin belaaz shalevaayr, af zo birchati 96 340:
Asher huvat lach. lo tarachta bah vaani yagati lehaggiah ad shebbaa leyadcha (Bereshit Rabba):
Channani. nun rishona mudgeshet, lefi shehi meshammeshet bimkom shete nunin, shehaya lo lomar chananani, sheen chanon belo shete nunin, vehashshelishit leshimmush, kemo asani, zevadani:
Yesh li chol. kol sippuki; veesav dibber bilshon gaava yesh li rav, yoter veyoter mikkede tzarki:
Ani el shadday. sheani cheday levarech, shehabberachot shelli:
Pere ureve. al shem sheadayin lo nolad binyamin, veaf al pi shekkevar nitabbera mimmennu:
Goy. binyamin:
Goyim. menashshe veefrayim, sheatidim latzet miyyosef, vehem beminyan hashshevatim (Bereshit Rabba):

Umelachim. shaul veish boshet, shehayu mishshevet binyamin (Bereshit Rabba), sheadayin lo noldu (ufasuk ze derasho avner keshehimlich ish boshet, veaf hashshevatim derashuhu vekervu binyamin, dichtiv ish mimmennu lo yitten et bitto levinyamin leishsha (Shoftim 21), vechazru veamru ilmale haya ole min hashshevatim lo haya hakkabba omer leyaakov umelachim mechalatzecha yetzeu:
Goy ukehal goyim. sheggoyim atidim banav leheasot keminyan haggoyim, shehem 70 ummot, vechen kol hassanhedrin shivim; davar acher sheatidim banav lehakeriv bishat issur bamot kaggoyim bime eliyyahu):
Vaychabbekehu. nitgalgelu rachamav, kesheraahu mishtachave kol hishtachavaot hallalu:

Vayyishshakehu. nakud alav; veyesh cholkin baddavar hazze babbarayta desifre, yesh sheddarshu nekudda zo shello neshako bechol libbo, amar rabbi shimon ben yochay, halacha hi beyadua sheesav sone leyaakov, ella shennichmeru rachamav beotah shaa uneshako bechol libbo (sifre Bamidbar):
Et morashehem. nichse ammayya dahavo machsenin lehon:
targum: Uvetura detzion tehe meshezavta vihon kadishin veyachsenun devet yaakov nichse ammaya dahavo machsenin lehon:

rashi: Vayyashov bayyom hahu esav ledarko. esav levaddo, ved meot ish shehalchu immo nishmetu meetzlo echad echad, vehechan para lahem hakkabba? bime david, shenneemar ki im arba meot ish naar asher rachvu al haggemallim (Shmuel 1 30) (Bereshit Rabba):
Mi elle lach. mi elle lihyot shellecha:
Al na. al na tomar li ken:

Im na matzati chen beenecha velakachta minchati miyyadi ki al ken raiti fanecha vegomer. ki keday vehagun lecha shettekabbel minchati al asher raiti fanecha, vehen chashuvin li kiriyyat pene hammalach, sheraiti sar shellecha, veod al shennitratztzeta limchol al surchani. velamma hizkir lo reiyyat hammalach? kede sheyyityare hemennu veyomar raa malachim venitztzal, eni yachol lo meatta:

Vattirtzeni. nitpayyasta li, vechen kol ratzon shebbammikra leshon piyyus, apeyytzaymanetav belaaz, ki lo leratzon yihye lachem (Vayikra 22) – hakkarbanot baot lefayyes uleratztzot, vechen sifte tzaddik yedun ratzon (Mishlei 10) – yodim lefayyes uleratztzot:
Vayyishkav otah. kedarkah:
Vayanneha. shello chedarkah (Bereshit Rabba):
ohc: Nesi haaretz. perush, uvaze tzaaka hannaara veen moshia lah.

Vayyishkav otah vegomer. yitbaer al derech amram zichronam livracha (horayot 10:) bemaase yael, shehanaatam shel reshaim tzaar hu etzel hatztzaddikim, vehu amro "vayyishkav otah" – hagam sheshshachav otah kederech ish veishsha umin hatteva shettehane haishsha, af al pi chen lo millevad shello nehenet ella adrabba innuy haya lah, vehu amro vayanneha, vehayu haddevarim nikkarim bah sheen cheftzah bo, vehutzrach ledabber al libbah, dichtiv "vaydabber al lev" vegomer.

rashi: Shalem. shalem begufo, shennitrappe mitztzalato; shalem bemamono, shello chasar kelum mikkol oto doron; shalem betorato, shello shachach talmudo bevet lavan (shabbat 33):
Ir shechem. kemo leir, vechamohu ad boana bet lachem (Rut 1):
Bevoo mippaddan aram. keadam haomer lachavero yatza peloni mibben shinne arayot uva shalem, af kan vayyavo shalem mippaddan aram, millavan umeesav shenizdavvegu lo badderech:
ohc: Vayyavo yaakov shalem. tzarich ladaat ma kavvanato beamro shalem, verabbotenu zichronam livracha (shabbat log:) amru derashot. od tzarich ladaat kavvanat hakkatuv beamro bevoo mippaddan aram, en yadua hamechuvvan baze. verashi zichrono livracha peresh "keadam haomer" vechulei yeuyyan devarav, vedavar ze yadua hu missippurim hakkodmim.

Achen nire ki yodia hakkatuv ki ma shechisser minnechasav yaakov avinu bammincha asher natan leesav, hishlim Adonai chesrono minnechasav minnechasav shehevi mippaddan aram, vehu amro vayyavo yaakov shalem vegomer bevoo mippaddan vegomer, perush, shalem bannechasim keshiur boo mippaddan aram, vahagam shennikka mehem bemincha gedola, af al pi chen Adonai shillem lo, vehi birkat "kol" shennatan lo Adonai kemo shepperashti (Bereshit 33:11).

rashi: Vesoraret. sara min hadderech:
targum: Umaradta hi ufaridta beveta la shachnan riglaha:

rashi: Ki en haish beveto. reitem shessillek hakkadosh baruch hu shechinato, vechol tov natan leovde gillulim:
targum: Degavra let hu beveta ezel beorach rechika:

rashi: Katonti mikkol hachasadim. nitmaatu zechuyyotay al yede hachasadim vehaemet sheasita immi, lechach ani yare, shemma mishshehivtachtani nitkalkalti vechet veyigrom li lehimmaser beyad esav (shabbat 32):
Umikkol haemet. amittat devarecha, sheshshamarta li kol havetachot shehivtachtani:
Ki vemakli. lo haya immi lo chesef velo zahav velo mikne ella makli levaddo. umia natan maklo bayyarden venivka hayyarden:
ohc: Katonti vegomer. amro mikkol hachasadim veachar kach mikkol haemet, umin harauy haya lo lehakedim haemet veachar kach hachesed shehu lifnim mishshurat haddin, nitkavven lomar shechesed el en koach baadam leshallem leel elyon, veelav yikkare emet ki en lo tashlum meadam, keamro (Iyov 35:7) "im tzadakta ma titten lo", uchefi ze yikkare chesed shel emet al derech amram zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 96:5) chesed heasuy im hammetim karuy shel emet.

Od yechavven lomar shene perate hattava: haechad hachesed shennitchassed immo Adonai berov tov, vehashsheni sheheemido beyado velo netano lelavan legazlo ulechamso veshamar lo haemet, perush sheheemid beyado et hachesed. veyesh lecha ladaat ki lifamim yitchassed Adonai im adam veyihye nigzal mehazzulat lihyot bechiri, vaAdonai yashuv yerachamehu temurat hannechsar, vehinne metziut ze hu chatzi nechama lannigzal velo nechama shelema, ki tamid choshev bechesrono asher gezalo haggazlan lishte sibbot: haachat sheyyachshov ki im lo haya gozlo haya lo letosefet haggazul vehannosaf, vehashsheni al kol panim yichav libbo al haggazlan asher asa vehitzliach. ma sheen ken im yaase Adonai hashelamat haggezela mehaggazlan atzmo sheyyotzi balo mippiv, nechama zo nechama. vehu ma sheasa leyaakov shehaya meshallem lo minnichse gazlan atzmo hu lavan, dichtiv (Bereshit 31:9) "vayyatztzel Adonai et mikne avichem vayyitten li", shehaya motzi balo shel lavan mippiv umachzir mamono shel yaakov, vehu amro umikkol haemet, venachon.

rashi: Achartem. leshon mayim achurim, en dati tzelula achshav (berachot 25). veaggada, tzelula hayta hechavit vaachartem otah (Bereshit Rabba) – masoret hayta beyad kenaanim sheyyippelu beyad bene yaakov, ella shehayu omrim ad asher tifre venachalta et haaretz (Shemot 23), lefichach hayu shotkin:
Mete mispar. anashim muatim:
ohc: Vayyomer yaakov vegomer. nikkarim haddevarim ki yaakov lo yada ki bemirma zu dibberu, ella chashav shehammirma hayta kede sheyyikchu dina mibbeto beal karcho, o laharog shechem levad baal davar, lo laharog kol anshe hair yachad:

rashi: Bammakom asher dibber itto. eni yodea ma melammedenu:
Vaemtzaekka. kede sheemtzaekka:
targum: Metul hechna nefaket leureach demafcha havet leragsha vaamaret edberinach:

rashi: Ki gam ze. nosaf lecha al yosef; verabbotenu darshu: im kol shevet nolda teoma, veim binyamin nolda teoma yetera:
ohc: Al tiri ki gam vegomer. tzarich ladaat ma hi hammora shemmavtichatah alav shello tira, velichshennomar ki emot mavet hayu lah, bamme mesira mimmenna hammora beamrah ki gam ze vegomer? od tzarich ladaat ma kavvanatah beamrah "gam"?
