Achen yitbaer al derech amram zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 82:8) ki binyamin noldu immo shete teomot, ma shello noldu ken im yosef ki im teoma achat, ad kan. velaze "vayhi vehakeshotah" amra lah hameyalledet "al tiri" mimma sheat mitkashshet balleda shemma tistakkeni, ki yesh lach herayon meshunne meharishon, vehu amro ki gam betosefet ribbuy ze lach ken, keillu amar "ki gam ben ze lach".
Od tirmoz al pi ma sheyyadua (nidda lo.) ki hamekashsha leled beven zachar enah mistakkenet, vehamekashsha leled bevat hi mistakkenet, laze amra ki vadday gam ze lach ben velo tistakkeni.

rashi: Garti. lo naaseti sar vechashuv ella ger, encha keday lisno oti al birkat avicha shebberchani heve gevir leachecha, shehare lo nitkayyema vi. davar acher garti begimatriyya 613, kelomar, im lavan garti vetaryag mitzvot shamarti velo lamadti mimmaasav haraim:
ohc: Vaytzav otam lemor. tzarich ladaat lamma hutzrach lomar lemor achar sheamar "ko tomrun leesav". veulay sheyyechavven lomar sheyyomru elav shehu tzivva lomar elav basseder hazze, shezzulat ze yachshov ki hashsheluchim hem haomrim benosach ze lechashvam ki hu habbechor bivchorato umin hammusar ledabber ken, velo yatzu haddevarim mippi yaakov, laze tzivva alehem sheyyomru ki hu amar kaddevarim haelle, ukerao adon alav shebbaze yasir kina vesina. uvaze nacha dati lamma yazkir yaakov esav beshem adon shello befanav, yagdil alav chelek hara chas veshalom, ulefi ma shekkatavti hem devarim hanneemarim leesav hechenif larasha kede shello yikkanes immo bemilchama.

Im lavan garti vegomer. tzarich ladaat ma modia baze, gam ma modia bechol maamar hashshelichut. veulay ki midderech shene achim asher neemanim hem beahavatam, lehodia haach leachiv et kol asher yaavor alav mehattovot gam meharaot, ki ze yaggid kurvat hallevavot. velaze sipper yaakov kol motzotav tovot veraot, limtzo chen beenav kesheyyeda ki maamin bo veneeman achavato.

Od nitchakkem bishlichut ze lehodio ki en rauy leharechiko, vetze ulemad im lavan garti – veyadua haya lavan behafelagat haresha veharammaut, veen adam dar im nachash, veaf al pi chen gar immo yaakov, veze lecha haot hafelagat maasav hannechonim, verauy venachon lekarvo uleohovo ulechabbevo. velo tomar shezze haya bizman muat ella vaechar ad atta, velo tomar shehaya pachut, eved lo shello haya shave nehom kereseh, laze amar vayhi li shor vegomer, veaf al pi chen hinni mazmin atzmi leeved lecha vekinyanay kinyanecha, udevarim ellu yattichu lev even.

rashi: Vayyiven lo bayit. shaha sham 18 chodesh, kayitz vechoref vekayitz (Megila 17), sukkot – kayitz; bayit – choref, sukkot – kayitz:
ohc: Nasa sukkota. perush, vetaam keriat shemah sukkota, bishvil shellemiknehu asa sukkot, al ken vegomer, velo amar "lesukkot" sheaz tavin shekkodem ba yaakov hayta nikret sukkot velo chen hu. veim tomar: vechi bishvil sheasa sham yaakov sukka yikkare lammakom ken? ulay ki asa davar chadash bechemlato al hammikne ma shello asa ken adam kodem, sheyyachin sukka labbehemot, uleshinnuy chadash kara hammakom alav.

rashi: Lo yaakov. lo yeamer od shehabberachot bau lecha veakba uremiyya ki im visrara vegilluy panim, vesofcha shehakkabba nigle elecha bevet el umachalif shimcha vesham hu mevarechcha, vaani sham ehye veode lecha alehen, veze shekkatuv vayyasar el malach vayyuchol bacha vayyitchannen lo (Hoshea 12) – bacha hammalach vayyitchannen lo, uma nitchannen lo? bet el yimtzaennu vesham yedabber immanu, hameten li ad sheyyedabber immanu sham; velo ratza yaakov, veal karcho hoda lo alehen, vezehu vayvarech oto sham, shehaya mitchannen lehametin lo velo ratza:
Veim anashim. esav velavan:
Vattuchol. lahem:
Veelle. hattoladot sheholidu vanav achshav mishshehalach leseir:

Basmat bat yishmael. ulehallan kore lah machalat? matzinu beaggadat midrash sefer shemuel 3 mochalim lahen avonotehen, ger shennitgayyer, vehaole ligdulla, vehannose ishsha. velamad hattaam mikkan – lechach nikret machalat, shennimchalu avonotav:
Achot nevayot. al shem shehu hissiah lo mishshemmet yishmael nikret al shemo:
Al hachalalim. lefashshet hachalalim:
ohc: Bene yaakov bau vegomer. perush kullan yachad, nitkavven hakkatuv lomar taam bizzat kol nichse hair vegomer, ki nogea habboshet lechullan vetzarich sheyyitlu keneged boshet kol echad. uchemo shekkatav harambam (hilchot naara betula 2:5) veze leshono: roin bet din maalato umaalatah, veshamin kamma mamon rauy leaviha ulemishpachtah litten velo yeera lahem davar ze meadam ze vechulei, vechamohu chayyav leshallem, ad kan. vehaachim bichlal hammishpacha. laze nitkabbetzu yachad lehaarich shiur harauy levashtam, vayyavozzu et kol hair veen kede bah leerech bashtam, velakchu hakkol lizchut yaakov avihen ki lo nogea. vahagam sheddanu bahem mishpat mavet, lo amrinan bivne noach kim leh bidrabba minne (tosfot eruvin sav. dibur hamatchil ben noach).

rashi: Elle allufe bene esav. rashe mishpachot:

ohc: Leavraham uleyitzchak. ayyen ma shepperashnu befarashat toldot befasuk (Bereshit 26:3) "ki lecha ulezaracha" vegomer, ki yitzchak nittosef lo zechut bechelek echad yater al avraham, veoto natan Adonai gam ken leyaakov.

Etten et haaretz. tzarich ladaat lamma hutzrach lachzor lomar "etten et haaretz" velo hispik bema shekkadam lomar "lecha ettenenna ulezarecha"? veulay shennitkavven lomar ki lo, leyaakov, natan haaretz sheyyeechoz bah, veillu amar "lecha ettenenna ulezarecha" tihye hakkavvana sheyyittenenna lo lehanechilah lezaro. laze dikdek lomar shete netinot, echad lo veechad lezaro, ma shello dikdek lomar ken behavetachat shene avot.

rashi: Venatannu. nun sheniyya mudgeshet lefi shehi meshammeshet bimkom shete nunin, venatannu:

Veet benotechem nikkach lanu. atta motze battenay sheamar chamor leyaakov uvitshuvat bene yaakov lachamor, shettalu hachashivut bivne yaakov likkach benot shechem et sheyyivcharu lahem, uvenotehem yittenu lahem lefi datam, dichtiv venatannu et benotenu – lefi datenu, veet benotechem nikkach lanu – kechol asher nachpotz; uchesheddibberu chamor ushechem beno el yoshve iram hafchu haddevarim, et benotam nikkach lanu lenashim veet benotenu nitten lahem, kede leratztzotam sheyyeotu lehimmol:
ohc: Venatannu et vegomer. kan nitchakkemu chachma gedola, vehu ki midderech harammay shello ledakdek bifrate hattenaim, veadrabba yevakkesh lehakel haddavar al shekkenegdo kede sheyyitratztze laasot haddavar, shebbaze yaase et asher zamam laasot. uvene yaakov hafchu haddavar, laakor millev shekkenegdam sefek arma, veamru tenay hu haddavar, venatannu et benotenu vegomer veet benotechem nikkach vegomer, perush sheharshut beyadenu latet velakachat, vedavar ze yaggid siman muvhak ki medabberim beyosher levav lo letzad arma baolam.

rashi: Bat lea. velo vat yaakov? ella al shem yetziatah nikret bat lea, sheaf hi yatzanit hayta (Bereshit Rabba), shenneemar vattetze lea likrato (vealeha mashlu hammashal keimmah kevittah):
ohc: Vattetze dina vegomer. taam amro bat lea vegomer, nitkavven hakkatuv lehodia hassibbot asher sibbevu hayyetzia. vehem bemispar shalosh, veze hu shiur hakkatuv: "vattetze dina", vetaam hayyetzia letzad heyotah bat lea, sheillu hayta bat rachel lo hayta yotzet, ella letzad heyotah bat yatzanit (Bereshit Rabba 80:1) yoladtah yalda bemizgah vetivah. sibba sheniyya: leheyotah bat yechida leyaakov, bat achat ben habbanim. od, leheyotah bat yaakov yatza lah shem havayatah baolam, shebbeemtzaut ze asa shechem ma sheasa kaasher avaer. hashshelishit: lirot bivnot haaretz, al derech amram zichronam livracha (pirki derabbi eliezer 38) ki shechem hevi benot haaretz saviv leohel yaakov, vehayu mesachakim bichle nevel vechulei latzet dina lekolam, vezo sibba shelishit litziatah. umimmotza davar atta yodea sheillule lo yada shechem bedina letzad heyotah bat yaakov harashum baolam vehaya lo shem beledet banav, lo haya ose maasehu.

targum: Ta nitbesam berachamata ad tzafra venesak chad lechad berigagata:
Lechon gavre karina vekali al bene nasha:
Vahava pitgam nevua min kodam Adonai im yona var amittay lememar:
Beidana veshuke beidana vishkake velikvel kol pinta deyaaya kamna:
Beramsha vemaarav yoma bachashocha delelya uvachavira:
Are kariv yoma deatid lemete min kodam Adonai al kol ammaya kema daavadat yitaved lach gamlach yittetav bereshach:
Im terim kenishra veim bene chochvaya teshave medorach mittaman achatinach amar Adonai:
Veatkkefat beh uneshakteh veachtzifat appaha vaamarat leh:
Hala beidana hahi amar Adonai veoved chakkimin meedom vechol gevar deveh sucheltanuta mikkerakka deesav:
Itbaynu shavre arimuta veshatye nistakkelun belibbehon:
Beresh ramata al archa ita uvenat shevile kayma:

bart: Hashshuttafin. sheyyesh lechol echad mehem bayit bechatzer, vehechatzer shellifne habbattim shenehem shuttafin bah. uvizman sheyyesh bechatzer din chalukka, vehu sheyyihye lechol bayit uvayit arba ammot bechatzer lifne habbayit veyishshaer od min hechatzer arba ammot laze vearba ammot laze, beha modu chulle alma dishnehem asurim likkanes bechatzer ad sheyyachaloku, hoil veyesh bah din chalukka. velo afligu rabbi eliezer verabbanan ella bechatzer sheen bah din chalukka, rabbanan amre kol echad mehem beshel chavero hu nichnas, verabbi eliezer ben yaakov savar yesh berera vehay bedideh kaazel vehay bedideh kaazel:

Ushenehem asurim lehaamid sham rechayim vechulei. umode rabbi eliezer ben yaakov bechol hane deshuttafim meakkevim ze al ze, delo shayyach lehattir mittaam berera, dechevan divyado leakkev alav veeno meakkev nimtza mehannehu:

Vechofin et hannoder limkor et chelko. dechayshinan meachar sheroe et chavero nichnas yishkach veyikkanes gam hu. aval kesheshshenehem asurim lo chayshinan. vedavka keshennadar meatzmo shello yehene beshel chavero hu dechofin oto limkor chelko, aval im chavero hiddiro shello yehene mimmennu, anus hu veen kofin oto limkor, demay it leh lemebad, veim amart ken kol shuttaf yaddir et chavero shello yehene mimmennu kede sheyyachofu oto limkor lo chelko:
Hammakdish. beshaa sheenah yovel. bizman sheen yovel noheg:

Petach atta rishon. bechamma atta rotze lifdotah. umippene revach shel hekdesh shoalim lo techilla, shehabbealim mosifim chomesh. ulehachi nakat beshaa sheen hayyovel noheg, devizman shehayyovel noheg en tzarich leshoalo bechamma tifdenah, shehare dameha ketzuvim bet kor bachamishshim shekel. uvizman sheen yovel noheg, kegon leachar sheggalu shevet reuven vegad devatlu yovlot dichtiv (sham) ukeratem deror baaretz lechol yoshveha, bizman shekkol yoshveha aleha velo vizman sheggalu mittochah, sheaz hi nifdet beshavyah:

Shehabbealim notnim et hachomesh. kol deme shavyah urevia yoter. vechen kol chomesh haamur battora, sheyyehe hakkeren vechumsho chamishsha. umippene shelosha devarim omrim labbealim petach atta rishon. haachat, shehabbealim mosifim et hachomesh, kidkatane vematnitin. vehashsheni, shemmitzvat geulla baadon, dichtiv (sham 27) im lo yigal, alma mitzvat geulla kodemet limchira. vehashshelishi, shehu mosif venoten befidyonah yoter mishshear bene adam, derotze adam bekav shello:
Mippene raatah. shehahotzaa shebbah yetera al hashshevach:
Issar. shemone perutot:

Lo amar ze ella bechabbetza. kelomar lo kach haya maase, shello amar beissar, ella bevetza. veamar lo haggizbar higgiatcha, hare hi shellecha bevetza. ufelugta detanna kamma verabbi yose, derabbanan savre en podin hekdesh befachot mearba perutot, kede sheyyehe vechumsho peruta. verabbi yose savar podin hekdesh bechol shehu, veaf al pi sheen bechumsho shave peruta. vahalacha ketanna kamma:
Hare ze goel miyyad. veen dino chedin sede achuzza sheeno goel pachot mishshete shanim:
Hare ze chemin ribbit. shekkeshemmachzir lo meotav betoch shana veen ze menakke lo chelum nimtza shennishtammesh beveto bischar hametanat meotav:
Veenah ribbit. gemura. deribbit lo mikkarya ella al yede halevaa shevvadday baa lide ribbit, sheenah nechletet leolam, velo al yede mecher, shehare im lo yigalenna vetachlot lo en kan ribbit:
Yigal beno. betoch shana im yirtze. aval achar shana, nechlat veeno nigal od, kedichtiv veim lo yiggael ad melot lo shana temima vegomer:

Mishshaa shemmachar lo. sheim mecharah reuven leshimon benisan veshimon lelevi beiyyar, kevan shehiggia nisan hu nechlat, veen monin lemecher sheni ella larishon, shenneemar ad melot lo, demashma laze shehayta shello:
Lehavi chodesh haibbur. sheim hayta shana meubberet enah nechletet ad shelosha asar chodesh:

Shana veibburah. ben beshana peshuta ben beshana meubberet notnim lo shenat levana shehi shelosh meot vachamishshim vearbaa yom, veyamim sheyterim shenat chamma al shenat levana achad asar yom shebbeibburan anu meabberim hashshana. vahalacha kachachamim:
Zerua venimlach lenatah. shehayta zerua tevua venimlach lenatah gefanim:
Gomem. leshon gommo im hashshofi deferek gid hannashe [chullin tzav:], kelomar koret haggefen samuch lakkarka shello yeshayyer gavoah min hakkarka tefach:

Memashkenim minnechasav ad eser vechulei. vehane mille keshechazru ze achar ze. aval chazru kullan keechad, meshalleshim benehen beshave. ketzad, amar harishon hare hu shelli beeser veamar hashsheni beesrim veamar hashshelishi beesrim vearba, vechazru bahen hashshelishi vehashsheni keechad, notnim oto larishon beeser, umemashkenim minnichse hashsheni besheva uminnichse hashshelishi besheva venimtza hahekdesh gove esrim vearba. vechen im chazru shelashtan keechad venimkar mehekdesh beshalosh, memashkenim benichse kol echad mishshelashtan shiva selaim. vechen al derech ze leolam:

Hakkol memirin. hakkol matpisin bikdushshat temura, shettofeset kedushshat temura bevehemat chullin, im amar zo tachat zo shel hekdesh. ben al pi anashim ben al pi nashim, kegon im hemira ishsha, tofeset kedushshat temura al piha. vehakkol ditninan hacha, laatoye yoresh sheim hemir bekarban shehifrish morisho bechayyav, temurato temura:
Lo sheadam rashshay lehamir. deha ketiv lo yamir:
Mumar. nitpeset aleha kedushsha ushetehen kedoshot:

Vesofeg et haarbaim. loke al lav delo yamir, veaf al gav delav sheen bo maase hu, dekayma lan kol lav sheen bo maase en lokin alav chutz minnishba umemer umekallel et chavero bashshem. veim tomar, lav hannittak laase hu, dichtiv vehaya hu utemurato yihye kodesh, veen lokin al lav hannittak laase. yesh lomar, deshane hacha shehallav kolel yoter min haase shebbo, shekkol memer loke veen kol memer ose temura, shehare shuttafim vetzibbur en osin temura, vechevan deen haase shave lallav lo mikre lav hannittak laase:
Hakkohanim memirin et shellahen. karbanot shehifrish hakkohen lehakeriv leatzmo, im hemir bo hakkohen matpis bitmura:

Lo vechattat velo veasham. shennatan lo yisrael sheyyakriv lo, im hemir bo hakkohen en ose temura al yado, deha en lo chelek bo, ella mishsheat haketarat emurin vaelach zoche babbasar, veen adam matpis bedavar sheeno shello:
Velo vivchor. shennatan lo yisrael:
Vechi mippene ma en hakkohanin memirim bivchor. vahalo kullo shel kohen hu umechayyim notnim lo veen yisrael mitkapper bo:
Ma chattat veasham en memirin. deha vadday peshita lan deen hakkohanim zochim bahen ella mehaketarat emurin vaelach:
Ma li eno memir bechattat veasham. kelomar, din hu sheen kohanim memirin bechattat veasham kulei:
Vehaya hu utemurato. makkish temura lahekdesh atzmo:
Hechan kedushsha chala. al hahekdesh, bevet bealim:

Af temura. lo tachul ella bevet bealim, aval bevet kohen lo chayla legamre, hilkach en kohen memir bivchor. aval yisrael im hemir bo, nitpas bakkedushsha, shehare birshuto chala hakkedushsha al habbechor. vahalacha kerabbi akiva:
Arbaa nedarim. kullehu mefaresh lehu veazel:
Konam sheeni fochet lecha min hassela. konam kikkar ze alay im ani pochet lecha min hassela. vehassela hu arbaa dinarim:
Al hashshekel. hu chatzi sela:

Shenehem rotzim bishlosha dinarim. velo haya belibbam leshem neder, ella hammocher nadar lezarez hallokeach sheyyosif damim, vechen hallokeach kede sheyyifchot hammocher bidme hammikkach, hilkach lo have neder. veaf al gav didvarim shebballev enam devarim, hecha demuchecha milleta ki hacha, shekken derech kol mochrin velokchin laasot ken, azlinan batar devarim shebballev:

Rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer af harotze lehaddir et chavero kulei. mefaresh baggemara dechassore michassera vehachi katane, harotze sheyyochal chavero etzlo umesarev bo umaddiro, nidre zeruzin hu. veharotze shello yitkayyemu nedarav kol hashshana yaamod berosh hashshana, veyomar, kol neder sheani atid liddor yehe vatel. veyaamod berosh hashshana lav davka, ella hu haddin bechol et sheyyirtze ulechol zeman sheyyikba:

Uvilvad sheyyihye zachur. min hattenay bishat hanneder vedato al hattenay sheyyihye kayyam, az hanneder batel. aval im lo nizkar min hattenay bishat hanneder velo betoch kede dibbur mishshaa shennadar, hanneder kayyam. veen tzarich lomar im nizkar min hattenay bishat hanneder vedato sheyyihye hattenay batel vehanneder kayyam, difshita shehanneder kayyam. umishpete hashshevuot vehannedarim shavin ledin ze. vahalacha kerabbi eliezer ben yaakov:

Charia. karkom yeari, vekorin lo baaravi 392. ushene minim hallalu dehaynu chardal vecharia hen mazzikin lattevua, veim lo shebbaal hassade zeraam verotze vekiyyumam lo haya manniach leadam acher sheyyizra echad mishshene ellu hamminim samuch lattevua shello, hilkach nire kimkayyem kilayim bassade:
Aval somchin lisde yerakot. sheenan mazzikin layrakot veharoe omer shel adam acher hem uvaal hayerakot eno makpid alehen im hem semuchim layrakot shello lefi sheenan mazzikin lahen:
Vesomech levur. im yesh betoch sade shel tevua mekom bur sheeno charush vezarua bet rova o yoter, somech sham zera acher, vechen somech etzel nir vehu makom charush:
Ulegafa. geder avanim sedurot keen choma belo tit:
Ulederech. im derech hayyachid mafseket ben shete sadot, muttar lizroa min echad bezo umin echad bezo:
Mesech al haaretz. sheen nofo gavoah min haaretz shelosha tefachim, im yesh tachtav zera muttar lismoch mibbachutz zera echad, dichgader dame:
Ulesela. lo itztarich lemitneye, deen lecha mechitztza gedola mizzo, ella leashmuinan daafillu sela bainan arbaa rochav, divfachot mikkan en shemah mechitztza lehafesik:
Cherme kohanim. charamim shehechrimum kede letittam lakkohanim:
En lahem pidyon. kedichtiv (sham) lo yimmacher velo yiggael. aval cherme bedek habbayit yesh lahem pidyon, deaddata dehachi achreminhu, deha en rauy levedek habbayit ella maot:

Vachachamim omrim setam charamim lakkohanim. vahalacha kachachamim. vehammachrim mittaltelim bazzeman hazze, vechen hammachrim karkaot bechutz laaretz sheddinam kemittaltelin leinyan ze, notnam lakkohanim. vehammakdish levedek habbayit bazzeman hazze sheen sham bayit, pode otan lechattechilla bedavar muat, velo yifchot lechattechilla mearbaa zuzim o karov laze, aval lo beshave peruta levad o chayyotze vaze, mishshum delekka pirsume milleta:
Shehu chal al kadshe kadashim. kedimfaresh veazel, machrim adam et kadashav kulei:

Kol shehu lifnim min hachoma. kegon batte habbaddim sheosin bahen shemen uvatte merchatzaot umigdalim uvorot shichin umearot. dichtiv asher bair, lerabbot kol shebbetoch hair. yachol sheani marbe et hassadot, talmud lomar habbayit, perat lesadot sheenan domim kelal levayit:

Rabbi meir omer af hassadot. lav sadot mammash kaamar rabbi meir, deha vayit ketiv, vesadot lo damu levayit. ella karka shel selaim umetzula sheenan reuyin lizria vaasuyin levinyan habbayit. mekom selaim, littol mishsham avanim levinyan. umetzula, littol mishsham chol levinyan. veen halacha kerabbi meir:
Eno chevatte are choma. lihyot nechlat besof shana:
Kotel hachitzon hi chomato. veniddon kevatte are choma. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda:
Agasim. baaravi 65 uvelaaz 591:
Kerusetumelin. min agasim ketannim haddomim laafatzim shekkorin milin:
Parishim. hem chavushim, baaravi 373 uvelaaz 486:
Uzradim. baaravi 287 uvelaaz 569:
Chazrad. tappuach yeari, targum vechaftor vechizar:
Afarsekim. belaaz 654, ucheshehen ketannim domin lishkedim:
Shizzafin. hirkiv zetim al rimmon nafek minnehon shizzafin:
Rimin. bearuch peresh 321 belaaz:
Kol shehu betoch bet rova. kegon nekaim meleim mayim, af al pi sheenam reuyim lizria olim lemiddat bet rova lechashev herchek ben min vamin:

Achilat haggefen. ma shehaggefen tofeset veochelet sevivoteha, dehaynu kede avodatah, ole lemiddat bet rova lehashelim eser ammot ushene tefachim umechetza orech al eser ammot rochav, deamrinan leel shehu shiur bet rova shetztzarich lehafesik ben min lemin. vechen hakkever nammi ole. vechen hassela, uvesela sheeno gavoah asara mayre, dei gavoah asara have mechitztza umafsik bifne atzmo:

Tevua vitvua bet rova. hayta sadehu zerua chittin verotze lizroa bah seorim, tzarich leharechik bet rova, uvilvad shello yihyu chittin makkifim et hasseorim mearba ruchot, dehatam lo mehaneya harechaka ad sheyyehe patuach meruach achat:

Yarak bitvua bet rova. vedavka bimrubba hu devainan hachi, aval im ratza laasot shura shel yarak betoch sade shel tevua, ose orech shura shel eser ammot umechetza al rochav shishsha tefachim, shehechmiru bimrubba tefe mibbeshura, vehachi amrinan bayrushalmi:
Rabbi eliezer omer yarak bitvua shishsha tefachim. desavar lo machmerinan bimrubba tefe mibbeshura. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer:
Karachat. makom panuy sheeno zarua keshehu merubba karuy karachat, kemo bekarachto (Vayikra 13) dehaynu shennimrat hassear vehammakom chalak:

Esrim vearbaa karachot levet sea. uvechol karcha zorea min echad. uvet sea hu chamishshim amma al chamishshim amma, uchesheatta ose vo esrim vearba karachot nimtzet kol karcha eser ammot ushene tefachim umechetza orech al eser ammot rochav. ketzad, im taase mechamishshim al chamishshim esrim vechamesh karachot tihye kol karcha eser al eser, kach achat mehen kede sheyyishshaaru esrim vearba karachot utechallekenna leesrim vearba retzuot, nimtza kol retzua shene tefachim umechetza rochav al orech eser, shekkol amma hi vat shishsha tefachim, hare shishshim tefachim leeser ammot, ten kol retzua meellu lerosh kol karcha, nimtzet kol karcha eser ammot ushene tefachim umechetza orech al eser ammot rochav:
Mikkarachat levet rova. shehare yesh bisa esrim vearbaa reviit shel kav, ten otam leesrim vearbaa karachot, hare lechol karcha bet rova:
Kol min sheyyirtze. velo matzrich rabbi meir harechaka kelal dechevan dimrubbaot hen nirot mufrashot umuvdalot zo mizzo:
Hayta. betoch sede tevua karachat achat shel bet rova o shete karachot:

Zoram chardal. deeno nire kisde chardal betoch sede tevua, aval shelosha karachot nirot kisde chardal betoch sede tevua, lefi sheen regilut lizroa min hachardal sade gedola. ushear minim afillu shelosha karachot enan nirin kesade, kevan shergilin lizroa mehen harebe beyachad:

Vachachamim omrim tesha karachot muttarot. aresha kamhadder, dekaamar rabbi meir dezorea kol esrim vearba karachot mikkol min sheyyirtze, vachachamim osrim lismoch min etzel min acher, ella ose levet sea esrim vechamesh karachot dehaynu chamesh shurot, vechol shura mechamesh karachot, vezorea karcha rishona shel shura rishona umanniach sheniyya sheetzlah bura, vezorea shelishit umanniach reviit bura, vezorea chamishshit umanniach shura sheniyya kullah bura vezorea mishshura shelishit karcha rishona ushelishit vachamishshit umanniach shura reviit kullah bura vezorea mishshura chamishshit karcha rishona ushelishit vachamishshit, hare tesha karachot zeruot levet sea:
Eser asurot. shetztzarich sheyyehe mafsik ben kol karachat vekarachat keshiur karachat, dehaynu bet rova bekeruv. vahalacha kachachamim:
Bet kor. sheloshim seim. vetaama derabbi eliezer ben yaakov lo itparesh:

En hamedumma medammea ella lefi cheshbon. sea shel teruma shennafla lefachot mimmea chullin venidmeu, venafal min hamedumma lemakom acher, bainan mea min hachullin lefi ma sheyyesh teruma bisa zo shel damua, velo bainan mea sea keneged kol otah sea shel damua, sheenah nechshevet kullah teruma leesor chullin sheniyyim:

Veen hamechummatz mechammetz ella lefi cheshbon. issa shel chullin shennitchammetza bisor shel teruma hare kullah asura lezarim. veim nafal meotah issa letoch issa acheret shel chullin vechimmetzattah, enah osartah ella lefi cheshbon seor shel teruma shennitarev bah, velo mittasra acharona ella im ken nafal bah min harishona shiur gadol kol kach sheyyesh basseor shel teruma hameorav bah kede lechammetz haacharona belo tzeruf hachullin hamedummaim:

Veen mayim sheuvim poslim et hammikve ella lefi cheshbon. mikve sheyyesh bo achat veesrim seim me geshamim, memalle bakkatef tesha esre sein ufotkan lammikve derech hameshacha vehen tehorim. veaf al gav dishlosha luggin mayim sheuvin poslin et hammikve, hashsheiva keshera keshehi derech hameshacha vehaya sham barishona rov shiur mikve shehu esrim veachat sein me geshamim. vehayenu lefi cheshbon, deen hashsheuvim poslim hammikve keshehen derech hameshacha ella im ken hen esrim seim mayim sheuvim, sheen sham rov shiur mikve mimme geshamim. kach nire perush mishna zo, vechen perashtiha bemassechet terumot perek sea teruma. aval baggemara hachi perusha, lefi cheshbon kelim, sheen shelosha luggin mayim sheuvin poslim et hammikve ella im ken naflu lammikve mishshelosha kelim o pachot, aval im naflu mearbaa kelim o yoter, enan poslim, vehayenu dekaamar veen mayim sheuvim poslim et hammikve ella lefi cheshbon, shemmechashshevim hakkelim shemmehen naflu shelosha luggin mayim lammikve, umonin otan, im hem shelosha kelim o pachot poslim et hammikve, veim mishshelosha kelim ulemala, en poslin. umatnitin rabbi yose ben choni hi, dehu savar shelosha luggin shennaflu miyyoter mishshelosha kelim en poslin, veenah halacha:
Veechad. hannoten bemattana. im ratza ligol betoch shenato, yigal, veim lav chalut lo:
Haya nitman. lokeach, beyom shenem asar chodesh, kede shello yimtzeehu mocher litten et meotav vihe nechlat lo:
Sheyyehe cholesh. sheyyehe metil meotav lelishkat hekdesh shebbaazara:
Vihe shover et haddelet. shel bayit shemmachar. venichnas. cholesh, kemo cholesh al goyim (yeshaya yad):
Muttar beyoshve yabbasha. sheen darkam laredet bayyam:
Bichlal yoshve yabbasha. shessofam laredet veleshev bayyabbasha:

Lo chaellu haholchim meakko leyafo. it dimfarshi la hachi, ha ditnan baresha dematnitin hannoder miyyorde hayyam muttar beyoshve yabbasha, demashma ha veyorde hayyam asur, lo chaellu sheholchim meakko leyafo, shehannoder miyyorde hayyam eno asur bahem, demishshum derech muat kaze lo mikkeru yorde hayyam. veit dimfarshi, lo chaellu haholchim meakko leyafo bilvad, devichlal yorde hayyam hem leaser vegam yoshve yabbasha mikkeru, ella af bemi sheddarko lefaresh, lefi shessofo lered layyabbasha:
Sheen adam macharim davar sheeno shello. uvitto nehi deyachol lemachrah bekatnutah, eno yachol lemachrah benaarutah:
Shehacharamim shellahem. dichtiv (Bamidbar 18) kol cherem beyisrael lecha yihye, vechevan dedideh have, ma hanaa vechach im haya machrim, ihu gufeh zachi beh velo yahev leh lechohen acher:

Nirin divre rabbi yehuda. hachi kaamar, nirin divre rabbi yehuda lerabbi shimon, demode lo rabbi shimon lerabbi yehuda vesover kemoto vekarkaot, velo dibber rabbi shimon ella bemittaltelin, lefi sheen hacharamim shel leviyyim. verabbi yehuda savar, hukshu mittaltelin lisde achuzza, dichtiv (Vayikra 27) mikkol asher lo meadam uvehema umissede achuzzato, ma sede achuzza en halleviyyim machrimim kedichtiv ki achuzzat olam hi lahem, af mittaltelin en leviyyim machrimim. verabbi shimon let leh hay hekkesha. umiddenachet rabbi lefaroshe milleteh derabbi shimon bamme mode lerabbi yehuda uvamme nechlak alav, shema minna dahalacha kerabbi shimon:
Hatztzenon vehannafutz. af al pi shehapperi vehealim domin ze laze hen kilayim ze vaze lefi sheen taam happeri dome, shehalchu baze achar taam happeri:
Lafsan. peresh bearuch 262 belaaz:
Nidre onasin. demeikkara lo haya bedato sheyyachul hanneder im yeakkevennu ones, uvichhay gavna shehaddevarim mochichim, devarim shebballev havu devarim:
Shikma. ilan teena sheggadel bayarim:
Saddan shel shikma. leachar shennechtach venisharu sharashav baaretz nikra saddan, veen notin yarak letocho dahave yarak beilan:
Pegam. esev shekkorin lo 211 belaaz:
Kidda. min ilan shel besamim targum kidda ketzia, uchetiv (tehillim ma) mor vaahalot ketziot kol bigdotecha:
Chatzuv. min yarak sheshsharashav yordim beomek haaretz beyosher veenam notim lechan ulechan, uvo tichem yehoshua et haaretz:
Mekero. leshon kor shettehe hatteena mekareret hachatzuv shehu cham beyoter. perush achar shettihye alav letzel leshon kora:
Memeha letochah. shehaavattiach lach umale mayim:
Challamit. baaravi 42 uvelaaz 83:
Yisrael sheyyarash. batte are choma meavi immo levi:

Eno goel kasseder hazze. baggemara amru, tane eno goel ella kasseder hazze. vehachi kaamar, eno goel kilviyyim dichtiv behu geullat olam tihye lalleviyyim, ella kasseder hazze haamur beyisrael, shettehe nechletet besof shana:

Vechen levi sheyyarash et avi immo yisrael. af hu eno goel kelevi, ella chasseder hazze haamur beyisrael. dilolam eno goel kelevi, ad sheyyehe levi uveare haleviyyim. ditre kerae chetive, ketiv (Vayikra 25) ki vatte are haleviyyim hi achuzzatam, demashma divare haleviyyim tala rachamana, laafoke ben levi sheyyarash avi immo yisrael, uchetiv (sham) vaasher yigal min haleviyyim, demashma lemiktzat leviyyim natatti reshut ligol velo chullam, laafoke ben levi habba min hammamzeret umin hannetina sheeno goel leolam, vechol shekken yisrael sheyyarash et avi immo levi, deyisrael gamur hu, sheeno goel leolam:
En haddevarim amurim. en haddevarim hallalu digullat olam amurim ella veare haleviyyim. aval ad sheyyehe levi lo vainan. vahalacha kachachamim:
Migrash. makom panuy mikkelum, en bo bayit velo zorim oto ella noy hu lair:

En osin sade migrash vechulei. dichtiv (sham) usede migrash arehem lo yimmacher, may lo yimmacher, ilema lo yimmacher kelal, ha middichtiv geullat olam tihye lalviyyim, mikkelal demizdevan, ella may lo yimmacher, lo yishtanne:
Kede shello yacharivu. et yishshuv haaretz:
Mochrim leolam. velo cheyisrael sheeno yachol limkor pachot mishshete shanim kodem hayyovel, dichtiv behu (sham) bemispar shene tevuot yimkar lach, aval ellu mochrim afillu samuch layyovel:

Vegoalim leolam. im batte are choma machru, enan nechlatim besof shana kevatte are choma shel yisrael, veim sadot machru, en tzerichin laamod beyad hallokeach shete shanim, ella goalim miyyad im yirtzu:
Rosh tor. keren zavit mechuddedet nichneset letoch sade acher, ketore zahav shel tachshite ishsha sheyyesh lahen shalosh zaviyyot mechuddadot:
Shehu nire kesof sadehu. venikkar velo mechaze kechilayim:
Mefullash. patuach mishshene tzedadav kemo mavoy mefullash sheppatuach mishshete ruchot:
Rabbi akiva omer orech shishsha tefachim. lo vainan mefullash ella sheyyehe hattelem hazzarua aroch shishsha tefachim, af al pi shezzera acher makkifo mishshalosh ruchotav share:

Verochav meloo. hayenu shishsha tefachim shehu shiur rochav telem. verabbi yishmael nammi bae rochav hattelem bimloo af al gav delo feresh lemilleteh, dechevan derabbi akiva demekel velo vae mefullash bae rochav meloo, kol shekken rabbi yishmael demachmir. verambam peresh rochav meloo sheyyihye rachbo [keamko]:

Rochav parsa. vehayenu tefach, veha dekaamar rochav parsa velo kaamar rochav tefach mishshum demappik la mikkera dichtiv (Devarim 11) vehishkita veraglecha kegan hayyarak, shetztzarich lihyot ben yarak leyarak makom lahanachat haregel dehaynu rochav parsa, vahalacha kerabbi akiva. uvefirkin dilel ditnan yarak beyarak shishsha tefachim hatam mayre ben sede yarak lisde yarak acher shetztzarich leharechik ze mizze shishsha tefachim, vehacha mayre beva litta shura achat shel yarak betoch sade keditnan behedya vehu mevakkesh litta betocho shura shel yarak acher, hilkach mafsik betelem rachav lemar kidit leh ulemar kidit leh:
Min hannotot. perot teluyin hannotin chutz min happardes:

Uvashsheviit lo yered letoch sadehu. af al gav deferot sheviit rachmana afkerinhu, guf hakkarka lo afkar rachmana, vechayshinan shemma veshaa sheeno ochel min happerot yishhe vassade veyitakkev sham veyehane migguf hakkarka sheeno hefker:
Eno mechashshev. hammocher keshebba legaalah:
Ella im harishon. veoto cheshbon yenakke lo kol shana veshana sheachalah, vehammotar yeshallem lo:
Asher machar lo. begoel sede mimkaro ketiv, veheshiv et haodef laish asher machar lo:

Laish asher betochah. shehu motze atta betoch hassade keshebba lifdotah. umenalan dedarshinan lekulla gabbe mocher velo darshinan lechumra, gamrinan geulla geulla meeved ivri, bisde achuzza ketiv (Vayikra 25) umatza kede geullato, uveeved ivri ketiv (sham) geulla tihye lo, ma lehallan lehakel af kan lehakel. vehatam menalan dilhakel, detanya, nimkar bemane vehishbiach veamad bematayim, minnayin sheen mechashshevim ella vemane uchemo shehiggia meoto mane lechol shana kach menakke lo, talmud lomar mikkesef miknato. uminnayin sheim nimkar bematayim vehichsif veamad al mane sheen mechashshevim ella vemane, talmud lomar kefi shanav, kelomar kefi ma shehu shave beotah shaa:

Lo yimkor. sade rechoka sheyyesh lo, kede sheyyigal sade zo shehi bekarov. vechen lo yimkor bera kede sheyyigal sade zo shehi yafa. velo yilve meacherim kede sheyyigal. veeno goel chatzi hassade shemmachar ella o goel kullah o lo kelum. vechol hane yalfinan mikkera dichtiv (sham) vehissiga yado umatza kede geullato. vehissiga yado meatzmo, velo sheyyilve veyigal. umatza, mashma sheyyimtza davar shello haya matzuy lo beshaa shemmachar, perat lemocher berachok kede ligol bekarov, bera kede ligol beyafe, shehaya matzuy lo beshaa shemmachar. kede geullato, [kede geulla] hu goel veeno goel lachatzaim:
Uvahekdesh muttar bechullan. hammakdish sadehu muttar limkor sade acheret o lilvot kede legaalah, veim eno maspik ligol kullah yigal chetzyah, ucheshettassig yado yigal kullah:

Tor. hu shem tachshit shel ishsha shetztzurato meshulleshet, kelomar baal shalosh zaviyyot, leshon tore zahav naase lach (Shir HaShirim 1), veal shemo korin keren zavit hamechuddedet rosh tor. veim keren zavit shel sade shehi zerua chittim nichneset betoch sade shel seorim muttar, mippene shehu nire kesof sadehu venikkar shello nizreu beirbuveya:
Muttar lismoch lo meoto hammin. muttar lismoch etzel sede chittin shello meoto hammin shel sede chavero, veen nire kechilayim besadehu mishshum denire kesof sede chavero:

Muttar lismoch lo telem shel pishtan. sheharoe yodea shello zerauhu sham ella kede livdok sadehu im tova lizroa bah pishtan im lav, lefi sheen adam asuy lizroa telem echad shel pishtan, sheen lo bo shum toelet. aval shel min acher deadam asuy lizroa mimmennu telem echad bilvad, afillu lo zerao ella livdok sadehu asur, sheharoe omer letzarko zerao kede lehanot bo:
Echad zera pishtan veechad kol hamminin. asur lismoch telem echad, sheharoe eno yodea delivdok sadehu hu ose:
Muttar livdok betelem shel pishtan. shehakkol yodim sheen mitkavven lekayyem happishtan ella livdok sadehu im hi yafa lefishtan. vahalacha ketanna kamma:
Batte hachatzerim. sheen lahem laayarot choma:
Koach yafe. kedimfaresh:
Venigalim miyyad. sheen tzarich leshahoto shete shanim beyad hallokeach kesadot. dichtiv behu geulla tihye lo, demashma miyyad yigalennu im yirtze, vehayenu chevattim shel are choma:
Uvegiron kesef. shemmenakke lo hallokeach lefi shanim sheshshahu veyado, kassadot. divvatte hachatzerim ketiv al sede haaretz yechashev, sheyyotzim begiron kesef kassadot:
Shete chatzerot shel shene shene vattim. ir sheen bah ella shete chatzerot af al pi shehi mukkefet choma mimot yehoshua, nechshavin kevatte hachatzerim:

Shete shurot shel kishshuin shete shurot shel deluin shete shurot shel pol hammitzri muttar. dechol shete shurot niret kesade bifne atzmah veikka hekkera veen kan irbuv, vehu deikka telem mafsik ben min lemin, aval shura achat shel kishshuin veshura achat shel deluin veshura achat shel pol hammitzri asur af al gav detelem mafsik ben kol min vamin, lefi sheshshelosha minim hallalu alim shellahem mitpashshetim umitarvim zo im zo, uchesheen sham ella shura achat mikkol min vamin nirin keillu nizreu kullan yachad bemappolet yad umechazu kechilayim, veen hafesakat hattelem nikkeret bahen:

Veshura shel kishshuim rabbi eliezer mattir. kasavar hoil veikka shete shurot shel kishshuin af al pi sheenan semuchot zo lezo chashvinan lehu keillu hen semuchot veyesh kan sade shel kishshuin veshura shel deluin veshura shel pol hammitzri havu keillu netuot besade shel kishshuin, vesaggi lehu beharechakat telem, keditnan leel hayta sadehu zerua yarak vehu mevakkesh litta betocho yarak acher vechulei:

Vachachamim osrim. lefi sheen shete shurot shel kishshuin semuchot zo lazo lo chashive kesade shel kishshuin umechazu kechilayim veyesh kan irbuv veen hafesakat hattelem moelet bahen, vahalacha kachachamim:
Mi shehachamma roa oto. middelo kaamar min haroim:
Meshar meshar. aruggot aruggot, vechol arugga mimmin echad levaddo:

Shelosha telamim shel patiach. kelomar manniach ben meshar lemeshar revach shelosha telamim shel macharesha, milleshon yefattach vishadded admato (yeshaya koach). uvayrushalmi mefaresh shehem shete ammot rochav al shete ammot orech. veachar kach metzer veholech im yirtze ad shello yishshaer benehen besof hammetzar ella kol shehu, shehare bechach hen nirim shello nizreu beirbuveya:
Haol hashsharoni. kimlo rochav haol shechorshim bo bashsharon, dehaynu vabbika, shehu rachav min haol shechorshim bo bahar:
Ukerovim divre ellu vechulei. sheshshiur shelosha telamim shel patiach karov lihyot shave limlo haol hashsharoni:
Sheggaggoteha chomatah. shello hikkifuha choma ella hikkifuha battim utechifat habbattim zo lezo hen kechoma:
Enah kevatte are choma. dechoma ketiv velo sheggaggoteha chomatah:

Vesheenah mukkefet choma mimot yehoshua bin nun. aval hammukkefet choma mimot yehoshua af al pi sheen lah choma achshav, niddon kevatte are choma. delo choma ketiv, male bevav vealef, demashma lo umashma lo, kelomar en lo achshav vehaya lo choma kodem lachen, have nammi bayit chalut bah:
Shalosh chatzerot. shebbechol achat veachat shene battim, mikkere ir:
Kegon katztzera. shem ir ketanna shehayta michutz letzippori:

Vechakra shebbegush chalav vechulei. kol hanach dachashiv bematnitin, yeduim shehayu mukkafot mimot yehoshua bin nun. virushalayim dekachashiv bematnitin, kayma lan deen bayit chalut birushalayim, hilkach ikka leman deamar baggemara detarte yerushalayim havu veen zo yerushalayim hakkedosha sheen habbayit chalut bah, ella yerushalayim acheret shehayta beeretz yisrael vegam hi mukkefet choma mimot yehoshua, vehaya habbayit chalut bah kishar batte are choma:

Oker shete shurot venotea shura achat. shiur hashshura en pachot mearba ammot rochav, uchesheoker shete shurot shel betzalim shehen shemone ammot venotea beemtzaan shura achat shel deluim shehi arba ammot nishtayyeru shete ammot burot mikkan ushete ammot burot mikkan:

Umanniach kamat betzalim shete shurot. shehen shemone ammot rochav veoker shete shurot shehen kemo chen shemone ammot vezorea beemtzaan shura rishona shel deluin shehi arba ammot, nimtza ben shura rishona shel deluin lekamat habbetzalim shete ammot burot vekamat habbetzalim shemone ammot, ushete ammot burot ben kamat habbetzalim leshura sheniyya shel deluim, hare ben shura shel deluim leshura shel deluim shetem esre amma, vechen leolam:

Rabbi akiva omer oker shete shurot venotea shete shurot. kasavar sheen tzarich lehafesik ben shete shurot shel deluim lekamat habbetzalim ella hattelem, keditnan leel befirkin bishar yerakot. uven shurot shel deluim leshurot shel deluim mafsikim shemone ammot shel kamat habbetzalim bilvad:

Vachachamim omrim im en ben shura lachavertah shetem esre amma vechulei. chachamim kerabbi yishmael sevira lehu shetztzarich sheyyihye ben shura shel deluim lachavertah shetem esre amma, mihu rabbi yishmael matzrich hefsek shete ammot burot ben shura shel deluim lekama shel betzalim, vachachamim mattirim lismoch shura shel deluim etzel kama shel betzalim velo matzreche ella telem echad bilvad kishar yerakot. aval shetem esre amma ben shura shel deluim lachavertah bau chachamim lefi shehaddeluim alin shellahen rechavot umitpashshetot harebe, kede shello terae kol hassade meurbevet bivtzalim udeluim. vahalacha kachachamim:

En me chattat naasin me chattat ella im mattan efer. beshaa shennoten et haefer naasim me chattat, vehilkach bainan sheyyihyu mayim techilla bakkeli veachar kach efer. aval natan efer techilla veachar kach mayim, pasul, deha lo hayu sham mayim bishat mattan efer kede sheyyeasu me chattat, vetu lo miavde me chattat. ukera dichtiv (Bamidbar 19) venatan alav mayim chayyim, lo sheyyitten hammayim al haefer, deha ketiv mayim chayyim el keli, demashma hammayim netunim el hakkeli velo el [haefer], ella, venatan alav, lehazehir sheachar sheyyitten [haefer] al hammayim yearvem beetzbao yafe veyachazir hammayim shettachtav alav:

En bet happeras ose vet happeras. sade shennecherash bah kever, im chazar vecharash bet happeras vesadot shessevivotav, lo machzekinan lishar sadot kevet happeras velomar shehammacharesha holicha haatzamot lassadot shessevivoteha, dekever echad la avid bet happeras. ella kol otah sade sheavad bah hakkever sheen yadua hechan hu, umelo maana lechan umelo maana lechan leoto derech shergilim bene habbika lacharosh sedotehen, im lemizrach umaarav o tzafon vedarom, deshemma leechad mishshene rasheha haya hakkever umishsham nitgalgel haetzem letoch achat min hassadot shemmikkan umikkan, vechen shiaru chachamim dimlo hammaana reuyot haatzamot liggalgel al yede hammacharesha, tefe lo. vechamma melo maana, mea amma:

Veen teruma achar teruma. hashshuttafim shettarmu ze achar ze, terumat harishon enah teruma, dechevan shechazar hashsheni vetaram, galle dateh delo nicha leh bitrumat harishon, vahave leh rishon torem shello middaat chavero, vechen hashsheni. umatnitin rabbi akiva hi, veenah halacha. ella im taram harishon kashshiur dehaynu echad mechamishshim, en terumat hashsheni teruma. veim lo taram harishon ella beayin raa, kegon shettaram echad mishshishshim, terumat hashsheni teruma:
Veen temura osa temura. deamar kera utemurato yihye kodesh, velo temurat temurato:
Velo havvalad ose temura. deamar kera vehaya hu, velo havvalad:

Rabbi yehuda omer havvalad ose temura. deamar kera yihye, lerabbot et havvalad. verabbanan savre, yihye, lerabbot shogeg kemezid, sheim savar [lehamir] shachor [vehemir] et hallavan, degabbe kadashim lo kaddish mishshum dahave hekdesh betaut, vegabbe temura kaddish. vahalacha kachachamim. umihu af al gav deen temura osa temura, kayma lan memirin vechozrin umemirin bivhema achat, vaafillu kamma behemot al behema achat shel hekdesh, ben bevat achat ben baze achar ze, kullan temura:
Shello neemar ella bivhema. veim hamer yamir behema bivhema:
Kadshe bedek habbayit en osin temura. degabbe temura ketiv karban, vekadshe bedek habbayit lo ikkeru karban:
Amar rabbi shimon vahalo hammaaser bakkelal haya. rabbi shimon sevira leh dekadshe bedek habbayit ikkeru karban, hilkach lo nafka lan delo avde temura ella mehacha:
Vahalo maaser bakkelal haya. bichlal kol hakkodashim deavde temura:
Velamma yatza. dichtiv bedideh deose temura, dichtiv gabbe maaser lo yevakker ben tov lara velo yemirennu:
Ma maaser karban yachid. veose temura, af kol karban yachid ose temura:
Yatzu karbenot tzibbur. vehashshuttafin. demaaser leteh beshuttafut, kidamrinan beferek batra divchorot [daf 26], yihye lecha velo shel shuttafut:

Yatzu karbenot bedek habbayit. deaf al gav deikkeru karban kedichtiv (Bamidbar lo) vannakrev et karban Adonai‏ ish asher matza cheli zahav, eno karban mizbeach kemaaser. verabbanan deamre leel kadshe bedek habbayit lo ikkeru karban, savre, nehi dekarban Adonai‏ ikkeru, karban laAdonai‏ lo ikkeru kishar karbenot mizbeach:
Uferusham lehakel. af al gav dichshepperesh devarav azlinan batar perusho, ki satam velo peresh azlinan lehachemir, distam noder dato leissur:
Kevasar maliach. hayenu karban, dichtiv (Vayikra 2) al kol karbancha takriv melach:
Kecherem shel kohanim muttar. af al gav decherme chohanim moalim bahem ad sheyyavou lide chohanim vehave davar hannadur, mikkol makom setam cherme chohanim mashma shekkevar bau leyad kohen:
Im kemaasar behema asur. dahave davar hannadur, shetztzarich lehakedisho, veen maasar behema oser haddir kemo shemmaasar dagan oser haggoren:
Sheen anshe galil makkirin terumat hallishka. lefi shehayu rechokim mirushalayim:
Sheen anshe galil makkirin cherme chohanim. vechol ma shehayu machrimin hayu mafrishin levedek habbayit. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda:
En ben hammuddar. ella derisat haregel. laavor derech artzo, o lehasheil kelim sheen osin bahem ochel nefesh, shemmuttarin bammuddar hemennu maachol, vaasurin bammuddar hemennu hanaa:

Nafa uchevara rechayim vetannur. shemmetakkenim bahem ochel nefesh. vechol shekken kedera veshappud shehaochel omed betocho. umuddar maachol ditnan bematnitin, hu sheyyomar lo hanaat maachalcha alay konam:
Mekom shemmaskirin kayyotze vahem. dechevan dederech lehasekir kayyotze baze vehu mochel lo hassechirut, beotam haddamim yachol liknot ochel nefesh, vehu hiddiro mehanaa hammevia lide maachol:

Kol min zeraim en zorim baaruga. ha desharinan leel chamishsha zeronim baaruga, ushelosha asar mine zeronim kesheyyesh lah gevul tefach, hanne mile bemine yerakot, shedderech lezaram arugot arugot, aval mine zeraim sheddarkan lizroa mehen sade gedola lo, mishshum demechazu kechilayim:

Afunim hashshufim. afunim chalakim shennirin keillu hen meshufin bichli shemmeshafin umachalikin bo haetzim. perush acher afunim [hashshufim ketannim], gamlonim gassim ugedolim leshon arammi korin ledavar gadol gamlona:
Gevul. kemin itztabba shel tit megubbal sheosin saviv laaruga lidrisat ragle adam:

Shehaya gavoah tefach. keshezzaru [vo shenem asar mine zeronim] venitmaet, muttarim hazzeronim sheggedelim bo afillu leachar shennitmaet veen tzarich laakor mishshum mekayyem kilayim, kevan shehaya kasher mittechillato bishat zeria. umihu eno yachol lizroa bo [battechilla] leachar shennitmaet ad sheyyaamidennu al gova tefach:

Achat mikkan. bisfat hattelem lerachbo veachat bassafa haacheret veachat beemtza hattelem, veholech vezorea mikkol min ad sheyyihyu meruchakin ze mizze tefach umechetza. veshehen amukkim tefach lirvuta nakat mishshum devayrushalmi ikka man deasar demechaze kechavush:
Verabbi yose oser. dechevan sheen sham acher sheyyachol lizkot ella hu, have chemattana. veen halacha kerabbi yose. vedavka been lo ma yochal hu desharu rabbanan, aval beeynish acharina lo:
Bamme devarim amurim tevua vitvua. tevua bemin tevua o vekitnit hu deamran berova lisa yemaet, aval zerone ginna shennitarvu vitvua o vekitnit:

Echad meesrim vearba benofel. mehen levet sea chittin, kelomar keshiur hazzera shezzorim mehen lemakom shezzorin bo sea shel chittin. veshiur hammakom shezzorim bo sea shel chittin hu chamishshim amma al chamishshim amma, veen zorim bo mizzerone ginna ella kav vachetzi lefi shehen dakkin uvekav vachetzi mehen yesh bahen kede lizroa makom shezzorim bo sea shel chittin. nimtza lefi cheshbon ze sheim nitarev bisa achat shel tevua o shel kitnit o shel zeronim echad mearbaa veesrim shel kav vachetzi mizzerone ginna shehu echad mishshishsha asar bekav chayyav lemaet. hilkach im nitarev bisa tevua kabbetza vachetzi zerone ginna shehu echad meesrim vearba bekav vachatzi kav, yemaet:

Keshem sheamru lehachemir. dezeronim dakkim osrim beshiur muat beechad meesrim vearba benofel mehen levet sea, kach amru lehakel dezeronim gassim shetztzarich mehen harebe lizroa bevet sea enan osrin bisa chittin ella echad meesrim vearba benofel mehen levet sea, kegon zera pishtan shetztzarich shalosh seim levet sea chittim en tzarich lemaet ad sheyyitarev mehen shalosh reviim bisa, vehayenu dekatane happishtan battevua mitztarefet echad meesrim vearba benofel mehen levet sea, vechevan denofel mehen shelosha sein levet sea, dehachi amrinan bayrushalmi, nimtza sheen tzarich lemaet ad sheyyitarev mehen shalosh reviim shel kav bisa, vechen halacha:

Im neder. im amar hare alay ola vehifrish behema lenidro veachar kach hechrimah, hoil vehu chayyav beacharayutah im meta o nigneva, nimtzet shello hi, venoten kol dameha lakkohen, veet habbehema yakriv lenidro, deha vadday yesh lah pidyon:

Veim nedava hi. deeno chayyav beacharayutah im meta, ha vadday lo chayel bah cherem, delav dideh hi ella vichde tovatah, vetova sheyyesh lo bah yitten lakkohen. ketzad, shor ze ola vehechrimo, omdim kamma adam sheeno chayyav beola rotze litten im yimtza ola bezol kede lehakeriv doron lekono, ucheotan damim yitten ze, shezzo hi tovat hanaa sheyyesh lo bah. shehare im meta o nigneva eno chayyav beacharayutah, umishshehifrishah yatza yede chovatah, umeatta eno meabbed veeno mafsid ella shello hikriv doron lekono:
Sheeno rashshay. sheeno chayyav. targum noshe rashya:

Ketzad podin oto. dehabbechor gufo eno mucheram, shehare eno shello ella lakkohen. ella omdim kamma adam rotze litten levaal habbayit sheyyitten bechoro leven bitto chohen o leven achoto, veotah tova deyahev, yitten baal habbayit ze lakkohen bishvil hacherem. vedavka nakat ben bitto o ben achoto chohen, deillu chohen gufo lo matze lemittan tovat hanaa levaal habbayit kede sheyyitten habbechor lo o lechohen acher, dechevan divchor chazi leh, mechaze kechohen hamesayyea bevet haggeranot ladush velizrot kede sheyyittenu lo terumot bischaro, veishtekach delo shakel leh betorat teruma ella betorat sachar:
Katuv echad omer takdish. gabbe bechor ketiv (Devarim 15) kol habbechor asher yivvaled takdish:
Vechatuv acher omer al takdish. (Vayikra 27) ach bechor asher yevukkar laAdonai‏ babbehema lo yakdish ish oto:
Hekdesh illuy. lehaaloto vedamim, sheyyitten tovat hanaato kamma adam rotze litten bo lehaaloto ola sheeno chayyav bah ella kede laasot doron lekono:

Vei atta makdisho hekdesh mizbeach. sheyyehe shem [zevach] acher chal alav. verabbanan denafka lehu hach derasha leel mikkol cherem kodesh kadashim, al takdish mibbae lehu lelav, sheim matpiso leshem zevach acher over belav, vetakdish mibbae lehu lomar shemmitzva lehakedisho velomar ze kadosh livchora, veaf al gav demeelav hu kadosh. verabbi yishmael let leh hach derasha. vahalacha kachachamim:

Ellu kadashim. uvelad veladan ad sof haolam. baggemara parech, kevan detane veladan uvelad veladan, ad sof haolam lamma li. mishshum deshameh tanna didan lerabbi eliezer deamar lekamman velad shelamim lo yikrav shelamim, mishshum hachi tana velad veladan ad sof haolam, kelomar, lo mibbaya bivladan delo modena lach, ella afillu ad sof haolam lo modena lach:

Velad shelamim lo yikrav shelamim. ella konso lechippa umet. midderabbanan. mishshum gezera, dei amart velad shelamim yesh lo takkana, ate leshahoye laem ad shetteled vigaddel adarim min havveladot veatu behu lide gizza vaavoda:

Lo nechleku al velad velad shelamim. modim chachamim lerabbi eliezer bivlad velad shelamim delo yikrav, shemmachashavto nikkeret mittoch maasav dilgaddel adarim bae. ufesak hahalacha ketanna kamma (shevvelad) velad veladan ad sof haolam hare ellu kishlamim:
Heid rabbi yehoshua vechulei. delo kerabbi eliezer. veedut ze emet vahalacha:

Veachalnu veladah shelamim bechag. bechag hashshavuot kaamar, sheim haya mamtin umetzappe lechag hassukkot, nimtza over baase, shenneemar (Devarim 12) uvata shamma vahavetem shamma, demashma beregel rishon shettavo shamma, tavi kol nedarim shealecha. mihu belav delo teacher eno over ad sheyyaavru alav shalosh regalim:
Muttar beyisrael. sheyyatzu mikkelal bene noach:
Veasur beovde chochavim. vaafillu beotam shehem mizzera avraham:
Asur beyisrael. vegerim nammi bichlal zera avraham ninhu, dichtiv (Bereshit 17) ki av hamon goyim netatticha:
Umuttar beovde chochavim. vaafillu veotam shehem mizzera avraham, delo ikkeru zera avraham ella bene yaakov bilvad, dichtiv (sham 21) ki veyitzchak yikkare lecha zara, beyitzchak velo kol yitzchak:
Sheeni nehene leyisrael. mishshel yisrael:
Sheen yisrael nehenim li. mishshelli:
Umocher beyoter, im shomin lo. garsinan. kelomar yimkor haddavar beyoter mikkede shavyo im yirtze chavero lishmoa lo, veliknot mimmennu hachefetz beyoter mimma sheshshave:
Laarelim. dato al mi sheeno maamin bivrit mila:
Lammulim. hammaaminim bivrit mila:
Muttar bearle yisrael. kegon mi shemmetu echav mechamat mila:
Veasur bemule ummot. kegon aravi mahul vegivoni mahul:
Shelosh esre veritot. neemru befarashat mila shenneemra leavraham:
Shehi docha et hashshabbat. dichtiv (Vayikra 12) uvayyom hashshemini yimmol besar arlato, vaafillu beshabbat:
Shehi docha et hannegaim. dedarshinan yimmol, vaafillu bimkom baheret, veen kan mishshum kotzetz bahareto shehu belav dehishshamer benega hatztzaraat (Devarim 24):
Hammocher et sadehu bishat hayyovel. beshaa shehayyovel noheg. aval bishnat hayyovel atzmah eno rashshay limkor, veim machar, hammecher batel umachazir haddamim:

Eno muttar ligol. vaafillu nitratztza lokeach, en shomim lo, dichtiv (sham 25) bemispar shanim achar hayyovel tikne, shettehe kenuya lo shete shanim. veim mehadder la mikkame hachi, over baase. umocher nammi over baase im goalah kodem shete shanim, dichtiv bemispar shene tevuot yimkar lach. aval leachar shete shanim im ratza lifdotah pode otah beal karcho shel lokeach venoten lo lefi ma shemmecharah, kedichtiv (sham) vechishshav lo et shene mimkaro, shemmechashshev kamma shanim mishshemmecharah ad hayyovel, umechallek haddamim lefi hashshanim. kegon im mecharah eser shanim lifne hayyovel bemane, nimtza shemmachar perot kol shana veshana baasirit mane, shehare setam mechira enah ella ad hayyovel, shahata veyad hallokeach chamesh shanim veachar kach ba mocher legaalah, menakke lo lokeach chatzi mane:

Enah ola mimminyan. shete shanim. deha shene tevuot ketiv, shete shanim haruyin litvua tishhe veyad hallokeach. aval hayta shana haruya litvua, venarah hayenu shecharashah vaasaah sede nir velo zeraah, o hovirah shehinnichah bur vaafillu nir lo asa bah, ihu deafsid annafsheh, veola lo beminyan shete shanim:
Shalosh tevuot lishte shanim. otah tevua haomedet bah bishat keniyya, ushete tevuot bishte shanim shettaamod beyado. verabbi elazar lo faleg attanna kamma veha ella divre hakkol hi:
Haomer karban ola mincha chattat toda ushelamim. kol hane, karbenot chova hem, vetoda nammi damya lechova, dearbaa tzerichin lehodot. vesalka datach amina deen ze noder bedavar hannadur:

Verabbi yehuda mattir. mishshum daamaran belo kaf dame lenishba bechayye hakkarban uvechayye haola veen kan lo neder velo shevua. veresha ashmoinan defaleg tana kamma aleh derabbi yehuda afillu birushalayim im hizkirah belo kaf veamar dahave neder. vesefa ashmoinan defaleg rabbi yehuda aleh detanna kamma afillu bekarban ola umincha vechulei‏ keshehizkiran belo kaf delo have neder:

Karban hakkarban kekarban sheochal lach asur. af al gav dechol hane shaminan lehu chevar, hakkarban itztericha leh, desalka datach amina bechayye hakkarban kaamar. veha ditnan lekamman beferek 2‏ hakkarban sheochal lach muttar, hatam ha karban kaamar, demashma chayye karban:
Lekarban lo ochal lach rabbi meir oser. denaasa cheomer lekarban yehe lefichach lo ochal lach. veen halacha kerabbi meir:

Konam pi medabber immach. veaf al gav deen nedarim chalim al davar sheen bo mammash, vedibbur en bo mammash, mikkol makom kesheamar konam pi medabber immach asar happe milledabber, vehappe davar sheyyesh bo mammash hu. vechen yeasru yaday lemaasehem, veraglay lehilluchan, vechol kayyotze baze:
Hammuddar hanaa mechavero lo yashilennu. gezera shemma yishal mimmennu, vehu asar hanaat oto peloni alav. vechen lo yalvennu, gezera shemma yilve mimmennu:
Velo yimkor lo. befachot mishshavyo, gezera shemma yikkach mimmennu nammi befachot mishshavyo venimtza nehene:
Im haya darko lacharosh hu asur. delo ikkavvan ella shello yacharosh hu atzmo kemo shehaya ragil, aval acherim yachreshu:
Veim en darko lacharosh. dato haya shello yachreshu vah lo hu velo acherim:
Amar echad hare hi shelli beesrim veachat. leachar sheamru habbealim beesrim:

Habbealim notnim. beal karchan: esrim veshesh. dilhay lo yahavinan leh, hoil veamru habbealim esrim veala hacheshbon im hachomesh beesrim vechamesh, vei yahavinan leh lehaich beesrim veachat nimtza hekdesh mafsid. uvealim beal karchan yittenu oto sela shehosif ze al hakkeren veesrim vechamesh didhu, aval al sela shehosif ze lo yosifu chomesh:

Amar echad bachamishsha veesrim habbealim notnim sheloshim. beal karchan. uvaggemara parech ammay kofin et habbealim, bishlama ad hasheta chayyevinan lehu deha lo matzinan lemetva lehanach, mishshum dekeren didhu lo have kekeren vechomesh deamru bealim baresha, hilkach al karchacha mehadderinan abbealim, vechevan dimhadderinan alayhu vau lemetav karna kamma deshaymuha acharine, vechumesha didhu. aval hasheta deamar echad bachamishsha veesrim, litteno lehaich, deha keren didhu have chekeren vechomesh deammur bealim baresha, velemru bealim hare ba acher bimkomenu sherotze litten chamishsha veesrim selaim kemotenu. umetaretz, kegon deammur bealim baresha peruta yoter al esrim selaim, demate chushebna dekeren vechomesh lachamishsha veesrim uferuta, vei yahavinan leh lehay, ikka feseda lahekdesh. hilkach mehadderinan abbealim beal karchayhu. veha dela tana varesha habbealim omrim beesrim uferuta, devifrutot lo dak tanna velo chash lemitninhu:

Im ratzu habbealim litten sheloshim veechad vedinar. kegon demeikkara kesheppatchu habbealim rishon amru beesrim veachat selaim dahave ben keren vachomesh esrim veshesh selaim vedinar, shehassela arbaa dinarim, vechomesh hu reviit hammamon kedaamaran, veilluyo shel ze hem chamesh, hare sheloshim veechad vedinar:
Habbealim kodmin. dei hava yahavinan leh lehay hava mafsid hekdesh dinar mimmay deammur bealim baresha, hilkach mehadderinan abbealim al karchayhu:
Veim lav. shello patchu habbealim techilla ella veesrim, veze omer chamishsha veesrim:

Omrim laze higgiatcha. hare hu shellecha, velo mehadderinan abbealim. mishshum deamre vealim ba acher bimkomenu shennoten esrim vachamishsha chemotenu. veha ditnan bematnitin sheen habbealim mosifin chomesh ella al ma sheppatchu hem techilla velo al illuyo shel ze, hane mille hecha dela shamu vene adam et hakkarka kemo sheamar ze haacher, aval im shamuhu shelosha vene adam kidvarav shel ze, mosifin bealim chomesh beilluyo beal karchan. vechulla matnitin lo ayre ella visde achuzza bizman sheen hayyovel noheg, keditnan beresh pirkin:
Kishshut udelaat. shehealim shellahen mitpashshetim umitarvim zo im zo, vechol shekken shear minim:
Zo nota letzad ze. deaf al gav deen hefsek shel telem moil lahen, hattayat healim zo letzad ze vezo letzad ze moil lahen, hoil uma sheasru chachamim bechilayim lo asru ella mippene marit haayin:
Veen lo ma yochal. orcha demilleta nakat, vehu haddin afillu yesh lo ma yochal:
Uva ze venotel mizze. im yirtze litten lo, veeno over al nidro. aval eno yachol lechofo leshallem lo, deha lo amar lo ten lo vaani efra. veim amar lo chen, asur, deha shaliach shavveye:
Kanbos o luf. shemminim hallalu en hatelaa vacharisha moelet bahen, lefi shemmitkayyemim baaretz shalosh shanim veenan matliin:

Istis. tzivo dome litchelet, korin lo baaravi 90 uvelaaz 171, uregilim shekkortim oto vechozer vetzomeach, uma shetztzomeach paam sheniyya nikra safiach. i nammi ma shetztzomeach min hazzera hannofel bishat ketzira karuy safiach:
Mekom haggeranot. sheddashim bo tevua vekitnit:
Tiltan. baaravi 47 uvelaaz 459:

En mechayyevin oto lenakkesh. divlav hachi sofo leakram, lefi sheistis kashe lattevua vehaasavim kashim lattiltan keshennizra lemaachal adam, umekom haggeranot nammi kashim lo hazzeraim shemmachlidim et hakkarka umalkim otah velo chazi tu limkom disha:
Veim nikkesh o chissach. dehashta galle dateh denicha leh beotam hannisharim shehare oker hakkol chutz mizze, omrim lo akor et hakkol, mippene shehu nire kimkayyem kilayim:
Nikkesh. sheakar hatztzemachim beyadav im hashshoresh:
Kissach. shechatach healim vehashshoresh nishar baaretz, targum lo tizmor lo techassach:
Tevua nota al gabbe tevua. kegon shennizreu kehilchatan ella shehashshibbolim mittoch gadlan nichpafim veshochvim ze al ze, vechen kullan:
Chutz middelaat yevanit. shealin shellah arukkim umitpashshetin beyoter ucheshehen notin al gabbe tevua o yarak hen mistabbechin umitkashsherin yoter mikkol shear minin umechazu kilayim:
Ufol hammitzri. 426 belaaz:
Veroe ani et divrehen middevaray. sheen bahen mesabbechin umistabbechin kidlaat yevanit. vechen halacha shehakkol muttar chutz middelaat yevanit:
Memirin min habbakar al hatztzon vechulei. dichtiv behema bivhema, vetzon uvakar zecharim unekevot kullehu behema mikkeru:

Tov bera. tov shel chullin lo yamir oto bera shel kodesh, veim hamer yamir vegomer, alma baale mumin avde temura. veabbaal mum chayla temura, dichtiv o ra betov, demashma baal mum shel chullin betam shel kodesh:

Veezehu tov bera. kelomar, ezehu ra shel kodesh daavid temura, kol shekkadam hekdesho et mumo. aval kadam mumo et hekdesho delo chala alav kedushsha, la avid temura. middahava matze lemichtav lo yamir tov bera o ra [bo], vahava mashma [o ra] lo yamir lo betov velo bera, betov batra dechatav rachamana lamma li, lomar lach tov meikkaro, shebbeshaa shehukdash haya tam veshuv nafal bo mum, ose temura. ra meikkaro, shennafal bo mum kodem shehukdash, en ose temura:
Memirin echad. shel chullin bishnayim shel kodesh, kegon sheamar hare zo tachat ellu:
Ushenayim. dechullin beechad dekodesh, kegon hare ellu tachat zo:
Ma hu meyuchad. dichtiv hu. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Lohoragin. listim shehorgin haadam venotlin et mamono:
Velochoramin. gazlanim sheenam horgim. velo zo af zo katane:

Velammochsin. bemoches haomed meelav. aval moches sheheemido hammelech, ben melech yisrael ben melech nachri, velokeach davar katzuv bechok hammalchut, dina demalchuta dina veasur livroach min hammeches, vechol shekken sheasur liddor velishshava lo lashsheker:
Shehen shel teruma. af al pi shehorgin vegozlin, en ochlin davar haasur. i nammi, teruma lo chashiva lehu, mittoch sheenah neechelet ella lechohanim tehorim nimkeret bezol harebe:
Lo yiftach lo veneder. im lo shaal mimmennu haannas sheyyiddor lo yatchil hu banneder:

Bema shehu maddiro. im shaal mimmennu haannas liddor lo yiddor lo ella bema sheshshaal bilvad, velo yiddor lo bedavar acher. vechol hane arbaa nedarim detana bematnitin, din hannedarim vehashshevuot shavim, uma shemmuttar beneder muttar bishvua veen tzerichim hattara, chutz minnidre zeruzin bilvad shetztzerichim hattara middivre sofrim, lefichach hashshevua asura bahem:

Omed aval lo yoshev. matnitin ayre keshennichse hamevakker asurim al hachole, uvimkom shennotlin sachar al hayeshiva im hachole, sheim yoshev immo veeno notel secharo hannahug hare mehannehu. aval amida, zeman muat hu veen regilin littol aleha sachar:
Refuat hannefesh. refuat gufo:

Refuat mamon. refuat behemto. lefi shechayyav adam lerappeot et chavero keshechala, shenneemar (Devarim 22) vahashevoto lo, lerabbot avedat gufo, umitzva kaaved, lefichach af al pi shehiddiro hanaa mimmennu merappeo veyadav keshechala begufo. veim chalta behemto eno yachol lerappeah beyadayim mippene shemmehannehu, aval omer lo sam peloni yafe lah, sam peloni ra lah:
Aval lo viktanna. mippene shemmehannehu keshemmagbiah alav et hammayim:
Aval lo vimot haggeshamim. mippene shemmechammemo. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda:

Aval lo min hattamchuy. lo yochal immo bichli echad, shemma yanniach milleechol mana yafa shebbo kede sheyyochal ze hammuddar hanaa mimmennu, o shemma yekarev lefanav chaticha sheyyochal, venimtza mehannehu:

Aval ochel hu [immo] min hattamchuy hachozer. levaal habbayit. reuven ochel bikara sheyyodea shekkesheyyachazirenna levaal habbayit yachazor baal habbayit veyishlechenna leshimon shemmuddar hanaa mimmennu, velo chayshinan shemma yeshayyer bakkeara kede sheyyochal mimmenna shimon venimtza mehannehu:
Haevus shellifne happoalim. keli gadol shemmemalleim oto veochlim bo kol happoalim beyachad:
Lo yaase immo veumman. lo yiktzor immo beotah shura shehu kotzer, sheggorem lo shemmemaher laasot melachto keshemmotze hammakom panuy, venimtza mehannehu. veen halacha kerabbi meir:
Evarim beubbarim. evarim dechullin beubbarim dekodesh. sheim amar tehe regel behema zo temurat ubbar kodesh shebbime behema zo, en hakkedushsha chala al haevar:
Velo ubbarim beevarim. sheim amar hare ubbar shebbevehemat chullin zo temurat regel shel behemat kodesh zo, en haubbar kadosh:
Velo ubbarim veevarim. shel chullin, bishlemim dekodesh:
Velo shelemim. dechullin, beubbarim veevarim shel kodesh:
Memirin evarim bishlemim. amar hare regel behemat chullin zo temurat behemat kodesh zo, chala temura al haevar ufashta lah bechol habbehema vehaveya temura kullah ukereva:
Velo shelemim bahen. deen koach beevar echad shel behemat kodesh laasot temura:
Vahalo vemukdashin. bitchillat hahekdesh kesheomer raglah shel zo ola:
Kullah ola. kidyalfinan mikkera dichtiv (Vayikra 27) kol asher yitten mimmennu laAdonai‏ yihye kodesh, keshehu omer yihye kodesh, lerabbot et kullah. vahalacha ketanna kamma:

Hattomen lefet utzenonot. kede sheyyihyu nishmarim tachat hakkarka, shello chederech shetila, galle dateh sheeno rotze behasherashatan, kegon shettaman agudda shel lefet vaagudda shel tzenonot yachad:
Im hayu miktzat alin megullin. mishshum shabbat nakteh, deim hayu kol healin mechussin i efshar littol im lo sheyyaziz afar beyadayim:

Lo mishshum kilayim velo mishshum sheviit. lo mishshum zorea kilayim velo mishshum zorea bashsheviit. i nammi afillu hosif matayim mishshum kilayim share delav derech zeria [hu], veim haya mishshishshit venichnesu lashsheviit vehotziu sefichim kederech shemmosifim habbetzalim battalush, en bahem mishshum sefiche sheviit:
Velo mishshum maasrot. eno chayyav leasser kesheyyitlosh otam mimmakom shehitminam, dichtiv (Vayikra 27) vechol masar haaretz mizzera haaretz, vehay lav zeria hi:
Venittalim beshabbat. dechitlushim damu, veochez bealim hamegullim umotzian. veaf al gav demeziz afar mimmekomo, tiltul min hatztzad letzorech devar hetter veeno nogea baddavar haasur muttar:

Ad sheyyihyu shene chittim useora. taama derabbi yehuda mishshum dichtiv (Vayikra 19) sadcha lo tizra kilayim, vesavar dekarka belo zera lo ikkere sade, umashma lo tizra kilayim bahade sadcha shennizra kevar. vechen (Devarim 22) lo tizra karmecha kilayim, lo tizra kilayim dehaynu shene mine zeraim bahade karmecha, velo mechayyev bechile hakkerem ad sheyyizra chitta useora vechartzan bemappolet yad. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda. dekarka af al pi sheenah zerua karuy sade, aval eno karuy kerem belo chartzan, hilkach hazzorea chitta useora keechad chayyav mishshum kile zeraim, veeno chayyav mishshum kile hakkerem ad sheyyizra chitta useora vechartzan bemappolet yad:
Asur bakkerchim uvevaale hassevot. middelo kaamar bevaale hassear:

Sheen nikraim shechore harosh ella anashim. lefi shehaanashim peamim mechassim rosham ufeamim megallim umishshacharut rosham nikkar shehem anashim, aval nashim leolam holchot verosham mechusse. vehakketannim ben zecharim ben nekevot holchin begilluy harosh veenam nikkarim ben zachar linkeva, umishshum hachi lo ikkeru shechore harosh ella haanashim haggedolim:

Yesh bekarbenot hayyachid. vekarbenot hatztzibbur en nohagim ella bizcharim. derubban olot, veola zachar hu, veen meviin shelamim ella kivse atzeret dizcharim hen, vechattat shellahen nammi ketiv bechullehu seir chattat echad:

Karbenot hayyachid chayyavin beacharayutan. kelomar, yesh meotan shekkavua lahen zeman sheafillu avar zemannan chayyav lehakerivam, kegon olat yoledet vekarbenot metzora, im avar shemini shello chayyav lehakerivam leachar zeman. aval karbenot tzibbur sheyyesh lahem zeman, im avar zemannan batel karbanan:

Mishshekkarav hazzavach. sheim karav hazzevach bizmanno velo karvu nesachav immo, chayyavin lehakerivam afillu mikkan vead asara yamim. dichtiv befarashat pinchas bechullehu uminchatam veniskehem lapparim, lomar lach minchatam veniskehem shel karbenot tzibbur kerevim afillu ballayla vaafillu lemachar, im karvu karban bizmanno velo nizdammenu lahem menachot unesachim, makrivin otan kesheyyizdammenu lahen afillu leachar kamma yamim:

Chavitte chohen gadol. dochin shabbat vetuma. dichtiv behu minchat tamid, hare lecha kammincha shel temidin sheddocha shabbat vetuma. devattamid ketiv bemoado, veamrinan bemoado af beshabbat, af betuma, sheim hayu rov hakkohanim temeim osim oto betuma:
Par yom hakkippurim. paro shel kohen gadol:
Ella shezzemannan kavua. kelomar, en hattaam taluy ella bikviut hazzeman, dechol karban shezzemanno kavua veim avar hazzeman en lo tashlumim, doche shabbat vetuma. vahalacha kerabbi meir:
Nidre havay. guzma usefat yeter, vehu beatzmo yodea shello haya kach:
Konam im lo raiti. konam alay kikkar ze im lo raiti vechulei:
Nidre shegagot. amar konam alay kikkar ze:
Im achalti im shatiti venizkar sheachal veshata. uvishat hanneder haya savur shello achal velo shata, lo have neder:

Konam sheeni ochel lach veeni shote, veshachach veachal veshata. divshaa shehanneder chal shehu vishat haachila vehashshetiyya shachach et hanneder, muttar, deyalfinan mishshevua dichtiv (Vayikra 5) haadam bishvua, devainan sheyyihye adam beshaa shehashshevua chala alav, kelomar sheyyihye zachur min hashshevua, vehu haddin beneder:
Konam ishti nehenet li shegganva et kisi. hayenu nidre shegagot, dechevan shennoda shello ganva lo, nimtza shello haya neder:
Ellu vaellu muttarin. deneder shehuttar miktzato huttar kullo, deeno rotze sheyyachul nidro ella keen shennadar oto, vechevan shemmiktzato haya shogeg nitbattel kullo:
Chattat hayyachid shekkipperu vealav. sheavda venitkapper beacheret veachar kach nimtzet harishona:
Veshel tzibbur. shekkipperu beacheret:
Enan metot. dechattaot hammetot halacha lemoshe missinay hi, usevira leh letanna kamma dilyachid gemire velo leshel tzibbur:
Rabbi yehuda omer yamutu. divshel tzibbur nammi gemire:

Amar rabbi shimon ma matzinu. kelomar, kayma lan chamesh chattaot metot, shemmetu bealeha, veshekkipperu bealeha beacheret, vesheavra shenatah, velad chattat, utemurat chattat. vechi hechi ditlat minnayhu lav betzibbur gemire, deha lo mashkachat lehu bekarbenot tzibbur, velad chattat lo mashkachat la betzibbur, sheen chattat nekeva betzibbur, utemurat chattat nammi en karban tzibbur ose temura, veshemmetu bealeha en tzibbur metim:
Af shekkipperu vealeha vesheavra shenatah. af al gav deefshar demishtakkeche betzibbur, lo gemire demetot:
Beyachid devarim amurim. demetot: aval lo vetzibbur. vahalacha kerabbi shimon:
Shokel lo shiklo. machatzit hashshekel shechayyav kol echad miyyisrael bechol shana letzorech karbenot tzibbur. vehammaddir yachol lishkol bishvilo, demitzva bealma kaaved:

Uforea lo chovo. it demokmi la davka bechov shehitna love im hammalve shello yifreennu ella lichsheyyirtze velo yuchal hammalve lelachtzo, vehasheta lo ahane leh mide bema shepporea chovo. veit demokmi la bechol chov shebbaolam, sheeno ella monea et baal chovo shello yitbeennu, umeniat tevia enah bichlal hanaa:
Umachazir lo avedato. ben shehayu nichse machazir asurim al baal aveda, ben shehayu nichse baal aveda asurim al hammachazir, mishshum demitzva kaaved:

Uvimkom shennotlin aleha sachar tippol hanaa lahekdesh. kesheshshenehem muddarim hanaa ze mizze, im hu notel sachar nimtza nehene, veim eno notel sachar nimtza mehanne, lefichach tippol hanaa lahekdesh. velo amrinan yolich hanaa leyam hammelach, lefi sheasar alav hanaato kehekdesh, hilkach kol hanaa habbaa leyado mimmennu hekdesh hi:

En meviin ilan beilan. en markivin ilan maachol beilan maachol min besheeno mino, o ilan serak beilan maachol, aval ilan serak beilan serak kevan sheen shum echad mehem ose peri, kemin echad chashuv veshare:
Yarak beyarak. min sheeno mino:
Rabbi yehuda mattir yarak beilan. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:

Delaat beyarak. habba litta delaat etzel yarak avodatah kayyarak dehaynu shishsha tefachim. aval im ba litta delaat bitvua tzarich leharechiv lo bet rova keshiur avodat hattevua shehu eser ammot ushene tefachim umechetza al eser ammot, vehu mekom zeriat rova hakkav:

Shura shel deluim notnim lah avodatah shishsha tefachim. vekila shura middelaat yechidit, didlaat yechidit bitvua tzericha bet rova, lefi sheshshura minnakkera bifne atzmah velekka irbuv kemo vidlaat yechidit. veshishsha tefachim ditnan hacha have shiur rochav, aval shiur orech lo itparesh bematnitin, uvattosefta pershu detzarich sheyyihye shiur haorech eser ammot umechetza:
Veim higdila. hashshura venichnesu haanafim betoch shishsha tefachim, yaakor millefaneha kol haanafim shennitpashshetu venichnesu betoch shiur ze:
Notnin lah avodatah. shel shurat haddeluim arba ammot, shetztzarich leharechik arba ammot min hattevua:

Hatachmir zo min haggefen. ditnan lekamman beferek 4‏ hannotea shura shel chamesh gefanim bet hillel omrim eno cherem veeno noten lah avodat hakkerem arba ammot ella shishsha tefachim, vehachi nammi beshura shel deluim en lehachemir velitten lahen arba ammot, deen lehachemir bechile zeraim yoter mibbechile hakkerem:

Matzinu shezzo chamura min haggefen. af al gav deissur kile zeraim kil meissur kile hakkerem, mikkol makom ha ashkechan dilgefen yechidit keshebba litta otah bitvua notnin lah avodatah shishsha tefachim velidlaat yechidit notnim lah bet rova shehen eser ammot ushene tefachim umechetza al eser ammot mippene shehi mitpashshetet veholechet merachok, hachi nammi en litmoah im leshura achat shel gefanim notnim lah avodatah shishsha tefachim uleshura shel deluin notnin lah arba ammot:

Kol shelosha deluin levet sea. rabbi meir paleg attanna kamma deamar shellidlaat yechidit bitvua notnim lah bet rova, vesavar ihu denotnim lah shelishit bet sea, verabbi yose ben hachotef efrati savar shelishit bet kor. veen halacha kedivre chullam ella ketanna kamma bilvad. udelaat hashshenuya bematnitin hi delaat yevanit bilvad shealim shellah rechavim umesakkechim umistabbechim tefe, aval delaat mitzrit im shear deluin dinan kishar yerakot:
Hare ellu chetoda. emurehen kerevim al gabbe hammizbeach vehabbasar neechol leyom velayla:
Uvilvad sheenan teunin lachem. dichtiv al lechem hattoda, hattoda atzmah teuna lechem, velo veladah utemuratah teunim lechem:
Temurat ola. kegon hemir zachar beola:
Uvelad temuratah. kegon hemir nekeva beola, dinkeva mitkaddeshet bitmurat ola, veyalda hattemura zachar:
Vetorem terumato umaasrotav ledato. kegon sheamar kol harotze litrom yavo veyitrom. aval lo yomar lo litrom, shehare osehu shaliach vahanaa hi lo sheose shelichuto:
Umakriv lo kinne zavin vezavot. kohen shehiddir et yisrael hanaa mimmennu, yachol lehakeriv karbenotav shemmevi al zav vezava veyoledet:
Umelammedo midrash. sifra vesifri, shehu midrash happesukim:
Halachot. halacha lemoshe missinay:
Aggadot. divre chachamim shehismichum al happesukim. vetaama deshare lelammedo kol hane, sheen adam rashshay likkach sachar kede lelammed et chavero et kol elle, veen kan hanaa, demitzva kaaved:

Aval lo yelammedennu mikra. shemmuttar littol sachar al limmud hammikra, sheeno notel ella sechar pissuk teamim lenaggen hammikraot kehilchatan, velav deorayta hu veshare littol sachar alav, veim eno notel nimtza mehannehu, veim notel nimtza nehene. vedavka bemakom shennahagu littol sachar al hammikra, aval bemakom sheen notlin sachar al hammikra af hammikra share lelammedo:

Aval melammed hu et banav. veaf al gav demitzva al haav lelammed et beno veze motzio mide chovato, lo mikkarya hanaa, demitzvot lav lehenot nittenu. vegam efshar shehaya motze acher shehaya melammedo chinnam:
Velo yazun et behemto. denicha leh befittumah veka mehanne leh:
Temea nafshah vegufah lashshamayim. delimlacha kayma veeno choshesh al pittumah:
Sheim yirtze mochrah leoved kochavim. laachila venotel damim yeterim bishvil pittumah:

Chayyav al kol achat veechat. veyihye nazir sheloshim yom im amar hareni nazir setam, veyavi karban nazir, veyachzor lihyot nazir kemispar happeamim sheamar sheyyihye nazir. uvishvua eno chayyav ella achat, sheeno loke ella malkut achat. aval im nishal al hashshevua harishona, chala hashshevua hashsheniyya, vechen im nishal al hashsheniyya, chala hashshelishit, veasur leechol ad sheyyutteru kullam, middelo tenan hare zo shevua achat, ella eno chayyav ella achat:
Kelev kufri. kelev shemmegaddelim bene hakkefarim vehu katan vedome leshual:
Hayyeelim. min chayya, veakko metargemin veyaala:
Arod. chamor habbar:
Macharim adam mitztzono. miktzat tzono. omer hare hen cherem venotnan lakkohen:
Veim hechrim et kullan. shello shiyyer leatzmo kelum:

Enan muchramin. deamar kera (Vayikra 27) mikkol asher lo meadam umissede achuzzato. mikkol asher lo, ellu mittaltelin, velo kol mittaltelin. meadam, ellu avadav veshifchotav kenaanim velo chullan. umissede achuzzato, velo kullah. veen halacha kerabbi elazar ben azarya, ella lechattechilla lo yachrim et kullan, aval im hechrim, muchramim:
Lihyot chas al nechasav. shello yevazbezem lahedyot:
Bechermo shel yam. leshon metzuda, kemo asher hi metzodim vacharamim (Kohelet 7):
Hare atzmi karban. asar atzmo kekarban al chavero:
En nishalim alehem. en tzerichin sheelat chacham, sheenan chalim:
Veim nishalu. veim am haaretz hu ze shennadar kehay gavna uva lishshael al nidro, en potchin lo petach lacharata veen mattirin lo. veim avar al nidro ze menaddin oto:
Potchin lo fetach mimmakom acher. marim lo shehanneder kayyam ufotchin lo petach mittaam acher umattirin lo nidro. aval lo onshin velo machmirin. vechen halacha:
Karban lo ochal lach kulei. muttar, dahave chenishba bakkarban venaasa cheomer bechayye hakkarban im ochal lach shum davar:
Shevua shello ochal lach. velo amrinan bechayye shevua kaamar kidamrinan bekarban, dishvua let bah meshasha velo shayyach lomar bah bechayye shevua:

Shevua sheochal lach. zimnin dishvua sheochal lach delo achilna mashma, kegon shehaya chavero mesarev bo leechol veamar lo achilna lo achilna, veshuv amar shevua sheochal lach, delo achilna mashma, vehachi kaamar, bishvua yehe alay i achilna lach:

Ze chomer bashshevuot. lo matzinan leokma ashshevua shello ochal lach vechulei, demiddekatane ze, chomer mashma, deneder have ella deeno chamur kishvua, vegabbe karban lo ochal lach tenan muttar, delo have neder kelal. mishshum hachi tzarich leokma addilel ditnina konam sheeni yashen sheeni medabber hare ze beval yachel, veokimna midderabbanan, demiddeorayta en hanneder chal ella al davar sheyyesh bo mammash, veze chomer bashshevuot mibbannedarim, sheshshevua chala afillu al davar sheen bo mammash:

Tefillin sheani meniach. mishshum deasar cheftza aleh, veeno nire kenoder levattel et hammitzva, shehare lo kibbel al atzmo ella asar hachefetz alav, veim yekayyem hammitzva haveya mitzva habbaa baavera, vedame lemi shechayyav leechol matztza belele fesach velo matza ella matztza shel tevel o shel hekdesh, sheasur leachlah. aval kol leshon shevua hu oser et atzmo millaasot haddavar, vechevan shehu mechuyyav laasot hammitzva lav kol kemineh lehafekia atzmo mechiyyuv hammitzva. veim amar hare alay karban im aniach tefillin, chal hanneder vechayyav lehavi karban im heniach tefillin:
Min hayyillodim. mashma shennoldu chevar:
Min hannoladim. mashma haatidin lehivvaled:

Min hannoladim rabbi meir mattir af bayyillodim. baggemara mefaresh dechassore michassera vehachi katane, min hannoladim asur bayyillodim, rabbi meir omer af hannoder min hannoladim muttar bayyillodim, ki hechi dehannoder min hayyillodim muttar bannoladim:
Ella mimmi sheddarko leholid. kegon adam uvehema, laafoke ofot vedagim sheen molidim ella metilim betzim:
Veellu muttarin. chullin sheochal lach. lesiman bealma nakteh, keshem shechullin sheochal lach en tzarich sheela lechacham, kach kol hane deamrinan bematnitin beresha en tzerichin sheelat chacham:
Keorot levuvin. hayu nokvim habbehema mechayyim keneged hallev umotziin hallev umakrivin oto laavoda zara, vetikrovet avoda zara asur bahanaa:
Kechallat aharon. shehaya rishon lakkohanim. velo have davar hannadur, sheen challa uteruma bain beneder unedava:

Hare ze muttar. deamar kera (Bamidbar 30) ish ki yiddor neder, ad sheyyiddor bedavar hannadur. vechattat sheeni ochel lach deamrinan beferek kamma deasur veaf al pi sheeno davar hannadur, have taama, deefshar sheyyavi chattat al yede neder, kegon shennadar benazir umitchayyev lehavi chattat:
Hare at alay keimma. af al gav delav davar hannadur hu, chamur mikkol hane dilel, detzarich hettera midderabbanan im hu am haaretz:
Potchin lo fetach mimmakom acher. kelomar mevakkeshim lo petach vetaam lacharatato. velo saggi vichdo tahit o libbach alach. vechol ze shello yakel rosho velo yargil leesor ishto alav:
Konam sheeni yashen kulei. hare ze beval yachel midderabbanan. aval min hattora en hanneder chal, dindarim en chalim ella al davar sheyyesh bo mammash:
