Konam sheeni meshammeshech. baggemara makshe, veha meshubad lah veheach yachol lehafekia shibudah benidro, veha have cheoser perot chavero al chavero. umeshane, kegon deamar hanaat tashmishech alay konam, sheasar hahanaa alav, veen maachilin lo laadam davar haasur lo:

Shevua sheeni yashen vechulei. asur min hattora, dishvuot chalin ben al davar sheyyesh bo mammash ben al davar sheen bo mammash. veim nishba shello yishan shelosha yamim retzufin layla vayom, loke veyishan miyyad, mippene shennishba al davar shei efshar lekayyemo:

Aruga shehi shishsha tefachim al shishsha tefachim vechulei‏ zorim vechulei. beferek rabbi akiva (shabbat 84:) darash la mikkera dichtiv ki chaaretz totzi tzimchah ucheganna zerueha tatzmiach (yeshaya 61), totzi chad, tzimchah chad, hare tere, zerueha tere hare arbaa, tatzmiach chad hare chamishsha. veha ditnan leel beferek sheni yarak beyarak shishsha tefachim, hanne mile besade gedola sheyyesh bah yarak harebe aval hacha deen zorea mikkol echad veechad ella meat lo chayshinan. uma sheyyesh lehakedim leferush hammishna hu ki anachnu tzerichin sheyyihye ben kol zeria uzeria richuk tefach umechetza [haggaha ze shello kedaat Rashi veharaavad zichrono livracha shehem zichrono livracha sovrim shetztzarich leharechik ben kol zera vezera shelosha tefachim. aval beshabbat perek rabbi akiva heetik mipperush Rashi zichrono livracha dehatam kemo shekkatuv betosfot yom tov] kede shello yinku ze mizze, ella im tihye zaviyyot betzad zaviyyot o vetzad tzela mekom zeria sheniyya az lo yitztarech, ki hagebalat hazzaviyyot yare havedalatam veaz en choshshin linikatam afillu hem ze betzad ze, veim ken baaruga shehi shishsha efshar lizroa bah chamishsha mine zeraim velo tihye kilayim, vezo tzuratah [tziyyur 1‏ besof hammassechet]. veyihye middat ma shennizra bezo haaruga esrim vearbaa tefachim, veamrinan baggemara perek rabbi akiva devaaruga becharava shaninu, aval aruga ben haarugot asur lizroa bah chamishsha minin, sheim yizra bechol ruach shebbaaruga zo uvechol ruach shebbaaruga shessevivoteha yerae hakkol kimorav. veharav rabbi shimshon zichrono livracha peresh al pi hayerushalmi dechach hu seder hazzeria, manniach bakkeranot charev tefach vachatzi chomesh al tefach vachatzi chomesh kede sheyyitrachek zera mizzera, zera mizrach mizzera darom, shiur alachson shel tefach vachatzi chomesh, dehaynu tefach vachetzi, vezorea bechol ruach arbaa tefachim chaser chomesh baorech. verochav tefach umechetza, ella shemmetzer veholech bechol tzad ad sheyyehe kale lerochav tefach chaser chomesh, kede sheyyehe leolam ben zera darom lezera mizrach tefach vachetzi, vechen lechol ruach ad sheyyehe manniach beemtza haaruga shelosha al shelosha, veose baemtza nekev vezorea bo garin echad kaze [tziyyur 2‏ besof hammassechet]. [haggaha yesh mefarshim shello yaale kol hazzarua shebbetzura zo rak pachot mishshenem asar tefachim (nire li shetztzarich lomar pachot mearbaa asar tefachim, dahave shelosha asar vearbaa chamshin)]. vehikshu vaggemara may dochkeh leokmeh baaruga shebbecharava, yakkifuha arugot mikkol tzad keneged hakkeranot veen bah davar zarua, vetertzu gezera shemma yemalle hakkeranot veyizra haaruga al zo hatztzura [tziyyur 3‏ besof hammassechet], o al zo hatztzura [tziyyur 4‏ besof hammassechet]. vehattaam shello amru baaruga shehi shishsha al shishsha tefachim zorin betochah tisha zeronin veyihye ben kol echad tefach umechetza kaze [tziyyur Adonai‏ besof hammassechet], lefi shekkol hannizra mimmenna hu tisha tefachim bilvad, veal zo shehikdamnu yihye esrim vearbaa tefachim. veha denakat aruga shishsha al shishsha, lefi shehi hayyoter ketanna shebbaarugot, shehi amma al amma, vehishmianu sheefshar lizroa bah zeraim mishtannim velo yihyu chilayim:
Haya lah govel gavoah vechulei. bayrushalmi [haggaha vechen nire min habbavli perek rabbi akiva] amru sheggam rochav haggovel tefach, nimtzet haaruga shemona al shemona:

Zorin betochah shelosha asar. shelosha al kol govel vegovel veechad baemtza kaze [tziyyur 6‏ besof hammassechet], veyihye middat hazzarua mimmenna sheloshim tefachim. veharosh zichrono livracha peresh al kol govel vegovel zorea arbaa bearbaat hakkeranot uven kol keren vakeren [haggaha perush shear kol haggovel shemmikkeren lekeren] shene mine zeraim, veha dekatane shelosha al kol govel mishshum dekeren echad nimne im hashshenayim, umone keren achat lechol ruach, uven arbaa minin shebbechol ruach tzarich leharechakat shelosha avirin shebbenehem arbaa tefachim vachetzi, veyishshaer limkom zera arbaa minin shelosha tefachim umechetza, vehu lechol min tefach chaser sheminit tefach. uvayrushalmi parech venitne shelosha al kol govel vegovel vachamishsha vaemtza kemo baaruga deresha veleheve shiva asar minin, umeshane mishshum shehaggevulim memaatim, perush shetztzarich leharechik zera haaruga mizzera haggevul tefach umechetza [haggaha perush tefach umechetza mitztzad mizrach vetefach umechetza mitztzad maarav hare shelosha velo nishar vechulei] velo nishar makom panuy lizroa baaruga ki im shelosha al shelosha. veim tomar lamma lo yizra al kol govel vegovel chamishsha minin shishsha tefachim learbaa avirim shebben chamishsha minin, veyishshaer shene tefachim lachameshet hamminin, shene chumshe tefach lechol min beorech tefach, veyihyu ben hakkol shishsha asar minin. [haggaha perush arbaa learba hakkeranot veod shelosha al kol govel vegovel, hare shishsha asar minin chutz min haemtzai] veyesh lomar deshemma beribbuy hamminim ikka irbuveya:
Mippene shehu memalehu. velo yuchal lizroa shelosha bechol gevul:

Rabbi yehuda omer shishsha baemtza. bayrushalmi daresh zera zarah zerueha hare telata, dahava matze lemichtav zera uchetiv zerueha, vetotzi tzimchah tatzmiach telata, hare shishsha. vechatav harash zichrono livracha devayrushalmi parech lemay deshaninan leel lerabbanan shehaggevulin memaatin hechi tane rabbi yehuda shishsha vaemtza, vei tema rabbi yehuda aresha kae, perush sheomer tanna kamma chamishsha vehu omer shishsha, ha tane rabbi chiyya rabbi yehuda omer shemona asar baemtza allema assefa kae, uferush sheshshenem asar al haggevul veshishsha vaemtza hare shemona asar. veeno metaretz kelum bayrushalmi. hilkach nire sheggova haggevul ole leminyan harichuk, dei lo tema hachi ammay nakat haya lah govel gavoah tefach, litne hayta haaruga shemona al shemona, ella vadday tana gavoah tefach leashmeinan shehaggova bichlal middat harichuk. vetzarich lomar derabbi yehuda letaameh deamar befirkin kimlo rochav happarsa dehaynu tefach, veen tzarich leharechik ki im tefach, vehasheta kevan sheggova haggevul min hamminyan lerabbi yehuda yachol lizroa bechol haaruga. vezorea bah shishsha minin shelosha beshura achat min hammizrach ushelosha beshura achat min hammaarav vechol min vamin tefach ushelish tefach rochav beorech shene tefachim umechetza, kaze [tziyyur 7‏ besof hammassechet]. verochav kol zarua meelle tefach ushelish beorech shene tefachim umechetza, vehakkav hallavan hecharev shebben shalosh shurot shemmitztzad ze leven shalosh shurot shemmitztzad haacher, hem shishsha tefachim beorech haaruga, vehecharev shebben zarua lezarua hu shene tefachim vachetzi keorech hazzarua, aval rachbo tefach echad kedaat rabbi yehuda, delo vae harechaka rak tefach, vehem arbaa avirim shehen asara tefachim, sach kol hecharev baaruga shishsha asar tefachim vesach kol hazzarua beemtza haaruga millevad haggovlin ole esrim tefachim. ulerabbanan zorea min echad baaruga chamishsha al chamishsha ki tzarich chatzi tefach [haggaha perush im tefach shebbegova haggovel have tefach umechetza kedaat rabbanan veyihye kol hazzarua esrim vachamishsha tefachim meachar shehu min echad. ad kan] mikkol tzad min haggovel. veim tomar lerabbanan ammay eno zorea ki im min echad bechol haaruga, vahalo yachol lizroa bah chamishsha minin tefach al tefach bechol keren vakeren vetefach al tefach baemtza, uvilvad shello yehe alachson shel tefach haemtzai keneged alachson haaruga sheaz lo yihye tefach umechetza ben zera haemtzai lezera hakkeranot, lefi shealachson haaruga shiva tefachim [haggaha perush retzono lomar, atta shello nishar rak chamishsha tefachim shekkevar achalnu chetzi tefach lechol tzad tashlum tefach vachetzi kidamran, vaalachson zeraim shel hakkeranot vehaemtzai arbaa tefachim vechomesh, perush shene alachsone hakkeranot im alachson haemtzai olin arbaa tefachim vechomesh. uferesh hechacham har avraham azulay nero, shehare keshettitten tefach zarua lechol keren vekeren vetefach zarua baemtza im yihye alachsono keneged alachson aruga ketzura zo [tziyyur 8‏ besof hammassechet] hinne shelosha tefachim hazzeruim im chumshehem shel shelosha alachsonim hannizkarim hem arbaa tefachim vechomesh, nishar min hashsheva shehu alachson haaruga shel chamishsha al chamishsha shelosha tefachim pachot chomesh lishne haharchakot, veanu tzerichin shelosha shelleyamin, tefach umechetza lechol tzad, shehu tefach ushene chumshin vachatzi chomesh, velekka bechol tzad rak tefach ushene chumshin, laze tzarich shello yihye tefach hazzarua beemtza alachsono keneged alachson haaruga ella tzalo keneged alachson haaruga kaze [tziyyur 9‏ besof hammassechet] ki bechach yishshaer lishne haharchakot shelosha tefachim hatzerichim veod chomesh echad yater. ketzad, ten tefach ushene chumshin lazzera shebbekeren zavit im alachsono, vetefach ushene chumshin lazzera shebbekeren zavit kenegdah baalachson, vetefach levad lazzera shebbaemtza, shehare eno baalachson ella arba tzalotav keneged hazzaviyyot, nishar avir panuy ben keren zavit letzela haemtzai tefach vachetzi vachatzi chomesh, vechen bekeren zavit shekkenegdah, vechen lishne haalachsonim haacherim, ad kan. veteretz rabbenu ovadya zichrono livracha veyesh lomar middelo shara rachmana ella chamishsha betoch shishsha mikkelal defachot mishshishsha ikka irbuv, ad kan. hakkushya vehatterutz hen hen divre har‏ shimshon zichrono livracha, vehapperush demikkelal divfachot mishshishsha ikka irbuv afillu keshehen tzela betzad zavit. ad kan haggaha] vaalachson hazzeraim shel hakkeranot vehaemtzai arbaa tefachim vachomesh. veyesh lomar middelo shara rachamana ella chamishsha betoch shishsha mikkelal defachot mishshishsha ikka irbuv. veharambam zichrono livracha peresh sheddaat rabbi yehuda sheefshar sheyyizra bezo haaruga shehi shishsha al shishsha veyesh lah gevul tefach shemona asar minin kezo hatztzura [tziyyur 10‏ besof hammassechet], veyihye middat hazzarua mimmenna sheloshim tefachim, ucheshettistakkel betzura zo timtza shishsha mesummanim orech kol echad shelosha tefachim verochav shene tefachim, nimtza kol tzela mehen alachson tefach umechetza al tefach, nimtzeu hazzeraim meruchakim ze mizze yoter mittefach umechetza. amnam im nirtze lomar lerabbi yehuda sheyyizra tisha minin baaruga baemtza uchemiddat hazzeria hazzot unetzayyer otah kemo zot hatztzura [tziyyur 11 besof hammassechet], ze i efshar lefi shekkol mesumman mehattisha hamesummanin hametzuyyarin hu arko shene tefachim verachbo shene tefachim, nimtza kol tzela mehem alachson tefach al tefach, vehu tefach ushene chumshin, veanu tzerichin letefach umechetza velekka. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda:
Ad shettatlia. veshiurah have keshettishhe baaretz shelosha yamim bekarka lacha, uvivesha tzarich yoter:
Veyofach. yahafoch hakkarka bammacharesha bishvil shello yitzmach hazzera:

Kamma yehe choresh. shello tomar shehu tzarich lacharosh telamim telamim ketannim semuchim ze laze, ella ketalme harvia, kitlamim shedderech bene adam lacharosh achar shettered harvia, shechorshim telamim gedolim:
Kede shello yeshayyer rova levet sea. shello yishshaer baaretz makom sheeno mehuppach ella pachot meesrim vearba bakkarka shehu choresh, dehaynu rova kav levet sea. veen halacha keabba shaul:
Veen temura osa temura. ditmurato amar rachamana velo temurat temurato:
Evarim veubbarim lo memirim. divhema bivhema ketiv:

Al baalat mum kavua. sheim hemir behemat chullin baalat mum bivhema temima shel hekdesh, chala aleha kedushsha chamura kol kach sheim yifduha lo tetze lechullin liggazez veleaved, ella kedin kadashim shekkadam hekdeshan et muman shekkesheppodin otan en bahen hetter gizza vaavoda ella hetter achila, ma sheen ken bakkadashim sheim kadam muman lehekdeshan yotzin lechullin al yede pidyon liggazez veleaved, aval bitmura galle kera tov bera o ra betov, lo hifrish ben tam levaal mum:

Asa shogeg kemezid battemura. sheim savur lomar shor shachor sheyyetze mibbeti techilla yehe temura tachat zo, veyatza mippiv shor lavan, gabbe temura kaddish veloke, degalle beh kera yihye kodesh, lerabbot shogeg kemezid. aval bichhay gavna lakkadashim, im baal mum hu, lammizbeach lo kaddish veeno loke, dehekdesh taut eno hekdesh:
Hakkilayim. habba mittayish verachel:
Lo kedeshim. bitmura. veaf al gav ditmura chala kedushshatah al baal mum kavua, enah chala al ellu:

Velo makdishim. acherim bitmura, im kadashim hem. uterefa mashkachat la shehi kedosha, kegon shehikdish behema veachar kach nitrefa, uvezo hutzrach lomar deaf al pi shekkedosha hi, en osa temura. aval kilayim vetumtum veanderoginos, mittechillat beriyyatan nitkalkelu vei atta motze bahen kedushsha ella bevalde kadashim, shekkaddesha immam kodem shennitabbera, dehashta mealehen kedeshim, deyerech imman hen, uvahen hutzrach lomar deen osin temura. veallibba derabbi yehuda deamar bishar velad kadashim ose temura. velo damu levaal mum, devaal mum yesh bemino karban, aval hanach en beminan karban vachashive kivhema temea sheenah osa temura. ucherabbi yose berabbi yehuda ucherabbi elazar kayma lan, delekka man defaleg alayhu beha:
Kol sea sheyyesh bah rova. hakkav dehaynu echad meesrim vearba lisa, shehassea shishsha kabbin:
Yemaet. oto min acher hameorav bo ad sheyyifchat harova veyitbattel betoch hassea, umuttar lizroa velo mittesar mishshum zorea kilayim:

Yavor. mikkevan shehuzkak lemaet yasir hakkol, mishshum demechaze kimkayyem kilayim mikkevan shehitchil livror im lo haya borer et kullo. aval techillato pachot merova share. veen halacha kerabbi yose:
Ben mimmin echad. ben sheoto rova mimmin echad ben mimminin harebe tzarich lemaet:
Lo amru ella mimmin echad. deen shene minin mitztarfin leshiur rova:

Vachachamim omrim kol shehu chilayim lassea. ikka ben chachamim letanna kamma kegon sea seorim sheyyesh bah rova shibbolet shual vechussemin, letanna kamma tzarich lemaet, lachachamim en tzarich lemaet, deen shibbolet shual mitztaref lechussemin kevan delo havu kilayim bisa shel seorim. vahalacha kachachamim:

Hare netiot haellu karban im enan niktzatzot. raa ruach seara baa veyare shemma yikkatztzu netiotav veamar hare ellu karban im enan niktzatzot. o sheraa deleka nafla vair veyare al tallito shemma tissaref veamar hare zo karban im lo tissaref:
Yesh lahem pidyon. kishar hekdeshot, veyippadu veyikne vidmehen karban. dechevan delo amar hare hen alay kekarban, lav lemesrinhu aleh kekarban ikkavvan ella sheyyihyu liknot bidmehen karban:
En lahem pidyon. ella hammaot nitpasin bikdushsha vehannetiot chozrot lihyot kedoshot, dechevan deamar ad sheyyikkatztzu, hachi kaamar, lichsheefdem yachzeru veyikdeshu ad sheyyikkatztzu:
Karachat hakkerem umechol hakkerem. mefaresh lehu veazel:
Bet shammay omrim esrim vearba ammot. im karachtah esrim vearba ammot muttar lizroa lesham, pachot mikkan lo yavi zera lesham:

Shecharav meemtzao. veyesh gefanim kol sevivot hakkarcha shehi shesh esre amma al shesh esre amma, vechen im halcha hakkarachat al pene rochav hakkerem, sheen gefanim ella mishshene tzidde hakkarachat:

Im en sham shesh esre amma. kedivre vet hillel lo yavi zera lesham afillu baamma haemtzait, dearba ammot shebbetzad hakkerem mizze vearba ammot shebbetzad hakkerem mizze havu avodat hakkerem, daavodat hakkerem arba ammot keditnan lekamman, lefi shehayu botzrim bishvarim uvaagalot uveet hacharisha chorshim otah bishvarim, hilkach otan arba ammot kakkerem damu, veim nisharu bentayim shemone ammot chutz meotan arba lechol tzad lo vatle legabbe cherem umuttar lezaran, batzir mishshemone ammot shade palga lehacha ufalga lehacha, batle legabbe cherem vechakkerem damu veasur lizroa bahen mishshum kilayim. ulevet shammay lo chashiv sade pachot mishshemone ammot, hilkach arbaa veesrim ammot bainan arba laavodat hakkerem mikkan uchenegdan mikkan, pashu lehu shesh esre, shade shemone lehacha ushemone lehacha, ikka sade velo vatle:
Vehannafutz. hu min tzenon vealav domim laale hallefet, hilkach lo havu kilayim:
Vehatterovtor. min keruv shekkelachim shello dakkim:
Teradin. baaravi silka uvelaaz 61:
Leunin. baaravi 189 uvelaaz 578:
Hashshumanit. shum midbari vehu katan min hashshum haggadel baggannim:
Betzaltzul. batzal midbari katan mishshear betzalim lefichach nikra betzaltzul:
Pelaslos. min turmos hu. veturmos min kitnit yadua mar meod sheshsholkim oto sheva peamim veochlim oto bekinnuach seudda:
Meochle shum. echad meeser takkanot shettikken ezra sheyyihyu ochlim shum lele shabbat, mippene shemmarbim hazzera velel shabbat hu zeman ona shel talmide chachamim:
Umuttar bakkutim. sheenan olim laregel, veaf al gav demiddeorayta hu, mippene shehem sonim yerushalayim uvacharu lahem har gerizim:
